items.title: Germany Approves UniCredit's Proposed Independent Supervisory Board Members for Commerzbank
items.summary: The German government has officially supported the independent candidates proposed by UniCredit for the supervisory board of Commerzbank.
items.content: The German Ministry of Finance has announced its support for the independent supervisory board members proposed by UniCredit for Commerzbank. This development follows UniCredit's receipt of final regulatory approval for its takeover of the German lender. By backing these candidates, the German government has signaled a shift in its stance, facilitating UniCredit's integration plans for Commerzbank. UniCredit has also proposed its CEO, Andrea Orcel, for the position of chairman of the supervisory board.

items.summary: BNP Paribas Asset Management Holding S.A. has crossed a 5% voting rights threshold in TAG Immobilien AG, according to a regulatory disclosure.
items.content: BNP Paribas Asset Management Holding S.A. reported that it crossed the 5% threshold of voting rights in the German real estate company TAG Immobilien AG on November 25, 2026. The notification, released on November 27, 2026, indicates that the entity now holds 5.90% of total voting rights, comprising 5.04% attached to shares and 0.86% through instruments. This disclosure was made in accordance with the German Securities Trading Act (WpHG).

items.title: Société Générale Discloses Crossing 5% Threshold in Mitie Group
items.summary: Société Générale has notified Mitie Group that it increased its direct shareholding to 5.206% of voting rights.
items.content: On November 27, 2026, it was reported that Société Générale notified Mitie Group of a change in its shareholding position. As of November 25, 2026, the bank increased its direct holding to 67,777,272 shares, representing 5.206% of the company's voting rights. This move marks an increase from its previously reported position of 4.781%. The notification was completed in London on November 26, 2026.

items.title: UBS Group AG Discloses Change in Shareholding in Solar A/S
items.summary: UBS Group AG notified Solar A/S of a change in its aggregate shareholding, which decreased from 5.01% to 4.996%.
items.content: On November 27, 2026, UBS Group AG announced a change in its position regarding Solar A/S shares. The bank's aggregate holding in Solar A/S decreased to 4.996% of the total share capital, down from the previously reported 5.01%. This position includes both the bank's own holdings and financial instruments, such as shares held in custody for clients where the bank maintains a 'right of use' for share lending. The disclosure was made in accordance with sections 30 and 38-40 of the Danish Capital Markets Act.

items.title: GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy Co-Hosts Briefing for UK Small Modular Reactor Program
items.summary: GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy, alongside SGE SMR UK and Samsung C&T, held a briefing for over 200 British companies to discuss potential supply chain roles for a proposed £35 billion small modular reactor (SMR) project.
items.content: GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy co-hosted a meeting with SGE SMR UK and Samsung C&T to engage British businesses in the supply chain for a proposed £35 billion program to build 14 small modular nuclear reactors (SMRs) across three UK sites. The proposal, which utilizes BWRX-300 reactor technology, aims to provide approximately 4.2 gigawatts of generating capacity, potentially supplying 11% of the UK's electricity. The briefing covered various roles for local businesses, including engineering, manufacturing, construction, and maintenance. While the project is currently under preliminary regulatory assessment and has not yet received construction approval, the organizers are actively building a prospective supply chain for the initiative, which targets first power by 2034.

items.title: Gap Inc. Deploys AI Software Engineering Agent 'Devin' to Enhance E-commerce Operations
items.summary: Gap Inc. is integrating Devin, an AI software engineering agent from Cognition, to help its technology teams identify and resolve technical issues on its e-commerce platforms.
items.content: Gap Inc. has begun deploying Devin, an AI software engineering agent developed by San Francisco-based Cognition, to support its technology teams in maintaining e-commerce site performance. The deployment follows a period of high digital traffic for the retailer, which processed millions of online orders during recent holiday shopping events.

items.summary: Meta Platforms was named as a respondent in a South African High Court ruling concerning the removal of content from a pseudonymous Facebook account.
items.content: The Gauteng Division of the High Court in Tshwane issued a ruling in a case involving the South African Minister of Justice and a pseudonymous Facebook account, with Meta Platforms and Facebook South Africa named as respondents. The court directed the removal of disputed content, reinforcing the legal obligations of social media platforms to address unlawful content and harassment. The South African government welcomed the decision as an affirmation that social media platforms are subject to judicial processes and are not exempt from laws governing defamation and disinformation.

items.title: Meta Launches Instagram for TV in India
items.summary: Meta Platforms has introduced its 'Instagram for TV' service to the Indian market.
items.content: Meta Platforms has expanded its service offerings in India by launching 'Instagram for TV.' This move aims to increase the platform's reach in the region by integrating television-focused features. The launch is part of the company's broader strategy to enhance user engagement across its family of apps in key international markets.

items.title: Warner Music Group Settles Copyright Lawsuit with Suno
items.summary: Warner Music Group has reached a settlement with AI music startup Suno, resolving a copyright lawsuit and establishing a new partnership.
items.content: Warner Music Group has settled its copyright litigation against the AI music generation company Suno. As part of the resolution, the two companies have entered into a partnership that will allow for the licensed use of Warner Music's catalog in Suno's AI music generation platform. This agreement marks a shift from legal conflict to a commercial licensing relationship, distinguishing it from ongoing copyright disputes involving other major music labels. The partnership enables Suno to continue developing its generative audio technology while providing Warner Music with a framework for monetizing its intellectual property within the AI space.

items.content: JPMorgan Chase and BlackRock are identified as contenders to manage a portion of Singapore's public pension fund, which holds approximately $543.62 billion in assets. The report highlights the firm's involvement in seeking mandates for large-scale institutional asset management. No further details regarding the specific scope or timeline of the potential mandate were disclosed in the initial reporting.

items.title: Snap Integrates Linktree for Profile Links
items.summary: Snap Inc. has announced a new partnership with Linktree, allowing Snapchat users to add link-in-bio tools directly to their profiles.
items.content: Snap Inc. is launching an integration with the link-in-bio platform Linktree, enabling users to display links directly on their Snapchat profiles. This feature is designed to help creators and users better showcase their work and external profiles to their audience on the platform. The partnership marks a strategic move to enhance profile customization and creator utility within the Snapchat ecosystem. By incorporating Linktree, Snap aims to provide a more seamless way for users to connect their social presence across different platforms.

items.title: Southwest Airlines Announces Limited-Time Black Friday Companion Pass Promotion
items.summary: Southwest Airlines is offering Rapid Rewards members the chance to earn a promotional Companion Pass for early 2027 by completing qualifying travel booked during the Black Friday period.
items.content: Southwest Airlines has launched a limited-time Black Friday promotion allowing Rapid Rewards members to earn a promotional Companion Pass. To qualify, members must register and book one qualifying roundtrip flight or two qualifying one-way flights between November 27 and November 29, 2026, with travel completed by January 5, 2027. The earned Companion Pass will be valid for use from January 8 through March 3, 2027. Additionally, new applicants for a Southwest Rapid Rewards Credit Card who are approved by December 14, 2026, and meet spending requirements can earn a Companion Pass valid through December 31, 2027. The Companion Pass allows members to designate one person to fly free with them on qualifying flights, excluding taxes and fees.

items.title: Cybercrime Investigation into AI-Powered Fraud Targeting RBC
items.summary: Royal Bank of Canada (RBC) has been identified as a target in a cross-border cybercrime investigation involving an AI-powered synthetic identity fraud network.
items.content: A cross-border investigation has uncovered an AI-powered synthetic identity fraud network that targeted major Canadian financial institutions, including the Royal Bank of Canada. Authorities in Pakistan arrested three individuals in Lahore on October 19, 2026, for their alleged collaboration with four Indian nationals residing in Canada to orchestrate the operation. The investigation highlights the ongoing security challenges posed by sophisticated, AI-driven financial fraud schemes.

items.title: KeyBank Offers Tips to Help Consumers Spot and Avoid Holiday Shopping Scams
items.summary: KeyBank issued a consumer advisory regarding the rise of holiday-related fraud, highlighting the increasing use of artificial intelligence by scammers.
items.content: KeyBank has released guidance to help consumers identify and avoid holiday shopping scams, which are becoming more sophisticated due to the use of artificial intelligence. The bank warns of common tactics including fake retail websites, phishing emails, text messages, and AI-driven voice impersonations. KeyBank emphasizes that it will never contact customers to request passwords, demand remote device access, or ask for payments via transfer apps. The advisory encourages consumers to remain skeptical of unsolicited communications and provides five safety habits to protect personal and financial information during the holiday season.

items.title: CopperCorp Provides Update on Proposed Sale of the Skyline Copper-Gold Project
items.summary: CopperCorp Resources Inc. has provided a status update on the pending sale of its Skyline Copper-Gold Project to Bubalus Resources Limited, with closing expected in mid-December 2026.
items.content: CopperCorp Resources Inc. announced an update regarding the proposed sale of its Skyline Copper-Gold Project in Tasmania, Australia, to Bubalus Resources Limited and its subsidiary, Skyline Copper Exploration Pty Ltd. The transaction, originally entered into on October 25, 2026, involves a total consideration of A$3 million in cash and shares, plus a contingent A$1.5 million milestone payment and a net smelter return royalty. The company received conditional approval from the TSX Venture Exchange on November 2, 2026, and currently expects the transaction to close in mid-December 2026, pending final exchange approval. As part of the transition, CopperCorp's President and CEO, Steve Swatton, will serve as a technical consultant to Bubalus for six months to ensure continuity, and key members of the exploration team are expected to be retained by the purchaser.

items.title: Jade Leader Corp. Announces Change of Auditor
items.summary: Jade Leader Corp. has appointed Crowe MacKay LLP as its new auditor following the resignation of BDO Canada LLP.
items.content: Jade Leader Corp. announced that BDO Canada LLP resigned as the company's auditor effective November 26, 2026, at the company's request. The board of directors has appointed Crowe MacKay LLP as the successor auditor, effective the same day, pending shareholder approval at the upcoming Annual General Meeting. The company confirmed there were no disagreements or unresolved issues with the former auditor regarding audit scope, accounting principles, or financial disclosures. Both firms have submitted letters to securities commissions in Alberta, British Columbia, and Ontario confirming their agreement with the change.

items.title: Tana Resources Corp. Announces 4:1 Share Consolidation
items.summary: Tana Resources Corp. has received board approval to consolidate its issued and outstanding common shares on a 4:1 basis.
items.content: Tana Resources Corp. announced that its board of directors has approved a share consolidation of its issued and outstanding common shares at a ratio of one post-consolidation share for every four pre-consolidation shares. The company currently has 28,723,763 common shares outstanding, which will be reduced to approximately 7,180,941 shares following the consolidation. The company expects trading on a post-consolidation basis to commence on or about December 7, 2026, which will also serve as the record date. The company's name and trading symbol will remain unchanged, though the shares will trade under a new CUSIP and ISIN. No fractional shares will be issued, with adjustments made in accordance with the Business Corporations Act (British Columbia).
