items.title: Maxim Downgrades TruGolf Holdings to Hold From Buy
items.summary: Maxim Group has downgraded its rating for TruGolf Holdings, Inc. from Buy to Hold.
items.content: Maxim Group has issued a downgrade for TruGolf Holdings, Inc., moving the stock rating from Buy to Hold. The action was reported on November 27, 2026. This change reflects a shift in the firm's outlook on the company's equity.

items.title: Oragenics, Inc. Announces 1-for-6.5 Reverse Stock Split
items.summary: Oragenics, Inc. has approved a 1-for-6.5 reverse stock split of its common stock, effective December 7, 2026, to maintain compliance with NYSE American listing standards.
items.content: On November 25, 2026, the Board of Directors of Oragenics, Inc. approved a 1-for-6.5 reverse stock split of the company's issued and outstanding common stock. The action is intended to help the company meet the continued listing standards of the NYSE American exchange and reduce the risk of delisting due to a low trading price. The reverse split is expected to become effective at 12:01 a.m. Eastern Time on December 7, 2026, with trading on a post-split basis beginning when the market opens that day. The company will continue to trade under the symbol "OGEN" with a new CUSIP number. Shareholders previously authorized the board to determine a split ratio between 1-for-2 and 1-for-50 at the 2025 Annual Meeting of Stockholders.

items.title: Boardwalktech Reports Financial Results for the First Six Months of Fiscal 2027
items.summary: Boardwalktech Software Corp. announced its financial results for the six-month period ended September 30, 2026, reporting revenue of $1.7 million.
items.content: Boardwalktech Software Corp. reported revenue of $1.7 million for the first six months of fiscal year 2027, a decrease from the $1.9 million reported in the same period of the previous year. The company attributed this decline primarily to lower software and subscription services revenue resulting from non-renewals by smaller customers. As of September 30, 2026, the company held $122,000 in cash and $1.1 million in collectible receivables, which have since been collected. Additionally, the company reported outstanding debt of $2.2 million, down from $2.5 million at the end of March 2026, drawn against a $4 million line of credit from Celtic Bank.

items.title: Vivakor Highlights Direct Midstream's Progress on Water Infrastructure Asset Integration
items.summary: Vivakor, Inc. announced that its partner, Direct Midstream, LLC, has completed due diligence and is proceeding with the integration of water infrastructure assets acquired from Water Energy Services, LLC.
items.content: Vivakor, Inc. provided an update regarding Direct Midstream, LLC, noting the completion of due diligence and the ongoing integration of water infrastructure assets. This follows Vivakor's recent entry into a definitive agreement related to these assets. The integration effort is part of the company's broader strategy in the energy infrastructure and midstream logistics sector. Management continues to focus on expanding its commercial platform through such strategic initiatives.

items.title: Tiago Cunha Announces Acquisition of Shares in South Star Battery Metals Corp.
items.summary: Tiago Cunha has disclosed an acquisition of shares in South Star Battery Metals Corp.
items.content: Tiago Cunha has reported an acquisition of shares in South Star Battery Metals Corp. This disclosure reflects a change in shareholding for the company. The event was formally noted in a press release on November 26, 2026.

items.title: Western Metallica Resources Corp. Extends Exclusivity and Revises Terms for Nueva Celti Copper Project Sale
items.summary: Western Metallica Resources Corp. and Ajax Resources Plc have extended the exclusivity and option exercise period for the acquisition of Western Metallica's subsidiary, Western Metallica, S.L., to December 18, 2026, with revised cash-only terms.
items.content: Western Metallica Resources Corp. has agreed to extend the exclusivity and option exercise period for the potential acquisition of its Spanish subsidiary, Western Metallica, S.L., by Ajax Resources Plc to December 18, 2026. The subsidiary holds the Nueva Celti Copper Project in Andalusia, Spain. Under the revised terms, the total cash consideration has been set at US$145,000, which includes a US$10,000 deposit already paid, leaving a balance of US$135,000 due upon completion. The previously proposed equity consideration component has been removed from the agreement. The reduced cash offer is conditional on Western Metallica finalizing a business combination with a third party; otherwise, Ajax retains its rights under the original terms.

items.title: DGEN Technologies Corp. Announces Board of Directors Changes
items.summary: DGEN Technologies Corp. announced the resignation of Cole Goodwin from its board of directors and the appointment of Luka Vukovic as a new director.
items.content: DGEN Technologies Corp. announced that Cole Goodwin has resigned from the company's board of directors, effective immediately. Mr. Goodwin will continue to serve as the company's Chief Executive Officer. Concurrently, the company appointed Luka Vukovic to the board of directors. Mr. Vukovic is a business and finance professional who currently serves as the CEO of Topspin Capital Corp. and brings experience in financial analysis, investment evaluation, and business development to the board.

items.title: Edgemont Gold Corp. Provides Update on Reverse Takeover Transaction with Laiva Gold Inc.
items.summary: Edgemont Gold Corp. has submitted a draft amended and restated listing statement to the Canadian Securities Exchange as part of its ongoing reverse takeover transaction with Laiva Gold Inc.
items.content: Edgemont Gold Corp. announced on November 27, 2026, that it has submitted a draft amended and restated listing statement to the Canadian Securities Exchange (CSE) to advance its reverse takeover transaction with Laiva Gold Inc. The company also provided updates on Laiva's recent business developments, including a $1,000,000 promissory note entered into in July 2026 and a private placement completed on September 29, 2026, which raised approximately $3.3 million. Additionally, Laiva secured a bridge loan agreement with an affiliate of Nebari Partners LLC for up to US$15,000,000. The transaction remains subject to final CSE approval, after which the company expects to resume trading under the symbol 'SISU'.

items.title: Everkind Wellness Inc. Completes Acquisition of Razroze Inc.
items.summary: Everkind Wellness Inc. has finalized its acquisition of Razroze Inc., a move intended to bolster its institutional research partnerships and AI safety capabilities.
items.content: Everkind Wellness Inc. announced the completion of its acquisition of 100% of the issued and outstanding shares of Razroze Inc., following a share purchase agreement signed on October 27, 2026. As part of the transaction, Everkind issued 197,160 common shares to the former sole shareholder of Razroze at a deemed price of $0.634 per share. Additionally, the company paid an arm's length finder's fee by issuing 3,943 common shares at the same price. The acquisition is expected to enhance Everkind's institutional research partnerships and AI safety capabilities. The issued shares are subject to contractual lock-ups, indemnity holdbacks, and a statutory four-month-and-one-day hold period.

items.title: VisionWave Holdings, Inc. Announces $2 Million Registered Direct Offering
items.summary: VisionWave Holdings, Inc. has entered into definitive agreements for a registered direct offering of common stock and warrants to raise approximately $2.0 million in gross proceeds.
items.content: VisionWave Holdings, Inc. announced it has entered into definitive agreements with institutional investors for a registered direct offering of common stock (or pre-funded warrants) and accompanying investor warrants at a price of $0.19 per unit. The company expects to generate approximately $2.0 million in gross proceeds, which it intends to use for general corporate purposes and working capital. The transaction is expected to close on or about November 27, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions. Aegis Capital Corp. is serving as the exclusive placement agent for the offering. Following the closing and assuming full exercise of the pre-funded warrants, the company expects to have 31,947,506 shares of common stock outstanding.

items.title: Trading Halt Imposed on Profusa, Inc. (PFSA)
items.summary: Profusa, Inc. (PFSA) shares were subject to a trading halt on November 25, 2026, pending the release of news.
items.content: Trading in the securities of Profusa, Inc. (PFSA) was halted on November 25, 2026, at approximately 19:50 ET. The halt was initiated pending the announcement of company news. As of the report date, no resumption of trading had been authorized.

items.title: Wisr AI Systems Inc. Adopts Semi-Annual Financial Reporting
items.summary: Wisr AI Systems Inc. has transitioned from quarterly to semi-annual financial reporting to reduce administrative burdens and focus resources on business objectives.
items.content: Wisr AI Systems Inc. announced its decision to adopt semi-annual financial reporting (SAR) in accordance with the British Columbia Securities Commission's Coordinated Blanket Order 51-933. By moving away from quarterly reporting, the company aims to lower administrative and financial costs while dedicating more time to its core business goals. The company will no longer file interim financial reports and related Management's Discussion & Analysis (MD&A) for its three-month and nine-month periods. The first period affected by this change is the three-month period ended September 30, 2026, with the first SAR period covering the six months ending December 31, 2026. Wisr AI will continue to provide audited annual financial statements and six-month interim reports as required by securities laws and the Canadian Securities Exchange.

items.title: Copper Road Resources Reports High-Grade Grab Sample Results and Land Package Expansion
items.summary: Copper Road Resources Inc. announced positive assay results from its Ben Nevis Volcanic Complex project and an expansion of its mining claim holdings.
items.content: Copper Road Resources Inc. reported high-grade rock grab samples from its Ben Nevis Volcanic Complex (BNVC) project in Ontario, including values up to 20.3 g/t gold, 45.3 g/t silver, and 1,520 ppm lead near the historical Canagau Shaft, as well as 1.58% copper and 92 g/t silver in the Croxall Breccia corridor. The company also expanded its land package by designating 55 new mining claim cells, increasing the total area to 229 claim cells covering 11,329 hectares, plus 13 mining-rights-only patents. These developments support the company's ongoing exploration program, which includes ground gravity surveys and the reprocessing of legacy geophysical data to refine drill targets. Additionally, the company has submitted an early exploration drilling permit application to the Ontario Ministry of Energy and Mines following a signed exploration agreement with the Matachewan First Nation.

items.title: Freedom Gold Corp. Announces Extension and Amendment of Flow-Through Offering and Extension of Unit Offering
items.summary: Freedom Gold Corp. has revised the terms of its non-brokered flow-through share private placement and extended the deadline for its separate unit offering.
items.content: Freedom Gold Corp. announced an amendment to its previously announced non-brokered private placement of flow-through common shares (FT Shares). The company revised the terms to offer up to 6,153,846 FT Shares at a price of $0.13 per share, aiming for aggregate gross proceeds of up to $800,000. The company plans to complete a first tranche of this offering on or about November 27, 2026, for approximately $500,000. Additionally, the company extended the deadline for its separate non-brokered private placement of up to 1,666,666 units at $0.12 per unit, which seeks to raise up to $200,000. All other terms for the unit offering remain unchanged, and both offerings are subject to regulatory approvals.

items.title: Irruptive Metals Increases Its Interest in Pimenton to 61%, Accelerating Majority Control of the Copper-Gold Project
items.summary: Irruptive Metals Corp. has entered into an amending agreement to increase its interest in the Pimentón copper-gold project to 61%, securing majority control five years earlier than originally planned.
items.content: Irruptive Metals Corp. announced that its subsidiary, Irruptive Metals Chile SpA, signed an amending agreement with Minera Tamidak Limitada, effective November 25, 2026. This amendment modifies the original November 2025 option agreement for the Pimentón copper-gold project in Chile. By paying an aggregate of C$3.5 million, Irruptive has increased its project interest from 17% to 61%, achieving majority ownership and control. The company stated that this move accelerates its path to majority control by approximately five years and reduces the total payments owed to the vendor from C$32.5 million to C$30.5 million.

items.title: Beauce Gold Fields Commences Sonic Drilling at Saint-Simon-les-Mines
items.summary: Beauce Gold Fields has initiated a sonic drilling program at its Saint-Simon-les-Mines gold project in Quebec to test the Delery and Chaussegros sections of the paleoplacer gold channel.
items.content: Beauce Gold Fields has commenced a sonic drilling program at the Saint-Simon-les-Mines gold project, the site of Canada's first gold rush. The company plans to complete approximately 20 sonic drill holes, with the majority concentrated in the Delery Section at the western end of the six-kilometre-long paleoplacer channel. Four additional holes are planned for the Chaussegros Section to investigate a potential ancient tributary. This program is part of the company's broader objective to trace historical placer gold deposits back to their bedrock sources. The technical content of the announcement has been reviewed and approved by an independent Qualified Person.

items.title: Imaging Dynamics Company Ltd. Announces Related Party Transactions
items.summary: Imaging Dynamics Company Ltd. disclosed a series of loan agreements entered into with directors, related parties, and control persons between March 2019 and November 2026.
items.content: Imaging Dynamics Company Ltd. announced that it entered into various loan agreements with directors, related parties, and control persons between March 6, 2019, and November 9, 2026, to fund ongoing operations and general corporate purposes. The company acknowledged that it failed to publicly disseminate details of these debt transactions at the time they occurred due to inadvertence. As of October 31, 2026, the company reported outstanding indebtedness of approximately USD $1.498 million to Hua Star and USD $2.182 million to New Journey Health Group Ltd., the latter of which holds a 40.86% stake in the company. The company also noted that it has not yet paid out certain accrued interest to these parties and estimates it may borrow up to an additional USD $410,000 in promissory notes from New Journey over the next 12 months.

items.title: Keek Social Inc. Provides Corporate Update on Operations and Strategic Direction
items.summary: Keek Social Inc. announced that recent financing efforts were unsuccessful, its iOS app was removed from the Apple App Store, and it is in discussions regarding a potential reverse takeover.
items.content: On November 26, 2026, Keek Social Inc. provided a corporate update disclosing that recent financing efforts did not secure capital and that the company is currently evaluating alternative funding options. The company also reported that its iOS developer account has been suspended and its applications removed from the Apple App Store, though it is actively appealing the decision. To maintain service continuity, Keek has developed a progressive web application (PWA) that can be installed directly from its website. Additionally, the company is in discussions with a Guyana-based Canadian gold exploration firm regarding a potential reverse takeover transaction, though it noted there is no assurance that a definitive agreement will be reached.

items.title: USFM Corporation Enters Earn-In Agreement for Hook Lake Project Ahead of Twin Vee Merger
items.summary: USFM Corporation, which has agreed to a reverse merger with Twin Vee PowerCats Co., has signed a binding term sheet to earn an interest in the Hook Lake Project in Canada.
items.content: USFM Corporation, a U.S. exploration company currently in the process of a reverse merger with Nasdaq-listed Twin Vee PowerCats Co. (VEEE), has signed a binding term sheet with Manhattan Gold Corporation Limited. Under the agreement, USFM may earn up to an 85% interest in the Hook Lake Project in Nunavut, Canada, through a total earn-in of approximately A$30.2 million. This commitment includes US$1.5 million in cash payments and A$28 million in exploration funding over three years. The merger between USFM and Twin Vee, originally announced in July 2026 and amended in October 2026, is expected to be completed in late 2026 or early 2027, with pre-closing USFM stockholders expected to hold 93% of the combined entity.

items.title: Trading Halt Imposed on Keek Social Inc. by CIRO
items.summary: The Canadian Investment Regulatory Organization (CIRO) halted trading of Keek Social Inc. on the TSX Venture Exchange on November 26, 2026.
items.content: On November 26, 2026, the Canadian Investment Regulatory Organization (CIRO) implemented a trading halt on Keek Social Inc. (TSX-V: KEEK) at 10:46 AM ET. The halt was issued pending further information to ensure a fair and orderly market. CIRO, the national self-regulatory organization for Canadian investment dealers and trading activity, did not provide specific details regarding the cause of the halt, directing inquiries to the company.

items.title: Greencastle Resources Reports Quarterly Financial Results
items.summary: Greencastle Resources Ltd. released its financial results for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, reporting a loss per share of 0.01 CAD.
items.content: Greencastle Resources Ltd. announced its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, on November 25, 2026. The company reported a loss of 0.01 CAD per share, compared to a loss of 0.010 CAD per share in the same quarter of the previous year. Revenue for the period was reported at 0.0 million CAD, consistent with the revenue reported in the prior-year quarter.

items.title: Axion Minerals Completes Phase 1 Fieldwork at Cranberry Creek REE Property
items.summary: Axion Minerals Corp. has finished its Phase 1 exploration program at the Cranberry Creek rare earth element property in British Columbia.
items.content: Axion Minerals Corp. announced the completion of its Phase 1 exploration program at the Cranberry Creek REE Property, located near Revelstoke, British Columbia. The field activities, which concluded in mid-November 2026, included geological mapping, rock sampling, soil and stream-sediment sampling, and various ground geophysical surveys. The program collected 239 primary field samples and 30 quality-control samples to follow up on targets identified in 2025. Management stated that the program expanded the company's geological and geochemical coverage and that the resulting data will be integrated with previous work to guide future exploration stages.

items.title: Pioneer AI Foundry Announces Early Warning Report
items.summary: Pioneer AI Foundry Inc. reported an early warning filing regarding an indirect acquisition of common shares by Suneal Sandhu through Machai Capital Inc.
items.content: Pioneer AI Foundry Inc. announced an early warning report concerning Suneal Sandhu, who has become an associate of the company. Mr. Sandhu acquired 8,092,000 common shares indirectly through Machai Capital Inc. on November 17, 2026. Following this acquisition, Mr. Sandhu's total holdings increased from 2,502,000 shares to 10,594,000 shares.

items.title: Maxim Group Downgrades Kyntra Bio to Hold; Oppenheimer Adjusts Price Target
items.summary: Maxim Group downgraded Kyntra Bio (KYNB) to a hold rating, while Oppenheimer maintained its buy rating but lowered its price target to $30.
items.content: On November 26, 2026, analyst actions regarding Kyntra Bio were reported. Maxim Group downgraded the company's stock from a buy to a hold rating. Simultaneously, Oppenheimer maintained its buy rating on Kyntra Bio but reduced its price target for the shares to $30. These adjustments reflect updated analyst perspectives on the biopharmaceutical company's outlook.

items.title: Copper Lake Resources Announces Annual General and Special Meeting Results and Board Changes
items.summary: Copper Lake Resources Ltd. reported the results of its Annual General and Special Meeting held on November 25, 2026, including the appointment of Adam Cegielski as Chair.
items.content: Copper Lake Resources Ltd. held its Annual General and Special Meeting of Shareholders on November 25, 2026, in Toronto, Ontario. A total of 15,695,857 common shares, representing 52.89% of the issued and outstanding shares, were voted at the meeting. The company announced the appointment of Adam Cegielski as Chair of the Board, alongside other changes to its board and officer composition.

items.title: Copper Lake Resources Engages Velocity Trade Capital for Market-Making Services
items.summary: Copper Lake Resources Ltd. has entered into an agreement with Velocity Trade Capital Ltd. to provide market-making services effective November 25, 2026.
items.content: Copper Lake Resources Ltd. has engaged Velocity Trade Capital Ltd. to provide market-making services to enhance liquidity for its shares. Under the agreement, which commenced on November 25, 2026, the company will pay a monthly cash fee of C$7,500, with an initial payment of C$15,000 due upon execution. The agreement includes a 60-day initial period, after which it may be terminated by either party with 30 days' written notice. The company confirmed that there are no performance obligations tied to the agreement and that Velocity Trade will not receive any company securities as compensation.

items.title: Quest PharmaTech Announces Results of Annual General Meeting and Granting of Stock Options
items.summary: Quest PharmaTech Inc. held its annual general meeting of shareholders on November 23, 2026, re-electing three directors and electing a new board member, while also announcing the grant of 775,000 stock options.
items.content: Quest PharmaTech Inc. announced the results of its annual general meeting held on November 23, 2026. Shareholders re-elected J. Mark Lievonen, Jeffrey Shon, and Bradley Glass to the Board of Directors and elected John Porter as a new director. Additionally, the company announced the granting of 775,000 stock options to its directors and officers. These options have a volume-weighted average exercise price of $0.05 per common share and are set to expire 10 years from the date of grant, subject to approval by the TSX Venture Exchange.

items.title: Gold'n Futures Mineral Corp. Announces Non-Brokered Private Placement
items.summary: Gold'n Futures Mineral Corp. has announced a non-brokered private placement to raise up to $1,800,000 through the issuance of up to 12,000,000 units.
items.content: Gold'n Futures Mineral Corp. is initiating a non-brokered private placement of up to 12,000,000 units at a price of $0.15 per unit, aiming for gross proceeds of up to $1,800,000. Each unit consists of one common share and one common share purchase warrant, with each warrant allowing the holder to purchase an additional share at $0.20 for 24 months. Because the proposed issuance exceeds 100% of the company's current issued and outstanding common shares on a fully diluted basis, the offering is subject to shareholder approval, which the company intends to secure via written consent. Net proceeds from the offering are intended for general working capital purposes. The company may also pay finders' fees in cash and warrants to eligible finders.

items.title: Healthcare Triangle Denied Continued Nasdaq Listing
items.summary: Healthcare Triangle, Inc. received a formal decision from Nasdaq denying its request for continued public listing on the exchange.
items.content: Healthcare Triangle, Inc. has been notified by Nasdaq that its request for continued listing on the exchange has been denied. Following the announcement, the company's stock experienced a significant decline in after-hours trading. This development represents a critical regulatory event regarding the company's status as a publicly traded entity on the Nasdaq exchange.

items.title: Sparta Manufacturing Featured in New Brunswick Business Spotlight
items.summary: Sparta Manufacturing, a division of Sparta Capital Ltd., was highlighted for its role in producing recycling equipment for the growing market in rural New Brunswick.
items.content: Sparta Manufacturing, a subsidiary of Sparta Capital Ltd., was featured in a local business spotlight for its operations in rural New Brunswick. The company specializes in the production of recycling equipment, serving an expanding market. This coverage underscores the company's ongoing operational presence and its contribution to the regional environmental technology sector.

items.title: F4 Uranium Announces Non-Brokered Private Placement of up to C$1.5 Million
items.summary: F4 Uranium Corp. has announced a non-brokered private placement of flow-through shares to raise gross proceeds of approximately C$1.5 million for exploration in the Athabasca Basin.
items.content: F4 Uranium Corp. is offering up to 17,647,059 common shares as "flow-through shares" at a price of C$0.085 per share. The company intends to use the proceeds to fund eligible Canadian exploration expenses and flow-through mining expenditures at its uranium projects in the Athabasca Basin, Saskatchewan, by December 31, 2027. Red Cloud Securities Inc. is acting as a finder for the offering on a best-efforts basis. The offering is expected to close on or about December 18, 2026, subject to customary conditions and TSX Venture Exchange approval.

items.title: Psyched Wellness Provides Strategic Review Update
items.summary: Psyched Wellness Ltd. announced an update on its ongoing strategic review, noting that its historical financial supporter, Gotham Green Partners, will not provide further financing.
items.content: Psyched Wellness Ltd. is continuing to evaluate strategic alternatives, including potential debt or equity financing, strategic partnerships, asset sales, or business combinations. The company confirmed that Gotham Green Partners (GGP), which has historically supported the company, is not expected to provide additional financing. Consequently, management is actively pursuing alternative arrangements to address working capital requirements and maintain operations. The company cautioned that if these efforts are unsuccessful, it may be required to further reduce or curtail its operations, and there is currently no established timeline for the completion of the strategic review.

items.title: Tribe Property Technologies to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 30, 2026
items.summary: Tribe Property Technologies Inc. has scheduled the release of its financial results for the third quarter of 2026 for November 30, 2026.
items.content: Tribe Property Technologies Inc. announced that it will release its financial results for the third quarter of 2026 on November 30, 2026. This event is a routine corporate disclosure regarding the company's quarterly financial performance. No further details regarding the specific content of the results were provided in the announcement.

items.title: FGI Industries Lowers FY2026 Sales Guidance
items.summary: FGI Industries has reduced its fiscal year 2026 sales outlook, citing a revised range of $120 million to $127 million.
items.content: FGI Industries has lowered its sales guidance for fiscal year 2026. The company now expects sales to fall between $120 million and $127 million, down from its previous forecast of $134 million to $141 million. This updated outlook compares to market estimates of approximately $135 million. The adjustment reflects the company's revised expectations for its performance in the residential repair and remodel market.

items.title: North American Niobium and Critical Minerals Corp. Announces Non-Brokered Private Placement
items.summary: North American Niobium and Critical Minerals Corp. has announced a non-brokered private placement to raise approximately $300,000 through the issuance of flow-through common shares.
items.content: North American Niobium and Critical Minerals Corp. (CSE: NIOB) announced it will proceed with a non-brokered private placement of up to 2,727,273 flow-through common shares at a price of $0.11 per share. The offering aims to generate aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $300,000. The company intends to use these funds to incur eligible Canadian exploration expenses related to its critical mineral mining projects in Quebec. The offering is subject to customary closing conditions, including regulatory and Canadian Securities Exchange approvals. Securities issued under the placement will be subject to a four-month statutory hold period.

items.title: Hertz Energy Announces Amendment to Previously Announced Non-Brokered Private Placement
items.summary: Hertz Energy Inc. has amended the terms of its previously announced non-brokered private placement, replacing charity flow-through units with critical minerals and traditional flow-through units while reducing the size of the non-flow-through portion.
items.content: Hertz Energy Inc. announced an amendment to its non-brokered private placement originally disclosed on October 9, 2026. The company is replacing the previously planned charity flow-through units with critical minerals flow-through units and traditional flow-through units. Additionally, the size of the non-flow-through portion of the offering has been reduced. Coloured Ties Capital Inc., which had previously agreed to participate in the offering, will no longer be involved. The offering is expected to close on or before December 11, 2026, subject to customary conditions and regulatory approvals, including final approval from the Canadian Securities Exchange.

items.title: 20/20 BioLabs Announces Year-End Investor Webinar
items.summary: 20/20 BioLabs, Inc. will host a year-end investor webinar on December 2, 2026, to review 2026 milestones and outline 2027 growth priorities.
items.content: 20/20 BioLabs, Inc. (Nasdaq: AIDX) announced it will host a year-end investor webinar on Wednesday, December 2, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. ET. CEO Jonathan Cohen will review the company's 2026 commercial and operational milestones, including its first year as a Nasdaq-listed company, and outline strategic priorities for 2027. The session will feature guest speaker Edmond Massuda of FDA Partners, who will discuss the regulatory pathway for multi-cancer early detection blood tests. This event concludes the company's 2026 monthly webinar series, with the company transitioning to a quarterly update model in 2027.

items.title: Western Pacific Trust Company Reports Quarterly Financial Results
items.summary: Western Pacific Trust Company released its financial results for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, reporting a slight decline in revenue.
items.content: Western Pacific Trust Company held a financial conference on November 25, 2026, to present its results for the quarter that ended on September 30, 2026. The company reported total revenue of 0.4 million CAD for the period. This figure represents a 2.33 percent decrease compared to the same quarter in the previous year, which also saw revenue of 0.4 million CAD.

items.title: Impauer Technologies Launches PauerOne V3 with Integrated Payment Onboarding Gateway
items.summary: Impauer Technologies Inc. has released PauerOne V3, which integrates a payment onboarding gateway to allow users to purchase digital assets using traditional payment methods.
items.content: Impauer Technologies Inc. announced the commercial release of PauerOne V3, a self-custodial wallet platform. The update features an integrated payment onboarding gateway that enables users to purchase supported digital assets directly within the interface. Supported payment methods include debit cards, credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and regional bank transfer rails such as ACH, Interac e-Transfer, and SEPA. This launch is part of the company's strategy to expand platform adoption and provide accessible financial tools.

items.title: Impauer Technologies Inc. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Equity Compensation Grants
items.summary: Impauer Technologies Inc. reported its unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2026, highlighting a significant reduction in comprehensive loss and an increased cash position.
items.content: Impauer Technologies Inc. announced its unaudited financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a cash position of C$206,727 and total assets of C$353,981, compared to C$50,391 and C$230,964 at the end of 2025, respectively. Total comprehensive loss for the nine-month period was C$104,455, representing a 97% reduction from the same period in 2025, driven by reduced operating expenses and liability settlements. Additionally, the company announced the grant of 9,600,000 stock options and 4,800,000 restricted share units to directors, officers, and consultants, vesting in three annual installments starting September 15, 2027.

items.title: Usha Resources Announces Extension of Maturity Date of Convertible Debentures
items.summary: Usha Resources Ltd. has extended the maturity date of its 5% unsecured convertible debentures by one year, from December 11, 2026, to December 11, 2027.
items.content: Usha Resources Ltd. has elected to extend the maturity date of its outstanding $500,000 aggregate principal amount of 5% unsecured convertible debentures by twelve months, moving the date from December 11, 2026, to December 11, 2027. This extension, which remains subject to TSX Venture Exchange acceptance, was executed under the terms of the debentures allowing for a one-year extension with notice provided at least 15 days prior to maturity. As a result of the extension, the conversion price of the debentures has been amended from $0.05 to $0.10 per common share. Additionally, the company announced its intention to satisfy $12,500 in accrued interest for the period of June 11, 2026, to December 11, 2026, through the issuance of common shares, subject to regulatory approval.

items.title: U.S. Corn, Wheat Export Sales Rose Last Week
items.author: Dow Jones Newswires

items.title: THS Maple Holdings Ltd. Reports Financial Results for the First Quarter of Fiscal Year 2027
items.summary: THS Maple Holdings Ltd. announced its unaudited financial and operational results for the first quarter ended September 30, 2026, reporting revenue growth of 62.8% to $8.0 million.
items.content: THS Maple Holdings Ltd. reported revenue of $8.0 million for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, representing a 62.8% increase compared to the same period in the previous year. The company achieved a net income of $50,130, a turnaround from the net loss of $2,687 reported in the first quarter of 2026. This performance was driven by $2.3 million in bulk maple syrup sales to a large U.S. wholesale customer and continued growth in international markets. Excluding the bulk sales, the company's core business grew by 17.1%. Management noted that the focus for the remainder of the fiscal year is on higher-margin products and channels.

items.title: PowerBank Corporation Announces 1-for-20 Reverse Stock Split
items.summary: PowerBank Corporation is implementing a 1-for-20 reverse stock split of its common shares, effective November 30, 2026.
items.content: PowerBank Corporation (NASDAQ: PBK) has announced a 1-for-20 reverse stock split of its issued and outstanding common shares. The consolidation is intended to help the company meet Nasdaq listing requirements. The shares are expected to begin trading on a split-adjusted basis starting November 30, 2026.

items.title: Stamper Oil & Gas Corp. Enters Third Amendment Agreement for First Green Lithium Property
items.summary: Stamper Oil & Gas Corp. has entered into a third amendment agreement to acquire a 100% interest in the First Green Lithium Property in Québec, involving a final cash payment of C$30,000.
items.content: Stamper Oil & Gas Corp. entered into a third amendment agreement on November 26, 2026, regarding its option to acquire a 100% interest in the First Green Lithium Property in Québec. Under the terms of this agreement, the company will make a final cash payment of C$30,000 to the vendors on or before December 31, 2026. In exchange, the company will receive a waiver of all remaining exploration expenditure commitments under the original option agreement. Upon completion of this payment, the company will have fulfilled the requirements to acquire the 100% interest in the property, subject to TSXV approval.

items.title: Inturai Ventures Corp. Launches Precision Floor-Level Wireless Intelligence Capability
items.summary: Inturai Ventures Corp. has introduced a new feature for its spatial intelligence platform that enables floor-level tracking in multi-level buildings without requiring new hardware.
items.content: Inturai Ventures Corp. announced the release of 'Precision Floor-Level Wireless Intelligence,' a new capability for its spatial intelligence platform that allows for the identification of a person or device's specific floor within multi-level buildings. The feature is available immediately and can be activated remotely on existing sensors, eliminating the need for site surveys or additional hardware installations. This update is designed to support the company's ongoing commercial and pilot deployments, including its recent work with a Southeast Asian Pizza Hut operator. The company noted that this technology helps address needs in sectors such as retail and aged care by providing accurate location data across multiple levels. Inturai is currently exploring potential patent protection for this proprietary sensing method.

items.title: Spark Energy Minerals Inc. Announces Share Consolidation and Private Placement
items.summary: Spark Energy Minerals Inc. has proposed a 1-for-10 share consolidation followed by a non-brokered private placement to raise up to $1,000,000.
items.content: Spark Energy Minerals Inc. announced a proposed consolidation of its issued and outstanding common shares on a 1-for-10 basis. Following this consolidation, the company plans to conduct a non-brokered private placement to raise up to $1,000,000 through the sale of up to 6,666,667 post-consolidation units at a price of $0.15 per unit. Each unit will include one common share and one common share purchase warrant, with the warrant exercisable at $0.40 for 24 months. The company intends to use the proceeds for exploration, general working capital, and corporate purposes. The consolidation has been approved by the board of directors and is subject to final confirmation by the Canadian Securities Exchange.

items.title: Affinor Growers Inc. Announces Non-Brokered Private Placement
items.summary: Affinor Growers Inc. intends to raise up to $1,000,000 through a non-brokered private placement of units.
items.content: Affinor Growers Inc. has announced plans to complete a non-brokered private placement of up to 10,000,000 units at a price of $0.10 per unit, aiming for gross proceeds of up to $1,000,000. Each unit consists of one common share and one share purchase warrant, with the warrant allowing the holder to acquire an additional share at $0.20 for a 24-month period. The company intends to utilize the net proceeds from this offering for general working capital and operational purposes. The offering may include finder's fees for eligible arm's length parties, and all issued securities will be subject to a four-month and one-day statutory hold period under Canadian securities laws.

items.title: Benton Resources Acquires Strategic Land for Dominion Project
items.summary: Benton Resources Inc. has expanded its Dominion gold-base metal project in Newfoundland by acquiring a new 18-claim land parcel.
items.content: Benton Resources Inc. has entered into a purchase agreement to acquire a strategic 18-claim land parcel contiguous to its existing Dominion project in central Newfoundland. Under the terms of the agreement, the company will pay $12,000 and issue 120,000 shares to three arm's-length vendors. The vendors will retain a 2.0% net smelter return (NSR) royalty, with Benton holding an option to buy back 1.0% of this royalty for $1.0 million. The newly acquired land is located approximately 1.5 km southwest of the Daniel's Pond VMS deposit, further consolidating the company's land position in the region.

items.title: Naughty Ventures Completes Sale of Hydrogen Assets to Rev Exploration Corp.
items.summary: Naughty Ventures Corp. has finalized the divestiture of its hydrogen assets to Rev Exploration Corp.
items.content: Naughty Ventures Corp. has completed the sale of its hydrogen assets to Rev Exploration Corp. The transaction, reported on November 25, 2026, represents a strategic divestiture for the company. No specific financial terms of the asset sale were disclosed in the announcement. This event marks a change in the company's asset portfolio as it continues its focus on mineral exploration and venture investment.

items.title: Blade Resources Closes First Tranche of Private Placement
items.summary: Blade Resources Inc. has closed the first tranche of its non-brokered private placement, raising gross proceeds of approximately $6.09 million.
items.content: Blade Resources Inc. announced the closing of the first tranche of its non-brokered private placement, which was originally announced on October 13, 2026, and subsequently upsized on November 16, 2026. The company issued 20,300,329 units at a price of $0.30 per unit, resulting in gross proceeds of $6,090,098.70. Each unit consists of one common share and one share purchase warrant, with each warrant exercisable at $0.40 for a period of 36 months. The company intends to use the proceeds to fund exploration and development at its Hot Breccia project in Arizona and for general working capital. Additionally, the company paid finders' fees totaling $123,187.90 and issued 410,626 finder warrants, each exercisable at $0.40 for 36 months.

items.title: SATO Technologies Corp. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Signs First AI Co-Location Agreement
items.summary: SATO Technologies Corp. announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2026 and confirmed the signing of its first AI co-location agreement through its subsidiary, Qritical AI Inc.
items.content: SATO Technologies Corp. reported its unaudited financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. The company achieved a net income of $718,220, largely attributed to a gain from the settlement of a senior secured loan completed in August 2026. Revenue for the quarter was $1,089,353, compared to $3,344,866 in the same period of 2025, as the company down-clocked a portion of its mining fleet due to profitability considerations. Additionally, the company announced its first AI co-location agreement, with its subsidiary Qritical AI Inc. beginning to host AI computing equipment at the company's hydro-powered data center in Québec. Management noted that with the secured debt settled, the company has begun designing a dedicated building to support its expanding AI infrastructure business.

items.title: SalesCloser Technologies Ltd. Q3 2026 Financial Performance Disclosed
items.summary: Parent company Wishpond Technologies reported that its subsidiary, SalesCloser Technologies Ltd., contributed negative Adjusted EBITDA of $1,509,275 during the third quarter of 2026.
items.content: In its third-quarter 2026 financial results, Wishpond Technologies disclosed that its subsidiary, SalesCloser Technologies Ltd., remains in a growth and investment phase. The company reported that SalesCloser contributed negative Adjusted EBITDA of $1,509,275 for the quarter. Additionally, the report noted that as of September 30, 2026, SalesCloser held $2,013,269 in cash, representing the remaining portion of its concurrent equity financing proceeds from its qualifying transaction, net of expenditures. Wishpond maintains an approximately 62.87% ownership interest in SalesCloser.

items.title: IDEX Metals Corp. Announces $1.5 Million Non-Brokered Private Placement
items.summary: IDEX Metals Corp. has announced a non-brokered private placement of up to 10,000,000 units at $0.15 per unit to raise gross proceeds of up to $1,500,000.
items.content: IDEX Metals Corp. announced a non-brokered private placement of up to 10,000,000 units at a price of $0.15 per unit, aiming for gross proceeds of up to $1,500,000. Each unit consists of one common share and one share purchase warrant, with the warrant exercisable at $0.25 per share for a period of 24 months. The company intends to use the net proceeds from the offering to fund exploration activities at its mineral properties in Idaho and for general working capital. The offering is subject to customary closing conditions, including the receipt of all necessary corporate and regulatory approvals, such as approval from the TSX Venture Exchange.

items.title: TAG Oil Ltd. Reports Financial Results and Operations Update for Period Ended September 30, 2026
items.summary: TAG Oil Ltd. filed its financial results for the nine-month period ended September 30, 2026, and provided an update on its T-200 well operations at the Badr Oil Field.
items.content: TAG Oil Ltd. released its financial results and management discussion and analysis for the nine-month period ended September 30, 2026. As of the period end, the company reported C$7.8 million in cash and cash equivalents and C$5.0 million in working capital, with no debt. Capital expenditures for the nine months totaled C$5,582,000, primarily directed toward exploration and evaluation of the T-200 well. Operationally, the company reported that the T-200 vertical well reached a total depth of 4,160 meters, with high-pressure acid stimulation conducted to improve wellbore clean-up. An artificial lift jet pump system was installed and commenced operations on November 24, 2026, with further production results expected following testing.

items.title: Atlas Engineered Products Secures $3.6 Million Conditional Loan for Ontario Robotics Facility
items.summary: Atlas Engineered Products has entered into a conditional loan agreement for up to $3.6 million in funding from the Province of Ontario to support its robotics truss manufacturing facility in Clinton, Ontario.
items.content: Atlas Engineered Products (AEP) announced a fully executed conditional loan agreement for up to $3.6 million through the Province of Ontario's Forest Sector Investment and Innovation Program (FSIIP). The funding is designated for the company's robotics truss manufacturing facility in Clinton, Ontario, specifically supporting building construction and the acquisition of robotics and an integrated saw. CEO Hadi Abassi stated that the facility's increased efficiency and capacity will help address housing shortages and affordability challenges in the region. The project is expected to provide long-term economic benefits, including job creation and retention. The company previously celebrated the completion of the building and the commissioning of the robotic system during an open house on October 21, 2026.

items.title: NuRAN Wireless Receives Investment Committee Approval for €10 Million Project Financing
items.summary: NuRAN Wireless Inc. has secured investment committee approval for up to €10 million in long-term project financing from the AFRIGREEN Debt Impact Fund to support its mobile network rollout in Côte d'Ivoire.
items.content: NuRAN Wireless Inc. announced that the AFRIGREEN Debt Impact Fund has approved a senior secured facility of up to €10 million to finance solar and storage systems for the company's rural mobile network sites in Côte d'Ivoire. The financing is intended to support the company's partnership with MTN Côte d'Ivoire. The facility features a final maturity date of June 30, 2033, and includes a 24-month grace period for principal repayments. Borrowing will occur in tranches of at least €1 million, contingent upon the commissioning and acceptance of sites by MTN Côte d'Ivoire. The company expects to sign the definitive agreement in January 2027, with closing anticipated four to six weeks thereafter, subject to customary conditions including equity injection and partner consent.

items.title: Sekur Private Data, Inc. Deploys New User Interface for SekurMessenger
items.summary: Sekur Private Data, Inc. has launched an updated user interface for its secure team messaging and collaboration platform, SekurMessenger.
items.content: Sekur Private Data, Inc., a subsidiary of Sekur Private Data Ltd., announced the deployment of a new user interface (UI) for its SekurMessenger service. The platform provides secure team messaging and collaboration tools for enterprise, government, and defense clients. The update is part of the company's ongoing efforts to enhance its secure communications offerings. The company continues to emphasize its Swiss-hosted infrastructure and privacy-focused approach to data management.

items.title: JZR Gold Provides Update on Gold Processing and Metallurgical Optimization at Vila Nova Gold Project
items.summary: JZR Gold Inc. announced an update on gold concentrate processing trials at the Recuperadora Brasileira de Metal (RBM) facility in Brazil, detailing metallurgical challenges and a new optimization program.
items.content: JZR Gold Inc. reported that initial gold concentrate processing trials at the RBM facility in São Paulo, Brazil, identified metallurgical challenges where cyanide reacted with iron and other metals, which interfered with gold dissolution and increased reagent consumption. To address these issues, the company is implementing a targeted optimization program that includes the addition of a pre-aeration stage and an oxygen sparging system to improve oxidation conditions. Additionally, a filter press is being integrated into the circuit to better separate gold-bearing solutions from solids, aiming to minimize gold retention and water usage. The company's immediate focus is on completing these circuit enhancements and validating their effectiveness through further testing. JZR Gold remains committed to converting concentrate from its Vila Nova Gold Project into saleable gold through a consistent and scalable operation.

items.title: Renegade Gold Announces Closing of Bought Deal Private Placement for Gross Proceeds of C$7 Million
items.summary: Renegade Gold Inc. has successfully closed its previously announced bought deal private placement, raising aggregate gross proceeds of approximately C$7.09 million.
items.content: Renegade Gold Inc. announced the closing of a bought deal private placement, resulting in aggregate gross proceeds of C$7,088,517.84. The offering included the sale of 8,146,252 units at C$0.27 per unit and 16,296,766 common shares at C$0.30 per share. The company intends to use the proceeds from the flow-through shares to fund eligible Canadian exploration expenses related to its gold projects in the Red Lake Mining District of Ontario. These expenditures are expected to be renounced in favor of subscribers by December 31, 2026. The transaction also included the partial exercise of the underwriter's option.

items.title: WidePoint Coverage Assumed by HC Wainwright & Co. at Buy
items.summary: HC Wainwright & Co. has initiated coverage on WidePoint Corporation with a 'Buy' rating.
items.content: HC Wainwright & Co. has assumed coverage of WidePoint Corporation, assigning the stock a 'Buy' rating. This analyst action represents a new formal assessment of the company's investment potential by the firm. The coverage initiation serves as a substantive update for investors regarding the company's market position and outlook as viewed by the research firm.

items.title: OverActive Media Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Board Changes
items.summary: OverActive Media Corp. announced its financial results for the third quarter of 2026, highlighting narrowed operating expenses and net losses, alongside the departure of a board member.
items.content: OverActive Media Corp. reported its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, noting a 29% reduction in operating expenses and a 53% narrowing of its net loss compared to the prior-year period. The company attributed the improved cost structure to lower roster and team payroll following its exit from the VALORANT Champions Tour (VCT) EMEA league, as well as reduced corporate and administrative expenses. Additionally, the company announced that Wende Cartwright stepped down from its Board of Directors and as Chair of the Human Resources, Governance and Compensation Committee, effective November 25, 2026. Operational highlights included Movistar KOI securing a berth in the League of Legends World Championship and Toronto KOI winning the Monster Energy Launch Invitational.

items.title: North Shore Uranium Ltd. Closes Non-Brokered Private Placement
items.summary: North Shore Uranium Ltd. has closed its non-brokered private placement, raising gross proceeds of $1,110,930 through the issuance of 5,847,000 flow-through common shares.
items.content: North Shore Uranium Ltd. successfully closed a non-brokered private placement, exceeding its initial target to raise gross proceeds of $1,110,930. The company issued 5,847,000 flow-through common shares at a price of $0.19 per share. Proceeds from the offering are designated for Canadian exploration expenses on the company's uranium properties in Saskatchewan, with renunciations to subscribers effective by December 31, 2026. In connection with the financing, the company paid cash finder's fees of $66,655.80 and issued 350,820 non-transferable finder's warrants exercisable at $0.19 for a two-year period. All securities issued are subject to a statutory hold period expiring on March 27, 2027, and the offering remains subject to final acceptance by the TSX Venture Exchange.

items.title: ZTEST Electronics Inc. Reports First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial Results
items.summary: ZTEST Electronics Inc. announced its financial results for the first quarter of fiscal 2027, reporting a 34.9% increase in revenue and a 39.2% rise in net income.
items.content: ZTEST Electronics Inc. released its financial results for the first quarter of fiscal 2027, highlighting significant growth in both revenue and net income. The company reported revenue of CA$2.5 million, representing a 34.9% increase compared to the prior period. Net income also saw a substantial rise of 39.2%. ZTEST provides electronic manufacturing services, including PCB assembly and testing, through its subsidiary Permatech Electronics Corporation.

items.title: Aston Bay CEO to Present at Resourcing Tomorrow Conference
items.summary: Aston Bay Holdings Ltd. CEO Thomas Ullrich is scheduled to present at the Resourcing Tomorrow conference in London on December 2, 2026.
items.content: Aston Bay Holdings Ltd. announced that CEO Thomas Ullrich will deliver a presentation at the Resourcing Tomorrow conference in London, United Kingdom, on December 2, 2026. The presentation will take place during the Copper and Base Metals Mining Spotlights session and will focus on the Pre-Feasibility Study (PFS) and maiden mineral reserve for the Storm Copper Project in Nunavut. Mr. Ullrich will also discuss the exploration targets announced on November 25, 2026, and the company's Epworth project. The PFS, which was previously announced on November 10, 2026, outlines an after-tax NPV7% of C$165.1 million and an IRR of 32.8% on a 100% project basis.

items.title: Inverite Insights Inc. Launches Portfolio IQ Intelligence Solution
items.summary: Inverite Insights Inc. has introduced Portfolio IQ, a new intelligence platform designed to help lenders analyze loan performance and refine risk strategies throughout the lending lifecycle.
items.content: Inverite Insights Inc. announced the launch of Portfolio IQ, a portfolio intelligence solution that enables lenders to connect historical and ongoing loan performance with financial data and risk intelligence gathered at origination. The platform utilizes a new Loan Performance API, allowing lenders to provide structured data on repayment outcomes that can be linked back to original financial data and credit decisions. By creating a continuous feedback loop, the solution supports retrospective model validation, portfolio monitoring, and strategy reviews. This launch expands Inverite's risk infrastructure capabilities beyond initial credit decisions, aiming to provide deeper insights into borrower behavior over the life of a loan.

items.title: Good Purpose Investments Inc. Reports Third Quarter and Nine-Month 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Good Purpose Investments Inc. announced its financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, reporting significant revenue growth.
items.content: Good Purpose Investments Inc. filed its interim financial statements and management's discussion and analysis for the period ending September 30, 2026. The company reported revenue of $11.7 million for the nine-month period, representing a 79% increase compared to the same period in 2025. For the third quarter, revenue reached $3.2 million, a 41% increase over the $2.3 million reported in the third quarter of 2025. Additionally, the company highlighted strong performance in its bags category, which saw revenue grow to $6.8 million for the nine-month period, up 333% year-over-year.

items.title: Military Metals Corp. Completes Upsized Non-Brokered Private Placement
items.summary: Military Metals Corp. has successfully closed a non-brokered private placement, raising approximately $2.4 million in gross proceeds to fund exploration at its Trojárová project.
items.content: Military Metals Corp. announced the completion of a non-brokered private placement, issuing 15,972,733 units at $0.15 per unit for total gross proceeds of $2,395,909.95. Each unit consists of one common share and one share purchase warrant, with the latter exercisable at $0.20 for 24 months. The company plans to allocate the net proceeds toward exploration activities and technical studies at its flagship Trojárová antimony-gold project in Slovakia, as well as for general working capital. CEO Scott Eldridge noted that the upsized financing reflects strong investor confidence in the company's asset portfolio and strategic direction despite current market challenges.

items.title: Saga Metals Corp. Closes Final Tranche of Private Placement
items.summary: Saga Metals Corp. has closed the final tranche of its non-brokered private placement, raising aggregate gross proceeds of C$1,680,000.
items.content: Saga Metals Corp. announced the closing of the final tranche of a non-brokered private placement, issuing 3,500,000 flow-through common shares at C$0.48 per share for gross proceeds of C$1,680,000. This brings the total gross proceeds for the offering to C$7,179,679.68. The company intends to use the proceeds to fund eligible Canadian exploration expenses that qualify as flow-through critical mineral mining expenditures by December 31, 2027. Additionally, the company issued 210,000 non-transferable finder's warrants exercisable at C$0.825 per share for 24 months. The company also reported that its board of directors granted 3,100,000 restricted share units to certain directors and officers under its Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan.

items.title: VSBLTY Groupe Technologies Announces Director Resignation and Engagement of AGORACOM
items.summary: VSBLTY Groupe Technologies Corp. announced the resignation of director David Roth and the engagement of AGORACOM for investor communications services.
items.content: VSBLTY Groupe Technologies Corp. announced that David Roth has resigned from its Board of Directors, effective November 23, 2026. Concurrently, the company has engaged AGORACOM to provide investor communications services, including content marketing, forum engagement, and a shareholder concierge service, through a dedicated verified shareholder forum. The agreement spans from November 1, 2026, to November 15, 2027, with total compensation capped at CDN $100,000 plus HST, payable in shares for services. The company stated that the board will continue to assess its composition and governance requirements following the departure.

items.title: Ventripoint Diagnostics Appoints Dr. Philip Toleikis as Chairman
items.summary: Ventripoint Diagnostics Ltd. has appointed Dr. Philip Toleikis as Chairman of the Board as part of a planned leadership succession.
items.content: Ventripoint Diagnostics Ltd. announced the appointment of Dr. Philip Toleikis as Chairman of the Board, effective November 26, 2026. This leadership change is part of a planned succession strategy aligned with the company's new business plan, which emphasizes growth and revenue generation. Dr. George Adams, who served as Executive-Chairman for 16 years, has resigned from his position and will transition to the company's Business Advisory Committee to continue providing guidance. Dr. Toleikis, who joined the board in July 2026, is a life sciences executive with experience in building and financing medical technology companies.

items.title: Pinnacle Silver and Gold Corp. Reports Assay Results from El Potrero Project
items.summary: Pinnacle Silver and Gold Corp. announced the remaining assay results from its underground delineation drilling program at the Pinos Cuates mine, part of the El Potrero property in Durango, Mexico.
items.content: Pinnacle Silver and Gold Corp. has released the final assay results from a 1,452.20-metre, 73-hole underground delineation drilling program at the historic Pinos Cuates mine. The company also reported results from the La Dura mine and initial drilling at the Dos de Mayo mine, both located at the El Potrero property. Notable highlights include intercepts such as 7.18 g/t gold and 165 g/t silver over a true width of 4.33 metres. CEO Robert Archer stated that the results confirm the high-grade nature of the mineralization and establish significant true widths, which will support future mineral inventory determination and mine planning. The company plans to conduct further surface drilling in the first quarter of 2027 to explore gaps between historic mines and test additional mineralized veins.

items.title: Predictiv AI Inc. Announces Resignation of Independent Director Rob Barlow
items.summary: Predictiv AI Inc. reported the voluntary resignation of independent director Rob Barlow, effective November 26, 2026.
items.content: Predictiv AI Inc. announced that independent director Rob Barlow has resigned from the company's Board of Directors, effective November 26, 2026. Mr. Barlow was noted for his contributions to the company's transformation following its December 2025 reverse takeover, which integrated Shift Technologies Canada Inc. and HouseStack Holdings Inc. into the organization. The company expressed gratitude for his service in establishing its current foundation in artificial intelligence and indicated plans to appoint a new independent director in the near term.

items.title: Fusemachines Granted Nasdaq Listing Extension and Approval to Transfer to Nasdaq Capital Market
items.summary: Fusemachines Inc. received approval from a Nasdaq Hearings Panel to transfer its listing to The Nasdaq Capital Market, providing the company with additional time to regain compliance with listing requirements.
items.content: Fusemachines Inc. announced that a Nasdaq Hearings Panel has granted its request to transfer its stock listing from The Nasdaq Global Market to The Nasdaq Capital Market. This decision follows a hearing held on November 3, 2026, regarding the company's previous non-compliance with Nasdaq's minimum Market Value of Listed Securities requirement. As part of the approval, the company has been granted an exception to demonstrate compliance with stockholders' equity and bid price requirements by January 29, 2027, and March 17, 2027, respectively. The company's common stock will continue to trade under the ticker symbol FUSE, though the company noted that the relief is subject to conditions and there is no assurance that it will successfully regain or maintain full compliance.

items.title: American Atomics Files U.S. Provisional Patent Application for Modular Uranium Ore Processing
items.summary: American Atomics Inc. has filed a U.S. provisional patent application for a modular system designed to process and upgrade uranium-bearing ore at a smaller scale.
items.content: American Atomics Inc. announced the filing of a U.S. provisional patent application on November 19, 2026, for a modular approach to processing uranium-bearing ore. The company aims to demonstrate that this compact system can economically process ore from smaller uranium deposits that would otherwise be uneconomic to develop using conventional milling methods. By reducing the physical footprint and processing requirements, the company intends to provide a path to production for smaller or stranded deposits. The filing represents an initial step in seeking patent protection, and the company noted that commercial performance, costs, and the physical footprint of the system have yet to be demonstrated.

items.title: AirIQ Inc. Reports Financial Results for the Three and Six Months Ended September 30, 2026
items.summary: AirIQ Inc. has released its unaudited consolidated interim financial statements and Management's Discussion and Analysis for the three and six months ended September 30, 2026.
items.content: AirIQ Inc. announced the filing of its unaudited consolidated interim financial statements and Management's Discussion and Analysis for the three and six months ended September 30, 2026, with Canadian securities regulatory authorities. The reported financial results include the accounts of AirIQ and its consolidated subsidiaries: AirIQ U.S. Holdings, Inc., AirIQ U.S., Inc., and AirIQ, LLC. All inter-company balances and transactions have been eliminated in the consolidation. The documents are available on the company's website and the SEDAR+ platform. The company reported revenue of CA$1.8 million for the second quarter.

items.title: Foremost Clean Energy Enters Third Amendment Agreement for First Green Lithium Property
items.summary: Foremost Clean Energy Ltd. has entered into a third amendment agreement to finalize the acquisition of a 100% interest in the First Green Lithium Property in Québec.
items.content: Foremost Clean Energy Ltd. entered into a third amendment agreement dated November 26, 2026, regarding its option to acquire a 100% interest in the First Green Lithium Property. Under the terms of this agreement, the company will make a final cash payment of C$30,000 to the vendors on or before December 31, 2026. In exchange, the company will receive a waiver of all remaining exploration expenditure commitments under the original option agreement. Upon completion of this final payment, the company will have fully acquired the 100% interest in the property, subject to TSXV approval.

items.title: Corus Entertainment Announces Fiscal 2026 Fourth Quarter and Year End Results
items.summary: Corus Entertainment reported a decrease in consolidated revenue and segment profit for the fourth quarter and full fiscal year 2026, alongside a net loss.
items.content: Corus Entertainment announced its financial results for the fourth quarter and full year ended August 31, 2026. Consolidated revenue declined 11% for the quarter and 15% for the year, while segment profit fell 35% and 29% respectively. The company recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of $59.4 million for the quarter and $113.1 million for the year. Free cash flow was negative $1.6 million for the quarter and negative $47.7 million for the year. Additionally, the company noted it will receive at least $36 million from a $600 million government allocation to support Canada's audio and audiovisual sectors, which will be reflected in fiscal 2027 financial statements.

items.title: TruSilver Metals Corp. Commences Trading on OTCQB Venture Market
items.summary: TruSilver Metals Corp. has received approval to trade its common shares on the OTCQB Venture Market under the symbol "TAGMF," effective November 27, 2026.
items.content: TruSilver Metals Corp. announced that its common shares are now trading on the OTCQB Venture Market in the United States under the ticker symbol "TAGMF." This listing complements the company's existing trading venues, including the TSX Venture Exchange in Canada and the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in Germany. The company stated that the OTCQB listing is intended to provide U.S. retail and institutional investors with easier access to its shares. Concurrently, the company is advancing its 2026/27 diamond drilling program at its 100%-owned Sturgis-Walton Silver Project in Nova Scotia, with the first hole, ST-26-01A, currently underway.

items.title: SunPower Establishes New Business Unit in China
items.summary: SunPower Inc. has announced the establishment of a new business unit in China, a development accompanied by a 4% increase in the company's stock price.
items.content: SunPower Inc. has officially launched a new business unit in China. Following the announcement, the company's stock price experienced a 4% rise. No further specific details regarding the operational scope or strategic objectives of this new unit were provided in the initial reports.

items.title: NTG Clarity Reports Q3 2026 Financial and Operating Results
items.summary: NTG Clarity Networks Inc. reported its financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, noting a revenue of $19.2 million for the third quarter.
items.content: NTG Clarity Networks Inc. announced its financial results for the third quarter of 2026, reporting revenue of $19.2 million, which represents a 7.9% decrease year-over-year and a 4.3% decrease from the second quarter of 2026. The company noted that the sequential revenue decline has narrowed throughout the year as the situation in the Middle East shows signs of stability. Gross profit for the quarter was $6.3 million, or 33.0% of revenue, compared to $7.3 million or 34.9% in the same period last year, a change attributed to pricing concessions on renewals. Total comprehensive income for the quarter was $0.2 million, or 1.0% of revenue, down from $1.9 million or 9.1% in the prior year. Management highlighted that the company's delivery capacity remains its strongest asset, positioning it to pursue new opportunities.

items.title: EON Resources Inc. Reports Theft to New Mexico Oilfield Theft Task Force
items.summary: EON Resources Inc. announced that it reported a theft of copper wire from its Grayburg-Jackson oil field to the New Mexico Oilfield Theft Task Force, leading to the arrest of several suspects.
items.content: EON Resources Inc. reported that copper wire critical to operations was stolen from its Grayburg-Jackson oil field in Eddy County, New Mexico, on November 21, 2026. The company provided surveillance footage of the suspects and their vehicle to the New Mexico Oilfield Theft Task Force (NMOTTF) and shared the images on social media. With the help of a tip from a member of the public, authorities located the suspects and the stolen materials at a residence within two days of the incident. The facility is owned and operated by LH Operating, LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of EON. Field production experienced a partial interruption for three days while replacement wire was procured and installed.

items.title: Southern Energy Corp. Announces Restricted Share Award Grant
items.summary: Southern Energy Corp. has granted 600,000 restricted share awards (RSAs) to directors and employees as part of its compensation and retention program.
items.content: Southern Energy Corp. announced the grant of 600,000 restricted share awards (RSAs) under its Share Award Incentive Plan. The awards were issued to directors and persons discharging managerial responsibilities as part of the company's employee retention and compensation strategy. The RSAs vest in three equal installments on the first, second, and third anniversaries of the grant date. Upon vesting, the company retains the discretion to settle the awards in either cash or common shares, based on the closing market value of the company's shares on the TSXV on the business day prior to payment.

items.title: PetMeds Adopts Tax Benefit Preservation Plan
items.summary: PetMed Express, Inc. has implemented a Tax Benefit Preservation Plan to protect its net operating loss carryforwards and concurrently terminated its previous shareholder rights plan.
items.content: PetMed Express, Inc., operating as PetMeds, announced the immediate adoption of a Tax Benefit Preservation Plan designed to safeguard its tax assets, specifically net operating loss carryforwards (NOLs). These assets may be used to offset future taxable income and reduce federal income tax liabilities. In conjunction with this move, the company's Board of Directors approved the immediate termination of its prior limited duration shareholder rights plan, which was originally adopted in December 2024. The prior plan's expiration was accelerated to November 27, 2026, effectively ending all associated rights and obligations. The company stated that these actions are part of a broader strategy to support its return to sustainable profitability and enhance shareholder value.

items.title: The Precision Peptide Company Initiates Production of Tirzepatide and GLP3 Needle-Free Patches
items.summary: The Precision Peptide Company has ordered 20,000 units each of its tirzepatide and GLP3 transdermal patches following successful U.S. testing.
items.content: The Precision Peptide Company announced that its tirzepatide and GLP3 transdermal patches have passed formal U.S. testing, leading to a production order of 20,000 units for each product. These patches represent the third and fourth products in the company's needle-free line to reach commercial production, following BPC-157 and Thymosin Alpha-1. The company is currently working toward a full needle-free product lineup, which it aims to have on sale by the first quarter of 2027. The tirzepatide patch entered development in August 2026 and formal testing in October 2026, while the GLP3 patch began development in October 2026.

items.title: Aurania Resources Announces Termination of Private Placement, New Loan Agreement, and Proposed Warrant Extension
items.summary: Aurania Resources Ltd. has terminated its previously announced non-brokered private placement due to market conditions and secured a US$1.5 million loan from its CEO, Dr. Keith Barron.
items.content: Aurania Resources Ltd. announced the termination of its non-brokered private placement, originally announced on November 19, 2026, citing current market conditions. To support its operations, the company entered into a loan agreement with its Chairman, President, and CEO, Dr. Keith Barron, for up to US$1,500,000. The loan is unsecured, carries a 2% annual interest rate, and matures twelve months and one day after a demand for repayment is issued. Proceeds are intended for exploration expenses and general working capital. Additionally, the company has applied to the TSX Venture Exchange to extend the expiry date of over 3.7 million outstanding common share purchase warrants by 12 months.

items.title: Power Probe Issues Trading Update Ahead of FY26 Year-End
items.summary: Power Probe plc provided a trading update for the financial year ending December 31, 2026, revising revenue expectations due to US market headwinds while highlighting growth in EMEA and new product launches.
items.content: Power Probe now expects FY26 revenue to be between $34.5 million and $36.0 million, compared to $39.4 million in FY25, with an underlying EBITDA forecast of $7.3–8.4 million. The company attributed the lower-than-anticipated H2 US revenue to fuel-cost pressures and distributor consolidation, which led to inventory rationalization. Conversely, the company reported strong performance in the EMEA region with year-to-date growth of approximately 60%. Operationally, the company successfully launched seven new products in 2026 and is progressing with its Charlotte, North Carolina manufacturing facility, which is scheduled for a pilot of Made-in-USA SKUs in December 2026. Management expects FY27 revenue growth of 10–15% despite anticipated persistent macroeconomic headwinds.

items.title: Canadian Uranium Corp. Announces $3,000,000 Flow-Through Private Placement
items.summary: Canadian Uranium Corp. has announced a non-brokered private placement of up to 3,000,000 flow-through common shares at $1.00 per share to raise up to $3,000,000 for exploration in Saskatchewan.
items.content: Canadian Uranium Corp. announced a non-brokered private placement of up to 3,000,000 flow-through common shares at a price of $1.00 per share, aiming for aggregate gross proceeds of up to $3,000,000. The company has engaged Interward Asset Management Ltd. (dba Bunt Markets) to act as a finder on a best-efforts basis and ECM Capital Advisors as a financial advisor for the offering. Proceeds from the placement are designated for eligible Canadian exploration expenses that qualify as flow-through critical mineral mining expenditures on the company's Saskatchewan uranium portfolio. These expenditures will be renounced to subscribers in accordance with the Income Tax Act (Canada). The offering may be completed in one or more tranches.

items.title: Bitcoin Treasury Corporation Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Bitcoin Treasury Corporation announced its financial results for the third quarter of 2026, highlighting continued growth in its Bitcoin per Share (BPS) metric and updates on its lending and share repurchase activities.
items.content: Bitcoin Treasury Corporation reported its Q3 2026 financial results, marking its third consecutive quarter of Bitcoin per Share (BPS) growth, which increased by 0.33% during the period. The company's net income for the quarter was $25,255,159, largely driven by a $22,800,108 fair value increase on its Bitcoin holdings. During the quarter, the company repurchased and cancelled 139,200 common shares under its Normal Course Issuer Bid (NCIB) and sold approximately 7.23 BTC to fund these repurchases and working capital. Additionally, the company noted that its 100 BTC fixed-term loan to a US-based trading firm matured in August 2026, and it ceased its lending advisory relationship with FRNT effective September 28, 2026.
