items.title: Deutsche Bank Analysts Assess New ECB Board Appointments
items.summary: Deutsche Bank research analysts provided an assessment of the new European Central Bank (ECB) board members, anticipating a shift in policy tone.
items.content: Analysts at Deutsche Bank have evaluated the appointments of new ECB board members Hernandez de Cos, Brunnermeier, and Boone. The firm characterizes the new members as potentially more 'dovish' than their predecessors, though they expect broad continuity in the central bank's monetary policy strategy. The research highlights that while the ECB may show greater patience regarding temporary inflation shocks, it remains committed to price stability. The analysts also noted that future chief economist Markus Brunnermeier may act as a counterweight to this patience, potentially favoring earlier policy adjustments in response to emerging risks.

items.title: Teleperformance Named Best AI-Powered CX Partner by The Digital Banker
items.summary: Teleperformance (TP) has been recognized as the 'Best AI-Powered CX Partner' in The Digital Banker's 2026 Global AI Innovation Awards for its agentic AI solutions in the banking and financial sector.
items.content: Teleperformance has received the 'Best AI-Powered CX Partner' award from The Digital Banker for its work in creating proactive, agentic AI-powered customer experiences. The company's banking offering, built on its proprietary TP.ai framework, integrates AI agents with human expertise and banking workflows to address customer service, collections, fraud, compliance, and dispute resolution. According to the company, the solution has delivered measurable results for financial institutions, including up to a 35% reduction in collections costs and a 25% to 40% reduction in manual chargeback-management effort. This recognition follows other recent accolades for the company in the Asia-Pacific region, including being named Frost & Sullivan's 2026 Asia-Pacific Company of the Year in Customer Experience Management Services.

items.title: Raiffeisen Bank International Advances Efforts to Release Strabag Stake Held by Rasperia
items.summary: Raiffeisen Bank International (RBI) has submitted documentation to claim damages against the Austrian assets of Rasperia Trading Limited, a move intended to facilitate the release of the Strabag stake held by the Russian entity.
items.content: Raiffeisen Bank International (RBI) is continuing its efforts to secure the release of the Strabag shares currently held by the Russian company Rasperia Trading Limited. On November 27, 2026, the bank announced it had submitted the necessary documentation to assert damage claims against Rasperia's Austrian assets. This action follows a Vienna default judgment in October that awarded RBI 3.15 billion euros in damages. The legal process aims to enable the Austrian Financial Market Authority (FMA), the sanctioning authority, to decide on the release of the Strabag shares in accordance with European sanctions regulations. The background of the case involves the 2022 disenfranchisement of Rasperia, a core Strabag shareholder, due to EU sanctions linked to Oleg Deripaska.

items.title: Security Breach Reported at US Air Force Cloud One Platform
items.summary: A security breach has been reported at the US Air Force's Cloud One computing platform, which utilizes infrastructure from several major technology providers, including Oracle.
items.content: The US Air Force's flagship Cloud One computing platform has experienced a security breach. The platform is powered by a multi-vendor cloud infrastructure that includes services from Oracle, Microsoft, Amazon, and Alphabet. The incident involves unauthorized access to the platform, which is critical for Air Force operations. Further details regarding the scope of the breach and the specific impact on Oracle's infrastructure remain limited as the situation develops.

items.title: Moody's Affirms Bureau Veritas' Rating

This action underscores the agency's confidence in the firm's financial stability and operational execution. The affirmation comes as the company continues to navigate its global testing, inspection, and certification business.

items.title: Safran participated in bidding process for Lumibird acquisition
items.summary: Safran was identified as one of the unsuccessful bidders in the competitive process to acquire the laser technology company Lumibird, which ultimately entered into exclusive negotiations with Thales.
items.content: According to reports from La Tribune, Safran was among the companies that submitted a bid to acquire the laser technology specialist Lumibird. Thales ultimately emerged as the successful party in the process, entering into exclusive negotiations to acquire a 51.6% stake in the company. The reports indicate that Thales was selected as the best-positioned bidder, offering superior terms and providing guarantees regarding the maintenance of the company's operations in Lannion, France. The transaction is part of a broader effort by Thales to strengthen its photonics capabilities.

items.title: Erste Group Bank Participates in Electrica Bond Program and Bridge Financing

items.content: Erste Group Bank was recognized by Electrica's CEO, Alexandru Chirita, for its role as a partner in the company's bond program and bridge financing. The transaction, which progressed from shareholder approval in April 2026 to final signing, involved collaboration with several financial institutions. This participation highlights Erste Group's ongoing involvement in corporate financing and capital markets activities within the Central and Eastern European region.

items.title: Eutelsat Communications Holds Annual General Meeting of Shareholders
items.summary: Eutelsat Communications held its Ordinary and Extraordinary Annual General Meeting on November 27, 2026, where shareholders approved all submitted resolutions.
items.content: During the Ordinary and Extraordinary Annual General Meeting held on November 27, 2026, Eutelsat Communications shareholders approved all proposed resolutions. Key approvals included the company's annual and consolidated financial statements and various regulated agreements, such as the Strategic Assets Protection Agreement between the company, Eutelsat SA, and the French state. Shareholders also voted to renew the director mandates for Padraig Mc Carthy and CMA CGM, approved the remuneration policy for corporate officers, and authorized the Board of Directors to acquire and potentially cancel company shares.

items.title: Hornbach Launches 'Hornbach macht Schule' Initiative

items.content: Hornbach has initiated a project titled 'Hornbach macht Schule,' which involves distributing construction kits to 150 schools. This initiative also includes the second edition of the company's 'Stapelbox' (stacking box) product. The program reflects the company's ongoing commitment to social engagement and educational support.

items.title: Erste Group Upgrades Spotify Technology to Buy

items.content: Erste Group analyst Stephan Lingnau has upgraded the rating for Spotify Technology S.A. from Hold to Buy. The upgrade is supported by the analyst's view that the company is demonstrating steady revenue growth. items.title: Lundbeck Explores Acquisitions in Psychedelic Medicines
items.summary: Lundbeck CEO Charl van Zyl stated that the company is actively exploring potential acquisitions in the field of psychedelic medicines to expand its psychiatry portfolio.
items.content: In an interview with Dow Jones Newswires, Lundbeck CEO Charl van Zyl confirmed that the company is engaged in active discussions regarding potential deals in the psychedelic medicine space. The company is evaluating both early- and late-stage development firms as it seeks to strengthen its presence in psychiatry, a sector where it currently lacks active development projects. Additionally, Lundbeck is pursuing broader acquisition opportunities to bolster its drug pipeline in therapeutic areas where it already possesses established expertise.

items.title: Stadler Rail Confirms 2026 Annual Targets and Reports Management Share Transaction
items.summary: Stadler Rail has reaffirmed its financial guidance for the 2026 fiscal year, projecting revenue exceeding 5 billion Swiss francs and an EBIT margin above 5 percent, while disclosing a share transaction between top executives.
items.content: Stadler Rail confirmed its financial targets for the 2026 fiscal year, maintaining expectations for revenue to surpass 5 billion Swiss francs and an EBIT margin of over 5 percent. Chairman Peter Spuhler expressed confidence in the company's current trajectory and long-term development. Additionally, the company disclosed that Vice Chairman Hans-Peter Schwald sold 350,000 shares to Peter Spuhler as part of a private, strategic investment. This transaction represents 0.35 percent of the company's share capital, with Spuhler remaining the largest shareholder at approximately 43 percent. The market responded positively to the confirmation of these financial goals.

items.title: Letko, Brosseau & Associates Opposes Canadian Natural Resources' Acquisition Proposal for Advantage Energy
items.summary: Investment firm Letko, Brosseau & Associates has announced its intention to vote against Canadian Natural Resources Limited's proposed acquisition of Advantage Energy Ltd. at $13.55 per share.
items.content: Letko, Brosseau & Associates has publicly stated its opposition to the proposed acquisition of Advantage Energy Ltd. by Canadian Natural Resources Limited. The firm intends to vote against the deal, which is valued at $13.55 per share. The opposition highlights concerns regarding the valuation of the offer for Advantage Energy, which holds significant oil and gas assets in Western Canada. This development represents a formal challenge to the proposed transaction by a shareholder.

items.title: Exosens Secures Contract to Supply Image Intensifier Tubes for German Armed Forces
items.summary: Exosens has been awarded a contract to supply 6,000 5G image intensifier tubes for the German military's "Future Soldier" program.
items.content: Exosens announced a new contract to provide 6,000 5G image intensifier tubes to the German Armed Forces. These components are intended for integration into fused night-vision binoculars as part of the German "Future Soldier" program. Deliveries are expected to commence in early 2027 and will be distributed over several years. While the specific financial value of the contract was not officially disclosed by the company, market analysts have estimated the potential revenue from this order at approximately 18 million euros.

items.title: J.P. Morgan Upgrades Pandora to Overweight
items.summary: J.P. Morgan has upgraded its rating for Pandora from neutral to overweight as part of its 2027 outlook for the luxury sector.
items.content: In a report detailing its 2027 outlook for the luxury industry, J.P. Morgan upgraded its rating on Pandora from neutral to overweight. The firm noted that while the luxury sector as a whole is expected to face another year without growth, specific segments like jewelry are showing resilience. This analyst action reflects a positive shift in the firm's view on the company's positioning within the broader luxury market.

items.title: Samsung Electronics to Contribute $3.53 Million to United Nations Development Program
items.summary: Samsung Electronics announced a $3.53 million contribution to the United Nations Development Program (UNDP) to support sustainable global goals.
items.content: Samsung Electronics has committed to a $3.53 million contribution to the United Nations Development Program (UNDP) as part of its ongoing partnership to support sustainable global development goals. The company disclosed in a filing with the Korea Exchange that the funding will be sourced through its 'Samsung Global Goals' application, supplemented by a matching contribution from the company. The payment is scheduled to be made in December, and the partnership is slated to continue through December 31, 2030.

items.title: Erste Group Downgrades Salesforce to Hold
items.summary: Analyst Stephan Lingnau at Erste Group downgraded Salesforce (CRM) to a 'Hold' rating.
items.content: Erste Group analyst Stephan Lingnau has downgraded Salesforce (CRM) to a 'Hold' rating. The action is reported by financial data platforms, which note the analyst's historical performance metrics. This rating change reflects the firm's current assessment of the company's stock.

items.summary: Scout24 SE has released a formal regulatory notification regarding voting rights and the acquisition or disposal of its own shares.
items.content: On November 27, 2026, Scout24 SE published a regulatory announcement concerning voting rights and the status of its own shares. This disclosure is part of the company's standard regulatory reporting obligations. The notification was disseminated through the EQS News service.

items.title: JP Morgan Chase & Co. Maintains Neutral Rating on Hugo Boss
items.summary: JP Morgan Chase & Co. has issued a research update maintaining a 'Neutral' rating for Hugo Boss AG.
items.content: On November 27, 2026, JP Morgan Chase & Co. released an analyst update regarding Hugo Boss AG. The firm maintained its 'Neutral' rating for the company's stock. This research note is part of the firm's ongoing coverage of the fashion and luxury goods sector.

items.title: Tikehau Capital: Disclosure of Shares Repurchases (20 Nov 2026 – 26 Nov 2026)
items.summary: Tikehau Capital released its weekly regulatory disclosure regarding share repurchases conducted between November 20 and November 26, 2026.
items.content: Tikehau Capital has published its mandatory regulatory disclosure under EU Regulation n° 596/2014, detailing share repurchase activity for the period from November 20, 2026, to November 26, 2026. During this timeframe, the company executed trades across multiple markets, including XPAR, CEUX, and TQEX. The aggregate volume of shares repurchased totaled 29,199, with a combined weighted average price of 15.7294 per share. Daily weighted average prices ranged from a low of 15.4468 on November 23 to a high of 16.0636 on November 26.

items.title: J.P. Morgan updates Hermès rating and target price
items.summary: J.P. Morgan has adjusted its outlook on Hermès, maintaining a neutral rating while lowering the target price to 1,340 euros from 1,600 euros.
items.content: On November 27, 2026, J.P. Morgan released an updated analysis on the luxury goods sector, which included a revision for Hermès. The firm maintained its neutral rating on the company's stock while reducing the target price from 1,600 euros to 1,340 euros. This adjustment is part of a broader sector outlook where analysts anticipate a challenging year for the luxury industry in 2027, characterized by uneven performance across different segments.

items.title: ABB Completes Major Modernization Project for Dyno Nobel in Queensland
items.summary: ABB has finalized a comprehensive maintenance and digital modernization project for Dyno Nobel's flagship facility in Moranbah, Queensland.
items.content: ABB's Electrification Service team successfully completed a 45-day turnaround project at Dyno Nobel's Moranbah facility, involving nearly 900 personnel at peak times. The project included the replacement of aging relays with ABB's REF615 technology, alongside detailed maintenance and upgrades to low and medium-voltage switchgear. These enhancements support the plant's digitalization goals, enabling real-time condition monitoring and improved electrical infrastructure reliability. The project was completed on schedule and within budget, with no reported safety incidents.

items.title: Coca-Cola HBC Completes Acquisition of 75% Stake in Coca-Cola Beverages Africa
items.summary: Coca-Cola HBC AG has finalized the $2.6 billion acquisition of a 75% controlling interest in Coca-Cola Beverages Africa (CCBA), expanding its reach to approximately 1.2 billion consumers.
items.content: Coca-Cola HBC AG has completed the acquisition of a 75% stake in Coca-Cola Beverages Africa (CCBA) for $2.6 billion, following receipt of necessary regulatory approvals including from the Fair Competition Commission of Tanzania. The transaction, funded through existing liquidity and bonds, adds 14 African markets to the company's footprint and makes it the second-largest Coca-Cola bottler by volume. Coca-Cola HBC has also secured an option to acquire the remaining 25% stake held by The Coca-Cola Company within a six-year period. Management expects the deal to be low-single-digit EPS accretive from the first full financial year post-completion and anticipates leverage will remain within its 1.5–2.0x net debt-to-EBITDA target range. Further financial details regarding CCBA are expected to be provided during the company's full-year 2026 results presentation in February 2027.

items.title: Novo Nordisk to Launch Wegovy Weight-Loss Pill in Sweden
items.summary: Novo Nordisk announced that it will launch its once-daily Wegovy weight-loss pill in Sweden on December 24, 2026.
items.content: Novo Nordisk has announced plans to introduce its oral Wegovy weight-loss treatment in Sweden on December 24, 2026. The company noted that pricing for the tablet version will be comparable to the existing injectable form, with retail prices to be determined by Swedish pharmacies. This launch is part of a broader rollout for the oral medication, which has already been introduced in several other markets including the U.S., U.K., Germany, and Spain. Jorgen Kronborg Jungersen, chief executive of Novo Nordisk Sweden, stated that the availability of a tablet option is expected to increase interest in obesity treatment.

items.title: BNP Paribas Asset Management Discloses Major Holding in TAG Immobilien AG
items.summary: BNP Paribas Asset Management Holding S.A. has reported crossing a 5% voting rights threshold in German real estate company TAG Immobilien AG as of November 25, 2026.
items.content: BNP Paribas Asset Management Holding S.A. announced that it reached a 5.90% total voting rights position in TAG Immobilien AG, a German real estate firm, as of November 25, 2026. This position consists of 5.04% in voting rights attached to shares and 0.86% through financial instruments. The disclosure was made in accordance with the German Securities Trading Act (WpHG) and published on November 27, 2026.

items.title: Nexi Greece showcases payment solutions at XENIA 2026
items.summary: Nexi Greece participated as an exhibitor at the XENIA 2026 trade fair, presenting its "Nexi Hospitality" payment solutions designed for the hotel industry.
items.content: Nexi Greece participated in the XENIA 2026 trade fair, marking its first appearance as an exhibitor at the event. The company showcased its "Nexi Hospitality" suite, which provides digital payment solutions tailored to the needs of the hospitality sector. The presentation focused on enhancing the guest experience and simplifying payment processes for hotel businesses.

items.title: Honeywell Executive Discusses Pure-Play Automation and AI Strategy
items.summary: Prad Pandit, Chief Commercial Officer for Honeywell Technologies in the UK, outlines the company's focus on autonomous AI-driven building management and critical infrastructure solutions.
items.content: In an interview published on November 27, 2026, Honeywell Technologies executive Prad Pandit detailed the company's strategic shift toward a pure-play automation model. The discussion highlighted the deployment of autonomous AI systems within commercial buildings, specifically focusing on agents designed to optimize occupant comfort and energy efficiency while managing operational alarms. Pandit emphasized that these technologies are intended to solve complex operational challenges for facility teams by automating routine building management tasks. The interview also noted Honeywell's ongoing collaboration with the European Space Agency and the UK Space Agency to develop quantum-secured satellite communications and resilient aerospace control systems.

items.title: Raiffeisen Bank International Advances Efforts to Release Strabag Assets
items.summary: Raiffeisen Bank International (RBI) has submitted necessary documentation to the Austrian Financial Market Authority (FMA) to pursue damage claims against assets held by the Russian company Rasperia Trading Limited.
items.content: RBI is continuing its efforts to secure the release of Strabag shares held by the Russian entity Rasperia Trading Limited. The bank recently submitted documentation to the Austrian Financial Market Authority (FMA) to enforce damage claims against Rasperia's Austrian assets, following a Vienna court ruling in October that awarded the bank 3.15 billion euros in damages. This legal action stems from the 2022 exclusion of Rasperia from the Strabag group due to EU sanctions against its former owner, Oleg Deripaska. The FMA now has a six-month window to decide on the application for the release of the assets. This development follows previous legal challenges in Austria and a separate 2.4 billion euro damage claim awarded to Rasperia by a Russian court against Raiffeisenbank Russia.

items.title: Banca Akros Upgrades Saipem to Buy Following Positive Q3 Results and Merger Progress
items.summary: Banca Akros has upgraded Saipem's rating to 'buy' from 'accumulate' and raised its target price to 5.4 euros, citing strong third-quarter operational performance and progress in the merger with Subsea 7.
items.content: Banca Akros has upgraded Saipem to 'buy' from 'accumulate,' increasing the target price from 4.4 euros to 5.4 euros. The upgrade follows positive third-quarter results, where Saipem reported an adjusted EBITDA of 468 million euros, exceeding the 437 million euros expected by analysts. The company confirmed its 2026 objectives and anticipates further growth in 2027, with its 18-month E&C pipeline reaching 65 billion euros. Regarding the merger with Subsea 7, the companies have secured 13 of the 16 required antitrust authorizations and are targeting completion in early 2027. Management expects the merger to generate 300 million euros in annual synergies.

items.title: Goldman Sachs Adjusts Price Target for Brenntag SE
items.summary: Goldman Sachs has lowered its price target for Brenntag SE from 76 to 75 euros while maintaining a 'Buy' rating.
items.content: Analyst Suhasini Varanasi of Goldman Sachs updated the firm's outlook on Brenntag SE, reducing the price target to 75 euros from the previous 76 euros. The 'Buy' rating remains unchanged. The analyst anticipates a solid performance for the chemical distributor to close out the year, though she noted significant uncertainties regarding price and volume trends for 2027.

items.title: MUFG Issues Research Report on OPEC+ Oil Market Outlook
items.summary: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) released a research report analyzing the challenges facing OPEC+ ahead of its upcoming ministerial meeting.
items.content: In a research report, MUFG highlighted that the OPEC+ alliance faces significant challenges, including unresolved Middle East conflicts that constrain production and the potential for a global oil supply glut by 2027. The bank noted that internal disputes over capacity assessments and production targets could hinder the alliance's ability to coordinate output effectively in the coming year. MUFG emphasized that while production policy is a factor, geopolitical developments in the Middle East remain the primary driver of short-term oil price movements, limiting the impact of any potential adjustments to production cuts.

items.title: Moody's Upgrades Outlook for adidas AG to Positive
items.summary: Moody's Ratings has affirmed the 'A3' long-term issuer rating for adidas AG while revising the outlook from stable to positive, citing improved financial performance.
items.content: Moody's Ratings has confirmed the long-term issuer rating of 'A3' and the rating for senior unsecured debt for adidas AG. Additionally, the agency affirmed the short-term issuer rating at 'Prime-2'. The outlook for the company was upgraded from 'stable' to 'positive'. According to Moody's, this rating action reflects the company's sustained improvement in financial performance observed through September 2026.

items.title: Market Analysis Highlights Bitmine Immersion Technologies' Ethereum Treasury Strategy
items.summary: A market report examines Bitmine Immersion Technologies' corporate Ethereum accumulation strategy, noting its role as a prominent institutional treasury model.
items.content: Bitmine Immersion Technologies, led by chairman Tom Lee, has become a notable proponent of corporate Ethereum accumulation. The company is building one of the largest corporate Ethereum holdings, utilizing a strategy modeled on the Bitcoin treasury playbook. This approach is funded through equity raises and is positioned as a long-term conviction bet on Ethereum's role in institutional finance, particularly regarding tokenization and stablecoin infrastructure. Analysts have highlighted the potential risks of this strategy, specifically noting that staking lockups could limit liquidity during market crises compared to Bitcoin treasury models.

items.title: Ausgold Shareholders Approve OceanaGold Acquisition Scheme
items.summary: Ausgold shareholders have voted to approve the scheme of arrangement for OceanaGold Corporation to acquire 100% of Ausgold shares.
items.content: On November 27, 2026, Ausgold shareholders voted in favor of the acquisition by OceanaGold Corporation, with 99.40% of votes cast in support of the transaction. Under the terms of the agreement, Ausgold shareholders are entitled to receive 0.03365 OceanaGold common shares for each Ausgold share held, or alternatively, they may elect to receive A$1.36 per share in cash, subject to a maximum cash pool of A$194 million. Upon the successful completion of the deal, which is expected to close on December 11, 2026, following court approval, Ausgold shareholders are anticipated to hold approximately 6% to 8% of OceanaGold. The transaction is currently scheduled to become effective on December 2, 2026.

items.title: B3 Partners with Major Financial Firms to Launch Digital Asset Settlement Platform
items.summary: B3 is collaborating with six major financial institutions to develop a shared infrastructure for settling digital asset trades using a neutral token.
items.content: B3 has partnered with Bradesco, BTG Pactual, Itaú Unibanco, Safra, Santander, and XP to create a shared infrastructure designed to facilitate the movement of money and settlement of digital asset trades. The initiative aims to provide a neutral token that rival institutions can accept, addressing a significant challenge for bank-led crypto projects. According to Luiz Masagão, B3's vice president of products, the platform is expected to launch in the first quarter of 2027. Additionally, B3 plans to utilize this 'Open BRL' token to settle tokenized stock trades on a digital equities platform currently under development, leveraging blockchain and smart contracts to automate settlement processes.

items.title: S&P Global Ratings Upgrades Sri Lanka's Sovereign Credit Rating
items.summary: S&P Global Ratings has upgraded Sri Lanka's sovereign credit rating to 'B-' from 'CCC+', citing improvements in the country's fiscal and external positions.
items.content: S&P Global Ratings announced an upgrade to Sri Lanka's long-term sovereign credit rating from 'CCC+' to 'B-', while also raising short-term foreign and local currency ratings to 'B' from 'C'. The agency attributed the decision to robust revenue growth and the accumulation of foreign reserves, which have helped strengthen fiscal and external buffers. Despite the upgrade and a stable outlook, S&P cautioned that the country still faces risks, including high debt burdens and potential exposure to global energy shortages or geopolitical conflicts. The agency projects economic growth to slow to 4% in 2026 before recovering to 4.5% in 2027.

items.title: Alphabet and Other Tech Providers Impacted by US Air Force Cloud One Security Breach
items.summary: Alphabet is among the technology providers for the US Air Force's Cloud One platform, which recently suffered a security breach that disrupted operations and potentially exposed sensitive data.
items.content: Alphabet, alongside Microsoft, Amazon, and Oracle, provides technology for the US Air Force's Cloud One platform, which was recently breached by hackers. The intrusion, discovered during a system upgrade, disrupted application migrations and updates, leaving some personnel unable to install software fixes. The US Cyber Command is currently investigating the incident to determine the extent of the data exposure and the identity of the attackers. The companies involved have not yet provided a formal response to the reports of the breach.

items.title: CNOOC Gas and Power Group Implements Cross-Border LNG Trading Product
items.summary: CNOOC Gas and Power Group has successfully launched a cross-border LNG trading product that integrates import, storage, and domestic/international sales to enhance market-oriented energy trading.
items.content: CNOOC Gas and Power Group, in collaboration with the Shanghai Petroleum and Natural Gas Exchange and CNOOC Hong Kong International Trade, has implemented a cross-border LNG trading product. The initiative allows for flexible logistics, enabling buyers to choose domestic delivery or authorize CNOOC to resell cargoes internationally based on price differentials. The pilot program, which saw four full LNG cargoes traded between June and July 2026, utilizes a closed-loop RMB settlement mechanism. This model represents a strategic shift for the company, moving from a passive infrastructure provider to an active market participant that balances energy supply security with value creation. The initiative is intended to serve as a demonstration model for China's cross-border LNG trade sector and provide insights for other energy enterprises.

items.title: Palantir Technologies Reportedly to Supply Maven Smart System to Poland's Defence Ministry
items.summary: Palantir Technologies is reportedly set to provide its Maven Smart System to the Polish Ministry of Defence.
items.content: Palantir Technologies has been reported to be in an arrangement to supply its Maven Smart System to the Polish Ministry of Defence. The Maven Smart System is a core component of the company's defense-focused software suite, designed to enhance intelligence and decision-making capabilities for military operations. This development indicates a potential expansion of the company's footprint within European defense sectors. The report highlights the continued adoption of Palantir's platforms by government agencies for mission-critical data integration and analytics.

items.title: Uber Secures Approximately 87% of Delivery Hero Shares
items.summary: Uber Technologies, Inc. announced that it has secured approximately 87.13% of Delivery Hero SE's share capital following the conclusion of its voluntary public takeover offer.
items.content: Uber Technologies, Inc. confirmed that its indirect subsidiary, Uber International Technologies II Corporation, successfully secured approximately 87.13% of Delivery Hero SE's share capital by the end of the additional acceptance period on November 24, 2026. CEO Dara Khosrowshahi noted that the strong shareholder support reinforces the confidence of Delivery Hero's management and supervisory boards in the transaction. The acquisition remains subject to customary closing conditions, including the receipt of necessary merger control and other regulatory clearances. The company expects the transaction to close in the second half of 2027.

items.title: Target Implements New Pricing Strategy for Holiday Season
items.summary: Target is pricing thousands of products at $5 or under while simultaneously investing in elevated merchandise to maintain competitive low-price positioning.
items.content: Target has announced a strategic pricing initiative, offering thousands of items at price points of $5 or less. This move is part of a broader effort to prioritize affordability for price-conscious consumers during the holiday season. Alongside these low-price offerings, the company is investing in elevated product assortments to balance value with trend-forward merchandise. This strategy aims to address current consumer demand for value while maintaining the retailer's competitive standing in the general merchandise market.

items.title: Disney Issues Cease-and-Desist to ByteDance Over AI Copyright Concerns
items.summary: The Walt Disney Company has reportedly sent a cease-and-desist letter to ByteDance, alleging the unauthorized use of Disney characters to train its Seedance 2.0 AI video generator.
items.content: Disney has taken legal action against ByteDance by issuing a cease-and-desist letter regarding the company's Seedance 2.0 AI video tool. The studio alleges that ByteDance utilized Disney-owned characters to train and power the generative AI platform without proper authorization. This move highlights the ongoing tensions between major entertainment studios and AI developers over intellectual property rights and the unauthorized use of copyrighted content for model training.

items.title: Equinix Collaborates with Honeywell on AI Data Center Infrastructure
items.summary: Equinix is partnering with Honeywell to implement advanced thermal management, fire safety, and security automation technologies across its high-density AI data centers.
items.content: Equinix has announced a collaboration with Honeywell to deploy integrated infrastructure solutions within its high-density AI-focused data centers. The partnership focuses on utilizing Honeywell's advanced thermal management, fire safety, and security automation systems to enhance operational efficiency and resilience. By integrating these technologies, Equinix aims to ensure continuous uptime and thermal stability for mission-critical enterprise workloads. This initiative is part of a broader effort to support the increasing power and cooling demands of modern AI infrastructure.

items.title: Goldman Sachs Warns of $100 Billion in Upcoming Systematic Selling
items.summary: Goldman Sachs' trading desk has issued a warning regarding an expected $100 billion wave of automated selling by systematic funds over the coming week.
items.content: The trading desk at Goldman Sachs, led by Paul Leyzerovich, informed clients that the systematic macro space remains in a sell mode. The firm estimates that approximately $70 billion in global equity sales occurred over the past week, with an additional $100 billion in automated selling projected for the following week. According to the firm's baseline scenario, this selling pressure is expected to conclude and transition into small repurchases by early December. Systematic funds, including commodity trading advisors that utilize price signals to track market trends, are identified as the primary drivers of this anticipated activity.

items.title: Citigroup Launches Reviews of Data Center Clients Following New U.S. Export Rules
items.summary: Citigroup has initiated comprehensive reviews of its data center clients to ensure compliance with new U.S. Commerce Department regulations regarding the export of advanced AI chips.
items.content: Citigroup, alongside other major financial institutions, has begun conducting sweeping reviews of its data center clients in response to tightened U.S. government regulations. The new rules, which took effect in November 2026, require data center operators in specific regions—including Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, and Brazil—to obtain a U.S. government license to purchase advanced AI chips from American manufacturers. Citigroup is requiring these clients to provide proof of compliance with the stricter export controls and disclose information regarding the end-users of the chips. This move reflects the broader impact of the regulatory shift on the financial sector, as banks adjust their financing and risk management practices to align with the updated export requirements.

items.title: Cloudflare Reports Significant Internet Traffic Surges During Grand Theft Auto 6 Launch
items.summary: Cloudflare observed and reported a sharp increase in global download activity and internet traffic associated with the launch of the video game Grand Theft Auto 6.
items.content: Cloudflare's infrastructure network recorded substantial spikes in internet traffic as users globally downloaded the newly released Grand Theft Auto 6. The company reported that download activity in the UK reached 8.6 times normal levels, while traffic in New Zealand surged to 14.8 times above typical baseline levels. These observations highlight the role of Cloudflare's edge network in managing high-volume digital content delivery during major global entertainment events.

items.title: Thermo Fisher Scientific Discusses Cooperation with Uzbekistan's Medical and Pharmaceutical Agency
items.summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific representatives met with officials from Uzbekistan's Agency for the Development of the Medical and Pharmaceutical Industry to explore potential collaborations in laboratory infrastructure and clinical research.
items.content: On November 26, 2026, a delegation from Thermo Fisher Scientific met with the Director of Uzbekistan's Agency for the Development of the Medical and Pharmaceutical Industry, Abdulla Azizov, to discuss potential cooperation. The discussions focused on developing laboratory infrastructure, introducing modern technologies, conducting clinical research, and enhancing the qualifications of local specialists. A key initiative discussed was the potential establishment of a reference laboratory at the National Institute of Biopharmaceutical Research. Both parties expressed interest in further collaboration and agreed to identify priority areas for a future memorandum of understanding.

items.title: Salesforce Releases Global Consumer Research on AI Adoption and Data Privacy
items.summary: Salesforce published new consumer research findings highlighting trends in AI-driven shopping behavior and evolving customer attitudes toward data privacy.
items.content: Salesforce released global consumer research indicating that AI is playing an increasingly significant role in the shopping journey, with approximately one in five consumers now utilizing AI to assist with purchases. The study projects that AI and AI agents will influence $75.8 billion in global online sales during Cyber Week 2026, accounting for 21% of total online sales for the period. Despite the growth in AI usage, the research highlights persistent consumer caution, noting that 73% of consumers are not yet prepared to entrust AI agents with their credit card information. Additionally, the findings reveal a shift in customer sentiment regarding data, with 71% of respondents becoming more protective of their personal information and 64% expressing concerns that companies are reckless with customer data.

items.title: Moody's Upgrades Vietnam's Sovereign Credit Rating to Ba1
items.summary: Moody's Ratings has upgraded Vietnam's sovereign credit rating from Ba2 to Ba1, citing improvements in governance and economic diversification.
items.content: Moody's Ratings announced an upgrade of Vietnam's sovereign credit rating to Ba1 from Ba2, reflecting the country's progress in governance, institutional reforms, and economic shift toward higher-value-added industries. The agency also revised its outlook for the nation from positive to stable. Moody's noted that while institutional overhauls and a more diversified economy have strengthened Vietnam's resilience, risks related to rapid credit growth and high leverage remain. This rating action is part of the company's core credit assessment operations.

items.title: The Coca-Cola Company Completes Sale of Controlling Interest in Coca-Cola Beverages Africa
items.summary: The Coca-Cola Company has finalized the sale of a 75% controlling interest in Coca-Cola Beverages Africa (CCBA) to Coca-Cola HBC AG.
items.content: The Coca-Cola Company, alongside Gutsche Family Investments, has completed the sale of a 75% controlling interest in Coca-Cola Beverages Africa (CCBA) to Coca-Cola HBC AG. As part of the transaction, The Coca-Cola Company sold 41.52% of its 66.52% stake in the bottler, while Gutsche Family Investments sold its 33.48% stake. The deal, which received all necessary regulatory approvals, includes an option agreement allowing Coca-Cola HBC to acquire the remaining 25% stake held by The Coca-Cola Company within a six-year period. CCBA is the largest Coca-Cola bottler in Africa, operating across 14 countries.

items.title: ScitiX Launches Model Inference Services on AWS Marketplace
items.summary: ScitiX has integrated its AI inference platform into the AWS Marketplace, allowing businesses to procure and manage AI model services directly through Amazon's cloud ecosystem.
items.content: ScitiX announced that its Model Inference services are now available for procurement via the AWS Marketplace. The platform provides users with access to multiple AI models through a unified API, designed to simplify enterprise AI adoption and resource management. By leveraging the AWS Marketplace, customers can streamline the purchasing process and integrate ScitiX's AI capabilities into their existing business applications. This partnership aims to help developers and enterprises scale their AI operations more reliably by utilizing ScitiX's unified resource management and intelligent scheduling tools.

items.title: Micron Reports High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) Capacity Largely Booked for Upcoming Year
items.summary: Micron Technology, Inc. has indicated that the majority of its High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) production capacity for the next year is already committed to customers.
items.content: Micron Technology, Inc. reported that most of its High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) capacity for the upcoming year has already been booked. The company noted that pricing for this capacity is significantly higher than in the current year. Management indicated that there is no immediate sign of an inflection point toward a supply-demand balance in the memory market. This update reflects strong ongoing demand for the company's advanced memory products used in high-performance computing applications.

items.title: China Shenhua Energy Announces HK$6.74 Billion H-Share Placement
items.summary: China Shenhua Energy Company Limited has announced plans to issue 177 million new H-shares at HK$38.10 per share to raise approximately HK$6.74 billion.
items.content: China Shenhua Energy Company Limited disclosed plans to raise HK$6.74 billion (approximately $859.8 million) through the placement of 177 million new H-shares at a price of HK$38.10 each. The company intends to use the proceeds from this capital raise to reduce outstanding corporate debt. Market analysts have characterized the placement as a likely one-off event for the coal-based integrated energy company.

items.title: HSBC to Consolidate Support Functions Across India in Cost-Cutting Push
items.summary: HSBC is reorganizing its financial operations in India by centralizing support functions as part of a broader cost-reduction and artificial intelligence integration strategy.
items.content: HSBC is consolidating its support functions across India as part of a strategic initiative to reduce costs and increase the adoption of artificial intelligence within its operations. The move involves centralizing finance-related roles across key hubs in the country. This restructuring is framed as part of the bank's ongoing efforts to streamline its global business model and improve operational efficiency.

items.title: TCL Mobile Collaborates with MediaTek on TCL P80 Ultra Smartphone Optimization
items.summary: TCL Mobile announced that its newly recognized CES Innovation Award honoree, the TCL P80 Ultra, features a three-layer optimization system co-developed with MediaTek.
items.content: TCL Mobile has announced that its TCL P80 Ultra smartphone, named a CES Innovation Awards 2027 Honoree, incorporates a specialized three-layer optimization system co-developed with MediaTek and EAGLE LAB. This collaboration focuses on enhancing device performance across several key areas, including NPU scheduling, imaging AI, display eye-comfort AI, multilingual voice processing, and on-device model adaptation. The integration highlights MediaTek's role in providing the underlying technological framework for TCL's latest flagship-level mobile device. The announcement was made ahead of the upcoming CES 2027 event in Las Vegas.

items.title: BYD Unveils "Whale" Flagship MPV at 2026 Guangzhou Auto Show
items.summary: BYD has introduced the "Whale," its first flagship multi-purpose vehicle (MPV) under the Ocean lineup, featuring both battery electric and plug-in hybrid powertrain options.
items.content: At the 2026 Guangzhou Auto Show, BYD unveiled the "Whale," a new flagship MPV designed for the 300,000 yuan market segment. The vehicle is the fifth independent IP in the company's Ocean lineup and is scheduled for an official launch in the first quarter of 2027. It will be available in both battery electric and plug-in hybrid variants, with the all-electric model offering a CLTC range exceeding 900 km. The MPV features BYD's second-generation Blade Battery and advanced flash charging technology, which the company claims allows for significant charging in under 10 minutes. The vehicle is also equipped with a LiDAR unit and next-generation advanced driver assistance systems.

items.title: Sony's Aibo Robotic Dog Offers Companionship
items.summary: Sony's Aibo robotic dog is highlighted for its role in providing companionship rather than performing household chores.
items.content: Sony's Aibo, a robotic dog, is characterized by the company as a companion rather than a functional tool for household tasks. The company avoids terminology such as "product" or "reboot" when discussing the robot, emphasizing its role in providing companionship. This perspective reflects Sony's approach to its robotics development, focusing on the emotional connection between the technology and its users.

items.title: Zijin Mining Group Repurchases 6 Million A-Shares for Employee Incentive Plan
items.summary: Zijin Mining Group Co., Ltd. announced the repurchase of 6 million A-shares on November 27, 2026, to support its employee stock ownership plan or equity incentive program.
items.content: On November 27, 2026, Zijin Mining Group Co., Ltd. disclosed the repurchase of 6,000,000 A-shares through the Shanghai Stock Exchange via centralized bidding. The shares were acquired at prices ranging from 23.77 RMB to 24.92 RMB per share, with a total expenditure of 147 million RMB. The repurchased shares are intended to be held as treasury shares for the company's employee stock ownership plan or equity incentive scheme. Following this transaction, the company's treasury shares increased to 31,249,770, while the total number of issued shares remained unchanged.

items.title: Market Commentary on Australian LNG Export Dynamics
items.summary: Recent industry analysis highlights the role of Shell and other producers in the Australian LNG market amid global supply volatility.
items.content: Industry reports indicate that a significant portion of Australian liquefied natural gas (LNG) is exported to Japan, China, and South Korea, primarily through long-term contracts. The analysis notes that new regulatory measures regarding domestic supply reservations will not apply to producers in Western Australia, which already operate under a state-mandated policy requiring 15% of production to be reserved for the local market. Shell remains a key participant in this landscape, which continues to navigate global supply disruptions and market volatility.

items.title: SK Hynix Reports Near-Sold-Out Production Capacity for 2029
items.summary: SK Hynix has indicated that its production capacity for 2029 is nearly fully booked, with memory shortages expected to persist into 2030.
items.content: SK Hynix reported that its production capacity for 2029 is nearly sold out, signaling that supply constraints in the memory market are likely to continue through 2030. This development reflects ongoing high demand for memory products, particularly in the context of the broader semiconductor industry. Analysts and institutions continue to monitor the supply-demand balance, with some forecasting significant price increases for DRAM and NAND flash in the coming year as the market struggles to meet demand.

items.title: Saudi Aramco's Jazan Refinery Operations Halted Following Attack
items.summary: Operations at Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery were temporarily suspended after a projectile strike caused a fire at the facility.
items.content: On November 26, 2026, a projectile struck the 400,000-barrel-a-day Jazan refinery on the Red Sea, resulting in a fire and the temporary suspension of some operations. The Saudi Energy Ministry confirmed the incident, noting that emergency teams and technical crews were deployed to assess damage and ensure facility safety. The attack, which resulted in one fatality and several injuries, has been attributed to Houthi forces. This event follows previous attacks on the same complex in August and September 2026.

items.title: HUTCHMED Announces NDA Acceptance for ORPATHYS Plus Osimertinib in China
items.summary: HUTCHMED has received acceptance from Chinese regulators for its New Drug Application (NDA) for the combination of ORPATHYS (savolitinib) and osimertinib for the treatment of first-line EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer with MET overexpression.
items.content: HUTCHMED (China) Limited announced that the National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) of China has accepted its New Drug Application for the combination therapy of ORPATHYS (savolitinib) and osimertinib. The application targets the treatment of patients with first-line EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) who also exhibit MET overexpression. This regulatory milestone marks a significant step in the company's clinical development program for its targeted oncology therapies. The acceptance initiates the formal review process by the Chinese health authorities.

items.title: BP and Iberdrola Start Operations at 25-MW Green Hydrogen Plant in Spain
items.summary: Iberdrola and BP have officially commenced operations at a 25-megawatt green hydrogen production facility located at the Castellón refinery in Spain.

This project represents a collaborative effort to scale up renewable hydrogen capacity within the region. The start of operations signifies the transition from development to active production for this specific infrastructure asset.

items.title: NIO's Firefly Brand Reaches 100,000 Cumulative Deliveries
items.summary: NIO's small electric vehicle brand, Firefly, has officially surpassed the 100,000 cumulative delivery milestone.
items.content: Firefly, the small electric vehicle brand under NIO Inc., reached the 100,000 cumulative delivery milestone on November 27, 2026, coinciding with the opening of the Guangzhou Auto Show. This achievement comes approximately 19 months after the brand began its first deliveries in April 2025. The brand has maintained steady growth, with October 2026 deliveries reaching a record 7,738 units, contributing 22.60% to NIO Inc.'s total monthly deliveries. To mark the milestone, Firefly launched limited-edition commemorative merchandise in its official app store.

items.title: Schneider Electric Launches Ultra-Fast EV Charging and Battery Energy Storage Solutions in Hong Kong
items.summary: Schneider Electric has introduced its EVlink Pro DC 720 ultra-fast charging solution and Schneider Boost Pro battery energy storage system to support Hong Kong's growing EV infrastructure.
items.content: Schneider Electric has launched the EVlink Pro DC 720, a direct current ultra-fast charging solution, and the Schneider Boost Pro, a battery energy storage system (BESS), in Hong Kong. The new products are designed to support the electrification of commercial fleets and meet the high-power charging demands of charge point operators, fleet operators, and building owners. The EVlink Pro DC 720 offers up to 720 kW of power, capable of charging an electric vehicle from 20% to 80% in approximately 15 minutes while supporting up to 12 vehicles simultaneously. The system features dynamic load management to optimize energy distribution across eTrucks, eBuses, and eTaxis, with a power efficiency of up to 97%.

items.title: XPeng Unveils 2027 Global Physical AI Expansion Roadmap
items.summary: XPeng announced a strategic roadmap at the 2026 Guangzhou Auto Show, detailing plans for international expansion across AI-powered vehicles, humanoid robotics, and autonomous mobility.
items.content: At the 2026 Guangzhou Auto Show, XPeng unveiled the next phase of its global Physical AI strategy, which includes the introduction of five new vehicle models to international markets by 2027. The company confirmed that Europe will be the first overseas market for its New P7 model. Additionally, XPeng plans to deploy its humanoid robot, IRON, internationally in the second half of 2027 and introduce its Robotaxi program to global markets. As part of this expansion, the company is establishing a new Hong Kong R&D Centre focused on humanoid robotics and general-purpose intelligence. XPeng aims to significantly increase its overseas sales, targeting a milestone of over 100,000 annual overseas vehicle sales in 2026 and aiming to more than double that figure in 2027.

items.title: Thales Enters Exclusive Negotiations to Acquire Majority Stake in Lumibird
items.summary: Thales has announced it is in exclusive talks to acquire a 51.6% majority stake in laser-technology company Lumibird.
items.content: Thales has entered into exclusive negotiations to purchase a 51.6% majority stake in Lumibird from its chief executive officer and majority shareholder, Marc Le Flohic. The proposed transaction values Lumibird at 30.10 euros per share, with the total valuation of the company's photonics division estimated at approximately 440 million euros, including debt. Thales expects to finalize the acquisition in the second quarter of 2027. The deal is intended to strengthen Thales' position in laser technology, with the company noting that defense and space activities are expected to represent a larger portion of Lumibird's revenue following the integration.

items.title: First Abu Dhabi Bank P.J.S.C. Securities Admitted to FCA Official List
items.summary: The UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) has officially admitted securities issued by First Abu Dhabi Bank P.J.S.C. to its Official List as of November 27, 2026.
items.content: On November 27, 2026, the UK's Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) announced the admission of various securities to the Official List. This regulatory action includes the admission of securities issued by First Abu Dhabi Bank P.J.S.C. The announcement was disseminated via regulatory news services and confirms the bank's participation in the listing process. This is a standard regulatory procedure for the admission of financial instruments to the market.

items.title: Melon Releases First Global-K Chart Data Report in Partnership with Tencent Music and Line Music
items.summary: The first data report from the Global-K Chart, a collaborative K-pop ranking initiative between Kakao Entertainment's Melon, Tencent Music, and Line Music, has been released, highlighting regional differences in artist popularity.
items.content: The Global-K Chart, launched in June by Kakao Entertainment's Melon platform in partnership with Tencent Music and Japan's Line Music, has published its first data report. The report analyzes 143 days of daily artist rankings from May 11 to September 30, 2026, using streaming data and fan engagement metrics from the three participating platforms. Findings reveal distinct regional preferences for K-pop artists, with BTS leading in Japan, Aespa dominating in China, and the group Rescene showing unexpected success in South Korea. This initiative aims to provide a cross-market perspective on K-pop consumption across Northeast Asia.

items.title: LVMH Announces Interim Dividend of €5.50 Per Share for 2026
items.summary: LVMH has declared an interim dividend of €5.50 per share for the 2026 fiscal year, payable in December.
items.content: LVMH Moët Hennessy - Louis Vuitton SE announced an interim dividend of €5.50 per share for the 2026 fiscal year. The dividend is scheduled for payment on December 3, 2026. The ex-dividend date is set for December 1, 2026, meaning the final day for investors to acquire shares with rights to this interim dividend is November 30, 2026.

The start-up of the plant represents a concrete step in their collaborative efforts to scale up green hydrogen production capacity.

items.title: Hotel101-Niseko Sold Out Ahead of Opening
items.summary: Hotel101 Global's Niseko property has reached full occupancy status for its pre-sold units prior to its official opening.
items.content: Hotel101 Global has announced that its Hotel101-Niseko project is sold out ahead of its scheduled opening. The development follows the company's asset-light 'condotel' business model, which involves pre-selling individual hotel rooms to investors before managing the property as a branded hotel. This milestone reflects the successful execution of the company's expansion strategy in Japan. The project is part of the company's broader global footprint, which includes ongoing developments in Spain and the United States.

items.title: Standard Chartered Initiates Reviews of Data Center Clients
items.summary: Standard Chartered has launched a review of its data center clients to ensure compliance with U.S. regulations regarding chip usage and transparency.
items.content: Standard Chartered, alongside other financial institutions like Citigroup, has begun conducting comprehensive reviews of its data center client portfolio. The initiative aims to ensure that these clients comply with stricter U.S. rules concerning the use and distribution of advanced chips. Banks are requesting that clients provide detailed information on their chip suppliers and proof of regulatory adherence. This move reflects growing scrutiny of the regional data center sector in markets such as Singapore and Malaysia, particularly regarding neocloud companies that lease computing power.

items.title: Meituan Reports Q3 2026 Earnings Beat
items.summary: Meituan reported third-quarter 2026 net profit of 2.07 billion yuan, exceeding analyst expectations as the company continues to recover from a food-delivery price war.
items.content: Meituan announced its financial results for the third quarter ended September 2026, reporting a net profit of 2.07 billion yuan, or approximately $310.7 million. This performance represents a significant improvement compared to the net loss of 18.63 billion yuan recorded in the same period a year ago and the 2.15 billion yuan profit in the second quarter of 2026. Quarterly revenue reached 115.55 billion yuan, marking a 22% increase year-over-year. The results surpassed market expectations, as analysts had projected a net profit of 354.7 million yuan on revenue of 113.56 billion yuan. Management indicated that the company is recovering from a prolonged food-delivery price war, with competition in the sector normalizing in recent quarters.

items.title: Severn Trent Plc Announces Director/PDMR Shareholding Transactions
items.summary: Severn Trent Plc reported that a Person Discharging Managerial Responsibilities (PDMR) and a Person Closely Associated (PCA) sold shares in the company on November 25, 2026.
items.content: Severn Trent Plc has been notified of share sales by a Person Discharging Managerial Responsibilities (PDMR), Robert Stear, and a Person Closely Associated (PCA), Sarah Stear. On November 25, 2026, Robert Stear sold 10,000 shares and Sarah Stear sold 6,000 shares, both at a price of 32.98p per share. Following these transactions, the PDMR retains a beneficial interest of 10,636 shares, while the PCA retains 929 shares. The company confirmed that the PDMR continues to meet the required shareholding threshold for their role. This notification was made in accordance with the UK Market Abuse Regulation.

items.title: DSC Holdings Ltd. Announces Vehicle-Sourcing Partnership with JAPANCARS
items.summary: DSC Holdings Ltd. has entered into a strategic partnership with Japanese automotive trading company JAPANCARS CO., LTD. to facilitate the export of Chinese used cars to global markets.
items.content: DSC Holdings Ltd. announced a vehicle-sourcing partnership with JAPANCARS CO., LTD. to connect China's used car inventory with international dealers. The collaboration, which went live on November 18, 2026, is managed through DSC's Singapore-based subsidiary, DASOUCHE PTE. LTD. By leveraging DSC's digital infrastructure and JAPANCARS' global export platform, the partnership aims to streamline cross-border vehicle trade and support DSC's long-term international expansion strategy. The initiative is expected to drive demand for DSC's digitalization solutions and transaction services by providing Chinese dealers with a consolidated entry point to overseas markets.

items.title: Kiatnakin Phatra Securities Maintains Neutral View on Delta Electronics (Thailand) Amid Tariff Uncertainty
items.summary: Kiatnakin Phatra Securities (KKPS) has provided an update on the potential impact of proposed U.S. Section 301 tariffs on Delta Electronics (Thailand), noting mixed implications and potential margin volatility.
items.content: Kiatnakin Phatra Securities (KKPS) maintains a "Neutral" rating on Delta Electronics (Thailand) (DELTA) following the U.S. Trade Representative's proposal for new tariffs on November 25, 2026. While the brokerage expects earnings to remain strong in coming quarters, it highlights potential near-term margin volatility due to the company's revised tariff accounting practices. Specifically, a timing mismatch may occur as tariff expenses are recognized when incurred, while corresponding revenue is recorded later, even if customers fully reimburse these costs. Additionally, the brokerage noted that Malaysia's proposed tariff rate matches Thailand's, which could reduce incentives for the company's parent to expand in Malaysia.

items.title: OCBC Bank Reports Limited Exposure to Data Center Sector
items.summary: OCBC Bank has disclosed that its lending exposure to the data center sector remains at a low single-digit percentage of its total loan portfolio.
items.content: OCBC Bank, alongside other major Singaporean lenders, has addressed concerns regarding the financing of the regional data center boom. The bank confirmed that its exposure to data center loans is limited, accounting for only a low single-digit percentage of its total lending. This disclosure comes amid broader market scrutiny regarding the financing of neocloud companies and the role of private equity in the sector's infrastructure expansion.

items.title: Tec-Do and Tencent Cloud Form Strategic Partnership
items.summary: Tec-Do and Tencent Cloud have entered into a strategic partnership aimed at helping businesses accelerate global growth through artificial intelligence.
items.content: Tec-Do and Tencent Cloud have announced a strategic partnership to support businesses in their international expansion efforts. The collaboration leverages Tencent Cloud's infrastructure and AI capabilities to provide solutions that help companies unlock global growth. This partnership is intended to enhance the digital transformation and operational efficiency of businesses operating in international markets.

items.content: Tullow Oil has entered into definitive agreements for strategic transactions and provided an update on its group restructuring process. The developments include the potential sale of the group's 50% interest in CADS Developers Limited, which remains subject to the waiver of pre-emptive rights or rights of first refusal by the other shareholder. These actions are part of the company's broader strategic and restructuring initiatives.

items.content: Huddled Group plc had its ordinary shares restored to trading on the AIM market at 07:30 on November 26, 2026. The resumption of trading followed the closure of a Capital Access Window, which had previously prompted a temporary suspension of the company's securities. The company confirmed the restoration of market liquidity for its ordinary shares (ISIN GB00BD5JRP64).

items.title: Huddled Group Raises £1.2 Million via Share Subscription and Retail Offer
items.summary: Huddled Group plc successfully raised £1.2 million through a combination of a share subscription and an offer directed at retail investors.
items.content: Huddled Group plc has raised £1.2 million in capital through a share subscription and a retail offer. This financing activity was reported on November 26, 2026, following the company's use of the London Stock Exchange's Capital Access Window to raise equity. The capital raise is part of the company's recent financial developments.
