items.title: Cloudbreak Discovery Lands Exclusive Option for Australia's Historic Emerald Gold Mine
items.summary: Cloudbreak Discovery has secured an exclusive option to acquire the historic Emerald Gold Mine in Australia.
items.content: Cloudbreak Discovery has entered into an agreement to secure an exclusive option for the historic Emerald Gold Mine located in Australia. This development represents a strategic move for the company as it continues to manage its portfolio of mineral exploration assets. The acquisition of this option aligns with the company's business model of identifying and advancing early-stage mineral projects. Further details regarding the terms of the option or the specific exploration plans for the site were not disclosed in the initial report.

items.title: Accsys Technologies: Forecasts maintained after resilient first half
items.summary: Progressive Equity Research has maintained its forecasts for Accsys Technologies following the company's resilient performance in the first half of the year.
items.content: Progressive Equity Research issued a report noting that Accsys Technologies has maintained its financial forecasts following a resilient first-half performance. The research highlights the company's ability to navigate current market conditions, supporting the existing outlook. This update serves as a reaffirmation of the company's financial trajectory as reported by the research firm.

items.title: Shore Capital Stockbrokers Discloses Dealings in Titon Holdings PLC
items.summary: Shore Capital Stockbrokers Ltd reported dealings in Titon Holdings PLC shares as an exempt principal trader on November 25, 2026.
items.content: Shore Capital Stockbrokers Ltd, acting as an exempt principal trader, disclosed dealings in the ordinary shares of Titon Holdings PLC that occurred on November 25, 2026. The firm reported purchasing 8,536 ordinary shares at prices ranging from 111.14p to 111.165p and selling 100,000 ordinary shares at a price of 112p. The disclosure confirmed that no derivatives, options, or other complex dealing arrangements were involved in these transactions. This filing was submitted on November 26, 2026, in accordance with regulatory requirements during the ongoing offer period.

items.title: Fitch Affirms Chesnara Ratings
items.summary: Fitch Ratings has affirmed its credit ratings for Chesnara plc, citing the company's strong market position and robust capital adequacy.
items.content: Fitch Ratings has affirmed its credit ratings for Chesnara plc. The rating agency highlighted the company's solid market position and strong capital base as key factors supporting the decision. This affirmation reflects the company's ongoing financial stability and operational standing within the life and pensions consolidation sector.

items.title: B90 Holdings CEO Ronny Breivik Purchases 1,060,000 Shares
items.summary: B90 Holdings CEO Ronny Breivik acquired 1,060,000 ordinary shares in the company on November 26, 2026, increasing his total interest to approximately 7.5% of the issued share capital.
items.content: On November 26, 2026, Ronny Breivik, the Chief Executive Officer of B90 Holdings, purchased 1,060,000 ordinary shares of the company. The shares were acquired through market trades on the London Stock Exchange (AIM) at an aggregated average price of 1.968 pence per share. This transaction increases Mr. Breivik's total interest in the company to 32,868,423 shares, representing approximately 7.5% of the company's issued ordinary share capital. This announcement serves as a replacement for a previous notification to correct the reported average purchase price.

items.title: Transense Technologies plc Trading Update and AGM
items.summary: Transense Technologies reports a 10% year-on-year revenue increase for the first four months of FY27 and announces a new contract with Continental.
items.content: Transense Technologies plc released a trading update for the first four months of the financial year ending 30 June 2027, reporting a 10% increase in group revenue compared to the same period last year. Revenue growth was driven by the Bridgestone iTrack (+7%), SAWsense (+17%), and Translogik (+8%) segments, with gross margins remaining above 85%. The company reported that AEBITDA was broadly flat, resulting in a small loss after interest, depreciation, and amortisation, while maintaining a cash position of £1.58 million as of 31 October. Additionally, the company announced a new development and supply contract with Continental for its Translogik business, which is expected to contribute to revenue in the second half of the year. This update was provided ahead of the company's Annual General Meeting held on 27 November 2026.

items.title: ProService Building Services Marketplace plc Announces H1 FY27 Trading Update
items.summary: ProService reported H1 FY27 revenue of approximately £145 million and narrowed its full-year underlying EBITDA guidance to between £9.0 million and £10.5 million.
items.content: ProService Building Services Marketplace plc released a trading update for the six months ended 30 September 2026, reporting revenue of approximately £145.0 million and underlying EBITDA of approximately £2.3 million. The company noted that it has achieved positive underlying EBITDA since May 2026 and expects a strong second half of the fiscal year supported by seasonal demand. Management narrowed the FY27 underlying EBITDA guidance range to between £9.0 million and £10.5 million. Additionally, the company reported pre-IFRS16 net debt of £41.6 million as of 31 October 2026, following recent refinancing activities.

items.title: RBC Capital Markets Adjusts Price Target for Liontrust Asset Management
items.summary: RBC Capital Markets has updated its price target for Liontrust Asset Management PLC while maintaining an 'Underperform' rating.
items.content: On November 26, 2026, RBC Capital Markets issued an analyst update regarding Liontrust Asset Management PLC. The firm adjusted its price target for the company while reiterating its 'Underperform' rating. This action reflects the firm's current assessment of the asset manager's market position and outlook.

items.title: Anglesey Mining plc Announces CEO Presentation at Proactive One2One Investor Forum
items.summary: Anglesey Mining plc announced that CEO Andrew Fulton will present at the Proactive One2One Investor Forum in London on December 1, 2026, to discuss the company's recent £1.25 million placing and future strategic plans.
items.content: Anglesey Mining plc has confirmed that its CEO, Andrew Fulton, will participate in the Proactive One2One Investor Forum during London Mining Week. The presentation is scheduled for December 1, 2026, at the Chesterfield Mayfair Hotel in London. During the event, the company intends to outline the details of its recently announced £1.25 million placing, the planned use of those funds, and its operational roadmap for 2027 and beyond. Additionally, management will be attending other industry events, including the CMA Annual Conference and the Mines and Money @ Resourcing Tomorrow conference, as part of an effort to increase investor engagement and corporate visibility.

items.title: GCM Resources Discloses CEO's Indirect Shareholding Interest
items.summary: GCM Resources announced that its CEO, Datuk Michael Tang, holds an indirect interest in 11.50% of the company's issued share capital through Mettiz Capital Limited.
items.content: On 26 November 2026, GCM Resources plc disclosed that its CEO, Datuk Michael Tang, is indirectly interested in 43,328,253 ordinary shares of the company, representing 11.50% of its issued share capital. This interest is held via Mettiz Capital Limited, which became the sole shareholder of Polo Investments Limited on 20 August 2021. The company clarified that the change in ownership involved no consideration and was executed outside a trading venue. This disclosure provides transparency regarding the significant shareholding position of the company's leadership.

items.title: Great Western Mining Identifies New Adit at Defender Tungsten Project
items.summary: Great Western Mining Corporation PLC has discovered a new historical adit, named Starry Night, at its Defender Tungsten Project in Nevada, potentially extending the project's tungsten strike length to 2.4 kilometers.
items.content: Great Western Mining Corporation PLC announced the discovery of a new adit, designated the Starry Night Mine, located approximately 400 meters west of the historical Widowmaker Mine at its Defender Tungsten Project in Mineral County, Nevada. Initial reconnaissance and shortwave ultraviolet inspection revealed about 50 meters of scheelite-bearing garnet skarn mineralization. This discovery is significant as it potentially extends the project's tungsten strike length from approximately 2 kilometers to 2.4 kilometers along a 3-kilometer mineralized trend. The company plans to prioritize channel sampling at the new site in upcoming fieldwork. Additionally, the company noted that assay results from a 2,590-meter reverse circulation drilling program completed in September 2026 are currently delayed due to regional laboratory capacity constraints.

items.title: Forgent plc Confirms Gold and Copper Mineralization at Peak Hill Project
items.summary: Forgent plc announced that Phase II drilling at its Peak Hill Gold-Copper Project in Western Australia has confirmed the presence of both gold and copper mineralization.
items.content: Forgent plc reported that Phase II drilling, completed in September 2026 at the central Curley's area, has successfully intersected gold and copper mineralization at its 99%-owned Peak Hill Gold-Copper Project. New assay results from drill hole CAC008 returned 9 meters at 0.45% copper from 43 meters, including a 5-meter interval at 0.60% copper from 46 meters. These findings follow previously announced gold results from the same project, which included 7 meters at 2.32g/t gold from 26 meters in drill hole CAC010. The company stated that these shallow-depth intersections have provided a clear focus for its ongoing exploration efforts.

items.title: Foresight Group Holdings Limited Announces Share Buyback Transactions and Pause of Programme
items.summary: Foresight Group Holdings Limited reported the purchase of 41,265 ordinary shares under its ongoing buyback programme and announced a temporary pause in further repurchases.
items.content: Foresight Group Holdings Limited announced that it purchased 41,265 ordinary shares between November 20 and November 26, 2026, through Berenberg. The shares were acquired under the company's £50 million share buyback programme, which was originally announced on April 10, 2025. Following these transactions, the company has paused further purchases under the programme, with plans to notify the market of any future resumption via an RNS announcement. To date, a total of 7,969,997 ordinary shares have been repurchased for an aggregate consideration of £34,366,415.37. The purchased shares will be held in treasury and carry no voting rights.

items.title: ECR Minerals Nears Intersection of Maddens Reef
items.summary: ECR Minerals reports that it is approximately ten metres away from intersecting the Maddens Reef at the Maddens Flat group of mines in Queensland.
items.content: ECR Minerals is nearing the intersection of the Maddens Reef at the Maddens Flat group of mines in Queensland, with only about ten metres of decline development remaining. The company, which holds a 50% interest in the Maddens Flat Group of Mines, has identified targeted stopes between the 345-metre and 358-metre levels. These stopes have the potential to generate approximately 2,500 ounces of gold on a 100% project basis, gross to the Maddens joint venture.

items.title: Trinity Biotech plc Subject to Volatility Trading Halt
items.summary: Trinity Biotech plc experienced a volatility-related trading pause on the Nasdaq exchange.
items.content: On November 26, 2026, Trinity Biotech plc (TRIB) was subject to a volatility trading halt on the Nasdaq exchange. The pause was triggered by market volatility, a standard procedural mechanism for managing rapid price fluctuations.

items.title: Aterian Signs Due Diligence and Exclusivity Agreement for Morocco Copper Projects
items.summary: Aterian plc has entered into a due diligence and exclusivity agreement with an international mining group concerning its Azrar and Tata copper projects in Morocco.
items.content: Aterian plc has signed a due diligence and exclusivity agreement with an international mining group regarding its Azrar and Tata copper projects in Morocco. The projects are 85% owned by Aterian and 15% by Lithosquare, and have been advanced under a joint venture between the two companies. Under the terms of the agreement, the counterparty will pay Aterian a due diligence fee of US$100,000. The deal provides for a 90-day exclusivity period to allow the counterparty to conduct due diligence and for the parties to discuss a potential transaction. Aterian stated it will provide further updates upon the conclusion of negotiations or the expiry of the exclusivity period.

items.title: Nanoco Publishes Annual Report and Accounts for FY2026
items.summary: Nanoco Group plc has released its Annual Report and Accounts for the financial year ended 31 July 2026.
items.content: Nanoco Group plc published its Annual Report and Accounts for the financial year ended 31 July 2026 on 25 November 2026. The document has been made available to shareholders on the company's website and submitted to the National Storage Mechanism for public viewing. The report provides comprehensive financial disclosures for the fiscal year, including revenue, profit or loss, and cash and debt positions, alongside management commentary regarding the company's performance and strategic direction.

items.title: Arbuthnot Banking Group to End Aquis Trading, Keep AIM Listing
items.summary: Arbuthnot Banking Group has applied to cancel the trading of its ordinary and non-voting shares on the Aquis Growth Market, effective December 30, 2026, while maintaining its listing on the AIM market.
items.content: Arbuthnot Banking Group has formally requested the cancellation of the admission to trading of its ordinary shares and non-voting shares on the Apex segment of the Aquis Growth Market. The cancellation is scheduled to take effect on December 30, 2026. The company will continue to maintain its primary listing on the AIM market of the London Stock Exchange. This decision reflects a strategic move to consolidate its trading venues.

items.title: GoldStone Resources Announces AGM Results and Gold Loan Restructuring
items.summary: GoldStone Resources Limited successfully passed all resolutions at its Annual General Meeting and secured an extension to its gold loan standstill agreement with Asian Investment Management Services Limited.
items.content: At its Annual General Meeting held on November 25, 2026, GoldStone Resources Limited shareholders approved all resolutions, including those facilitating an interest conversion. The company will convert 351.40 troy ounces of accrued interest on its gold loan into 109,215,120 new shares at 1p each, valued at approximately £1.09 million. Additionally, the company reached an agreement with Asian Investment Management Services Limited (AIMSL) to extend the maturity date of its gold loan from June 30, 2027, to June 30, 2028. Following the conversion, AIMSL's stake in the company will increase to approximately 28.3%. The new shares are expected to be admitted for trading around November 27, 2026.

items.summary: Iconic Labs plc has scheduled its Annual General Meeting for December 22, 2026, at its nominated offices in London.
items.content: Iconic Labs plc announced that its Annual General Meeting (AGM) will take place on Tuesday, December 22, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. The meeting will be held at the offices of AMBA Company Secretarial Services Ltd in London. The company has confirmed that the Notice of AGM will be made available on its website and that proxy forms have been distributed to shareholders. This announcement is a standard procedural update regarding the company's corporate governance.

items.title: Emmerson PLC Restores Trading on AIM
items.summary: Emmerson PLC announced the restoration of trading for its ordinary shares on the AIM market following the closure of a Capital Access Window.
items.content: Trading in Emmerson PLC's ordinary shares was temporarily suspended to facilitate a Capital Access Window. Following the closure of this window, the company confirmed that trading on the AIM market was restored effective 26 November 2026 at 07:30 GMT. No additional financial metrics were disclosed in the announcement regarding the restoration of trading.

items.title: Emmerson PLC Announces Results of Annual General Meeting and Proceeds with Fundraising
items.summary: Emmerson PLC confirmed that all resolutions were passed at its Annual General Meeting, allowing the company to proceed with a previously announced £1.8 million fundraising.
items.content: At the Annual General Meeting held on 26 November 2026, shareholders approved all proposed resolutions. This approval enables the company to move forward with its fundraising initiative, which aims to raise approximately £1.8 million through a placing, subscription, and retail offer at 0.975 pence per share. Applications have been submitted for the admission of the new shares to trading on AIM, with admission expected on or around 1 December 2026.

items.title: Schroder European Real Estate Investment Trust plc Announces Date for Full Year Results
items.summary: The company has scheduled the release of its full-year financial results for the period ending 30 September 2026 for 4 December 2026.
items.content: Schroder European Real Estate Investment Trust plc will announce its full-year results for the 12-month period ending 30 September 2026 on Friday, 4 December 2026. In conjunction with the release, the company will host a live webcast presentation for analysts and investors at 09:00 GMT / 11:00 SAST. This notice serves as a procedural update regarding the upcoming financial reporting schedule.

items.title: Tooru plc Enters £500,000 Unsecured Funding Facility
items.summary: Tooru plc has secured a two-year unsecured funding facility of up to £500,000 from S-Ventures, with drawdowns subject to interest and warrant issuance.
items.content: Tooru plc has entered into a two-year unsecured funding facility with S-Ventures for a total of up to £500,000. The facility is expected to be drawn down in tranches of £100,000, with each drawdown accruing 5% annual interest. Both the principal and accrued interest are repayable on the second anniversary of each respective drawdown. Additionally, upon each drawdown, Tooru will issue two tranches of warrants: the first tranche based on the drawdown amount divided by the reference price multiplied by 1.5, and the second tranche based on the drawdown amount divided by the reference price multiplied by 1.78.

items.title: Trifast plc Announces Director-Related Share Purchase
items.summary: Trifast plc reported that Rockwood Strategic plc, an investment vehicle connected to company director Nicholas Mills, acquired 75,000 ordinary shares.
items.content: Trifast plc announced that Rockwood Strategic plc, an investment vehicle associated with company director Nicholas Mills, purchased 75,000 ordinary shares of the company. The shares were acquired at a price of 68.67 pence per share on 25 November 2026. This notification was made in accordance with the UK Market Abuse Regulation requirements regarding persons discharging managerial responsibilities and their closely associated persons.

items.title: KCR Residential REIT plc Announces AGM Voting Results
items.summary: KCR Residential REIT plc reported that only the first three resolutions were passed at its annual general meeting, while resolutions regarding share allotment and pre-emption rights were defeated.
items.content: At its annual general meeting, KCR Residential REIT plc announced that shareholders passed Resolutions 1, 2, and 3, which covered the receipt of accounts, the reappointment of the auditor, and the reappointment of a director. However, Resolutions 4 and 5, which sought to authorize the directors to allot ordinary shares and disapply pre-emption rights, were defeated by a significant margin. Specifically, Resolution 4 received only 1.02% of votes in favor, and Resolution 5 received 0.68% in favor. The failure of these resolutions limits the board's current authority to issue new shares and constrains the company's capacity for future equity raising. The results were based on a total of 29,513,675 shares voted, representing 70.83% of the company's 41,669,631 ordinary shares in issue.

items.title: SRT Marine Systems Announces Retail Offer to Raise £0.5 Million
items.summary: SRT Marine Systems plc has launched a retail offer to raise up to £0.5 million through the issuance of new ordinary shares to fund a new UxV development program.
items.content: SRT Marine Systems plc announced a retail offer to raise up to £0.5 million before expenses by issuing up to 769,230 new ordinary shares at an issue price of 65.0p per share. This price represents a discount of approximately 5.11% to the closing mid-market price of 68.5p on November 25, 2026. The retail offer is separate from a concurrent placing and is intended to fund approximately £10.0 million of customer demand-led capital expenditure for a new UxV development program, as well as to strengthen the company's balance sheet and working capital. The offer is conditional on shareholder approval at a General Meeting scheduled for December 16, with admission of the new shares expected on December 17, 2026.

items.title: Castlebar Capital LLP Discloses Long Position in Tribal Group plc
items.summary: Castlebar Capital LLP has reported an opening long position in Tribal Group plc, representing 3.26% of the company's relevant securities.
items.content: As of November 25, 2026, Castlebar Capital LLP disclosed an opening long position in Tribal Group plc. The position consists of 7,005,114 cash-settled derivatives, which accounts for 3.26% of the company's relevant securities. This includes a contract for difference (CFD) increase of 3,610,498 reference shares at a price of 101.50 GBp per share. No other arrangements, such as stock-settled derivatives or subscription rights, were reported in the disclosure.

items.title: Petra Diamonds Announces Resignation of CEO Vivek Gadodia
items.summary: Petra Diamonds Limited has announced that Chief Executive Officer Vivek Gadodia has resigned from his position and as a director of the company, effective immediately.
items.content: Petra Diamonds Limited announced on November 25, 2026, that Vivek Gadodia has resigned as Chief Executive Officer and as a director of the company, effective immediately. The Board and Gadodia have agreed that he will focus exclusively on progressing the company's ongoing Strategic Review Process during his notice period. The company acknowledged Gadodia's role in the business restructuring carried out in 2024 and 2025, as well as his contributions to the previous year's refinancing and rights issue. This leadership change occurs amidst ongoing challenges faced by the company and the broader diamond market.

items.title: Time To ACT plc Appoints Cavendish Capital Markets as Corporate Adviser and Broker
items.summary: Time To ACT plc has appointed Cavendish Capital Markets Limited to serve as its Corporate Adviser and Broker, effective immediately.
items.content: Time To ACT plc, an Aquis-listed specialist engineering group, has announced the appointment of Cavendish Capital Markets Limited as its Corporate Adviser and Broker. The appointment is effective immediately and is intended to formalize the company's external advisory and broking support. Management expects this partnership to potentially enhance market liquidity, improve investor engagement, and strengthen the company's readiness for future corporate actions or capital raises. The company operates through its primary businesses, Diffusion Alloys and MTE, alongside its earlier-stage development activity, GreenSpur.

items.title: Yü Group Completes Modernization and Maintenance Project for Dyno Nobel
items.summary: Yü Group has successfully completed a complex 45-day infrastructure upgrade and maintenance project at Dyno Nobel's facility in Moranbah, Queensland.
items.content: Yü Group delivered an extensive modernization and maintenance project for Dyno Nobel's flagship facility, involving upgrades to low and medium-voltage ABB switchgear. The project, which spanned 45 days and required approximately 185,326 work hours, was completed on schedule and within budget with zero safety incidents. The work included retrofitting new relays and implementing digital solutions for real-time condition monitoring to enhance plant safety and proactive maintenance. Management noted that the project future-proofs the site's electrical infrastructure and supports Dyno Nobel's operational reliability.

items.title: Great Southern Copper Appoints Zeus Capital as Joint Corporate Broker
items.summary: Great Southern Copper plc has appointed Zeus Capital Limited as its Joint Corporate Broker, effective immediately, to work alongside its existing broker, SI Capital.
items.content: Great Southern Copper plc has appointed Zeus Capital Limited as Joint Corporate Broker to act alongside its existing broker, SI Capital Limited. The company stated that the appointment is intended to leverage Zeus Capital's experience in the natural resources sector and its institutional investor relationships to broaden the company's shareholder base. This move coincides with the commencement of diamond drilling at the Artemisa Copper-Molybdenum prospect and supports the company's next phase of growth. Management expressed that the new partnership will be valuable as the company advances exploration at its flagship Especularita project in Chile.

items.title: Crimson Tide plc Reports First Half Fiscal 2027 Financial Results
items.summary: Crimson Tide plc reported a loss before tax for the first half of fiscal 2027, citing the conclusion of a major retail contract as a primary factor in revenue reduction.
items.content: Crimson Tide plc announced its financial results for the first half of fiscal 2027, reporting a loss before tax of GBP 0.254 million compared to a profit of GBP 0.322 million in the same period last year. Total comprehensive loss for the period was GBP 0.276 million, or GBP 4.02 per share. Revenue for the half-year fell to GBP 2.375 million from GBP 2.950 million, with recurring revenue totaling GBP 2.364 million. The company attributed the year-on-year revenue decline primarily to the conclusion of a large retail contract on March 31, 2026. Despite these results, the company stated that it expects the full-year outcome for 2027 to remain in line with market expectations.

items.title: Harena Rare Earths Raises £1.25 Million and Initiates Strategic Review
items.summary: Harena Rare Earths has successfully raised £1.25 million in new funding and announced the commencement of a strategic review.
items.content: Harena Rare Earths has secured £1.25 million in capital to support its ongoing operations and development. Alongside the fundraising, the company has initiated a strategic review to evaluate its current assets and future direction. The additional capital and the review process are intended to strengthen the company's financial position and optimize its strategic focus on its rare earth and uranium exploration projects. Further details regarding the scope of the strategic review and the allocation of the raised funds were not immediately disclosed.

items.title: FDM Group Announces Retirement of Chief Commercial Officer Andy Brown
items.summary: FDM Group (Holdings) Plc announced that Chief Commercial Officer Andy Brown intends to retire after more than 30 years with the company.
items.content: FDM Group (Holdings) Plc has announced that Andy Brown, the company's Chief Commercial Officer, has notified the Board of his intention to retire and step down from his position. Brown has been with the company for over 30 years and is expected to remain in his role until November 24, 2027, in accordance with his contractual notice period. The Board is currently progressing succession plans for the leadership of the company's Sales and Commercial functions. CEO Rod Flavell acknowledged Brown's significant contribution to the company's growth and development over his long tenure.

items.title: Harena Rare Earths Adds £100,000 Retail Offering to Fundraising
items.summary: Harena Rare Earths has expanded its recent capital raise by adding a £100,000 retail offering to its existing £1.25 million fundraising round.
items.content: Harena Rare Earths has supplemented its previously announced £1.25 million fundraising by adding a £100,000 retail offering. This move allows for broader participation in the company's capital raise, bringing the total amount raised to £1.35 million. The additional funds are expected to support the company's exploration and development activities, including its primary interest in the Ampasindava Ionic Clay Rare Earth Project. This retail component follows the company's broader efforts to secure funding while undergoing a strategic review.

items.title: Iomart Group plc Interim Results for the Six Months Ended 30 September 2026
items.summary: Iomart reported a decline in revenue and adjusted EBITDA for the first half of fiscal year 2027, alongside a strategic reorganization into four business units and the renewal of its revolving credit facility.
items.content: For the six months ended 30 September 2026, Iomart Group plc reported an 11% decline in revenue to £69.0m, with adjusted EBITDA falling to £9.0m from £12.9m in the prior period. The company recorded an adjusted loss before tax of £6.4m, while net debt increased to £117.2m. During the period, the group successfully renewed its £115m revolving credit facility, extending the maturity date to 30 June 2028. Operationally, the company has reorganized into four distinct business units following the separation of its data centre operations into Iomart Data Centre Services Limited. Management also noted a continued focus on cost optimization, including the consolidation of facilities and systems, and reported growth in order bookings for its cloud services, excluding Microsoft products transferred to Atech.

items.title: Craneware Publishes AGM Statement Confirming FY27 Trading Performance
items.summary: Craneware plc has released its Annual General Meeting statement, confirming that trading for the 2027 fiscal year is proceeding in line with current guidance.
items.content: In its AGM statement published on November 27, 2026, Craneware confirmed that trading for FY27 has started positively and remains consistent with its existing guidance. The company reported that it has successfully concluded a comprehensive review of its cost base and has implemented necessary actions, with management expressing confidence in exiting the fiscal year in line with EBITDA guidance. Furthermore, the company expects to return to its historical 30% EBITDA margin by FY28. Regarding its recent cyber security incident, the company noted that it continues to mitigate the impact, with no discernible effect on customer demand for its solutions.

items.title: Ajax Resources Extends Option and Improves Terms for Nueva Celti Copper Project Acquisition
items.summary: Ajax Resources PLC has extended its option to acquire Western Metallica, S.L. to December 18, 2026, while revising the deal terms to a cash-only consideration.
items.content: Ajax Resources PLC has extended the exclusivity and option exercise periods for its potential acquisition of Western Metallica, S.L. until December 18, 2026. Under the revised terms, the total cash consideration for the acquisition of the Nueva Celti Copper Project in Spain has been set at US$145,000, which includes a previously paid US$10,000 deposit. The equity component of the original deal has been removed. This improved cash offer is conditional upon Western Metallica finalizing a separate business combination with a third party; if this condition is not met, Ajax retains the right to exercise the option under the original terms. The acquisition remains subject to the negotiation and execution of definitive documentation.

items.title: Robert Walters Releases Salary Survey 2027 for Vietnam
items.summary: Robert Walters published its annual Salary Survey 2027, highlighting trends in hiring, salary benchmarks, and talent retention strategies within the Vietnamese market.
items.content: The Robert Walters Salary Survey 2027 provides an analysis of employer and professional attitudes in Vietnam, noting that 96% of employers plan salary increases for 2027. The report indicates that while the job market remains resilient due to strong GDP growth and foreign direct investment, organizations are shifting focus toward targeted pay rises for roles that drive revenue and digital transformation. The survey suggests that businesses should prioritize benchmarking salaries, investing in critical skills like AI, and providing clear career progression paths to retain top talent. Market salary adjustments are expected to remain between 5% and 10% in 2027, with nearly half of employers planning headcount growth of 5% or more.

items.title: Clarksons' New Facilities at Port of Lowestoft Highlighted in Infrastructure Investment
items.summary: Clarksons' new facilities at the Port of Lowestoft were highlighted as part of a collective investment in energy and supply chain infrastructure to support offshore wind projects.
items.content: The Chief Commercial Officer of Associated British Ports (ABP) noted that Clarksons' new facilities at the Port of Lowestoft are part of a broader effort to strengthen the supply chain for offshore wind energy. This development is linked to a £35 million investment in the Lowestoft Eastern Energy Facility (LEEF) and RWE's long-term commitment to the port. The initiative aims to turn offshore wind ambitions into local jobs and economic opportunities. The statement underscores the collaborative nature of the infrastructure investment involving ABP, RWE, and Clarksons.

items.title: Rockfire Resources Announces Maiden Germanium Resource at Molaoi Deposit
items.summary: Rockfire Resources has declared a maiden JORC Inferred resource of 190.4 tonnes of contained germanium at its 100%-owned Molaoi zinc deposit in Greece.
items.content: Rockfire Resources plc has announced a maiden JORC Inferred resource of 190.4 tonnes of contained germanium at its 100%-owned Molaoi zinc deposit in Greece. Management highlighted the project's growing importance to the European critical mineral supply chain as work continues to advance the site. The company noted that germanium is recognized as a critical mineral in jurisdictions including the United States. This development marks a significant milestone in the company's ongoing efforts to delineate resources at its exploration projects.

items.title: Shearwater Group plc Announces Results of 2026 Annual General Meeting
items.summary: Shearwater Group plc held its 2026 Annual General Meeting on November 26, 2026, where shareholders approved all proposed resolutions by poll.
items.content: Shearwater Group plc announced that all resolutions presented to shareholders at its 2026 Annual General Meeting (AGM), held on November 26, 2026, were successfully passed by way of poll. The company confirmed that the full voting results from the meeting would be made available on its investor relations website. No additional financial metrics, board changes, or dividend decisions were disclosed in connection with the meeting results.

items.title: Eurocell Launches GBP 5 Million Share Buyback Program
items.summary: Eurocell plc has initiated a share buyback program with a maximum value of GBP 5 million, effective from November 26, 2026.
items.content: Eurocell plc announced the launch of a share buyback program valued at up to GBP 5 million. The program commenced on November 26, 2026, and is scheduled to run until no later than the company's 2027 annual general meeting. Peel Hunt LLP has been appointed to manage the share repurchases independently, with the authority to make trading decisions regarding the timing of acquisitions. All ordinary shares repurchased under this program will be cancelled by the company.

items.title: NewRiver REIT Announces Appointment of Sarah Williams as Chair of the Audit Committee
items.summary: NewRiver REIT plc has appointed independent Non-Executive Director Sarah Williams as the new Chair of the Audit Committee, effective 1 December 2026.
items.content: NewRiver REIT plc announced that Sarah Williams, an independent Non-Executive Director, will assume the role of Chair of the Audit Committee starting 1 December 2026. The appointment was disclosed in accordance with UK Listing Rule 6.4.6R. This governance change is intended to enhance the company's audit oversight and board structure. The company confirmed that the appointment does not involve any changes to financial metrics or guidance.

items.title: Afentra plc Appoints Antonio Fernandes as Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: Afentra plc has appointed Antonio Fernandes, the company's current Deputy CFO, as its new Chief Financial Officer and Executive Director, effective December 1, 2026.
items.content: Afentra plc announced the appointment of Antonio Fernandes as Chief Financial Officer and Executive Director, effective December 1, 2026. Fernandes, who has been with the company since its inception and currently serves as Deputy CFO, succeeds Anastasia Deulina. Deulina will step down from the Board on November 30, 2026, but will remain with the company until February 2027 to facilitate an orderly transition. Fernandes brings 15 years of upstream oil and gas experience to the role, including a decade at Tullow Oil, and has played a key role in the company's acquisitions and financing activities in Angola.

items.title: Kakao Entertainment's Melon Releases First Global-K Chart Data Report
items.summary: Kakao Entertainment's music streaming platform, Melon, published its inaugural data report for the Global-K Chart, highlighting K-pop artist performance trends across Korea, China, and Japan.
items.content: On November 27, 2026, Kakao Entertainment's Melon platform released the first data report for the Global-K Chart, a ranking system launched in June in collaboration with Tencent Music and Line Music. The report analyzes 143 days of streaming data and fan engagement metrics collected between May 11 and September 30, 2026. The findings provide insights into regional K-pop consumption patterns and artist popularity across the three participating platforms. This report marks the first comprehensive analysis of the cross-platform chart's performance since its inception.

items.title: SCOR and Japan Post Insurance Approve Reinsurance Vehicle Deal
items.summary: The boards of SCOR and Japan Post Insurance have approved a transaction involving the transfer of legacy policy risks.
items.content: SCOR and Japan Post Insurance have officially cleared a reinsurance agreement. Under the terms of the deal, Japan Post Insurance will cede 3 trillion yen of legacy policy risks to the French reinsurer. The transaction represents a significant transfer of risk between the two entities. The boards of both companies have provided their formal approval for the reinsurance vehicle.

items.title: SAP Confirms No Customer Data Breach Following Security Incident

items.content: Following a security incident, SAP SE conducted an investigation to determine if customer information had been accessed or compromised. The company has officially stated that there are no signs of a data breach affecting its customers. This update provides clarity on the scope and impact of the security event, confirming the integrity of customer data.

items.title: Deutsche Telekom and Rheinmetall Reportedly Explore Joint Surveillance Platform Offering
items.summary: Deutsche Telekom and Rheinmetall are reportedly considering a potential partnership to jointly market a surveillance platform for civilian applications.
items.content: According to a report by Wirtschaftswoche, Deutsche Telekom and Rheinmetall are exploring a collaborative effort to offer a surveillance platform for civilian use. The potential partnership involves the joint marketing of technology currently associated with the defense contractor. While the report highlights the companies' interest in this venture, the initiative remains in the discussion phase. Market observers have noted the development as a secondary point of interest alongside other corporate updates.

items.title: Stellantis in Advanced Negotiations with Struggling Supplier
items.summary: Stellantis is reportedly in advanced negotiations regarding the future of its Melfi, Sulmona, and Rivalta plants in connection with a struggling supplier.
items.content: Stellantis is engaged in advanced negotiations involving its production facilities in Melfi, Sulmona, and Rivalta. The discussions are linked to a supplier currently facing financial difficulties. The supplier is expected to present an industrial plan to the relevant ministry on December 1, 2026.

items.title: Transamerica Life Bermuda Expands Operations in Dubai International Financial Centre
items.summary: Transamerica Life Bermuda, a subsidiary of Aegon Ltd., has announced a further expansion of its business operations within the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC).
items.content: Transamerica Life Bermuda, a provider of life insurance services for high-net-worth individuals and a subsidiary of Aegon Ltd., has officially expanded its presence in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). The DIFC serves as a major financial hub for the Middle East, Africa, and South Asia (MEASA) region. This latest development builds upon the company's initial entry into the DIFC in 2025. The expansion is intended to strengthen the firm's service capabilities and market reach within the region.

items.title: Capgemini Announces Employee Share Ownership Plan Results
items.summary: Capgemini has successfully concluded its latest employee share ownership plan, attracting over 37,000 subscribers across 37 countries.
items.content: Capgemini reported that more than 37,000 employees across 37 countries participated in its latest employee share ownership plan. The company issued three million new shares at a price of €106.89 per share, resulting in a capital increase of €321 million scheduled for December 17, 2026. To offset the dilution, the Group has repurchased an equivalent number of shares for cancellation. Management expects employee ownership to remain at approximately 8% of the company's total capital by the end of the year.

items.title: Graubündner Kantonalbank to Increase State Guarantee Compensation
items.summary: The government of the Canton of Graubünden has reviewed a report recommending that Graubündner Kantonalbank (GKB) increase its compensation for the state guarantee provided by the canton.
items.content: The government of the Canton of Graubünden has acknowledged a report from the Department of Finance and Municipalities (DFG) regarding the future strategic direction of Graubündner Kantonalbank (GKB). The report, commissioned in 2024, recommends that the bank maintain its current purpose and legal form while further developing its public corporate governance. A key finding is the proposal that GKB should pay higher compensation to the canton for the state guarantee it receives. This development reflects the government's ongoing assessment of the bank's relationship with the state.

This partnership represents a strategic step in the company's broader research and development initiatives. Further details regarding the specific scope of the collaboration were noted in the context of the company's ongoing preparations for its clinical study programs.

items.content: Proximar Seafood announced that it has secured extensions for two Yen-denominated loans. This financial development provides the company with additional flexibility as it continues its land-based salmon farming operations in Japan. The company utilizes Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS) technology to produce fresh Atlantic salmon at its facility near Mount Fuji.

items.summary: Cyviz AS has been selected to deliver an Envisioning Theater for the expansion of Microsoft's Innovation Hub in Zurich, Switzerland.
items.content: Cyviz AS announced its selection to provide an Envisioning Theater for the expansion of Microsoft's Innovation Hub in Zurich. The project, which utilizes the proprietary Cyviz platform to support customer-facing environments, is currently expected to reach completion by June 2028. According to the company, this engagement highlights Microsoft's ongoing investment in environments powered by Cyviz technology. The announcement was formally disseminated on November 26, 2026.

items.title: NordAmps to Participate in Ny Teknik's 33 List and Redeye Technology Day
items.summary: NordAmps AB (publ) has been selected to participate in the prestigious Ny Teknik 33 List and will present at the upcoming Redeye Technology Day.
items.content: NordAmps AB (publ) has announced its participation in two significant industry events: the Ny Teknik 33 List and the Redeye Technology Day. The Ny Teknik 33 List recognizes innovative Swedish technology companies, while the Redeye Technology Day serves as a platform for companies to engage with investors and industry stakeholders. These appearances highlight the company's ongoing visibility and recognition within the deep-tech and semiconductor sectors. The events provide an opportunity for NordAmps to showcase its proprietary vertical nanowire transistor technology and its strategic position in the wireless communication and sensing markets.

items.title: Norse Atlantic Suspends All Flights and Warns of Potential Bankruptcy
items.summary: Norse Atlantic ASA has suspended all flight operations and announced its intention to file for bankruptcy if it cannot secure urgent short-term financing.
items.content: On November 26, 2026, Norse Atlantic ASA suspended all scheduled flights as the company faces a critical financial situation. The board of directors stated that it intends to file for bankruptcy if it fails to secure necessary short-term funding. The airline is currently engaged in discussions with investors regarding a potential takeover that would include financial support, though no assurance of a viable solution has been provided. The crisis follows significant operational challenges, including rising fuel costs and the termination of a major aircraft-leasing deal, which have severely impacted the company's liquidity.

items.title: Biovica Receives Validation from Genentech Ahead of SABCS
items.summary: Biovica announced a validation from Genentech regarding its biomarker technology in anticipation of the San Antonio Breast Cancer Symposium (SABCS).
items.content: Biovica has received validation from Genentech for its biomarker assay technology ahead of the upcoming San Antonio Breast Cancer Symposium (SABCS). This development underscores the clinical relevance and industry interest in the company's DiviTum TKa blood test, which is designed to monitor the efficacy of cancer therapies. The validation represents a significant milestone for Biovica as it prepares to showcase its technology at the symposium. The company continues to focus on the commercialization and clinical adoption of its blood-based biomarker assays for metastatic breast cancer.

items.title: Aeffe Faces Legal Challenge Over Collective Layoffs
items.summary: Approximately 70 former employees have initiated legal action against Aeffe to contest collective layoffs, with the first court hearing set for December 16, 2026.
items.content: Aeffe is facing a legal challenge from about 70 former employees who are contesting collective layoffs. The first court hearing for this dispute is scheduled for December 16, 2026. This development occurs amidst the company's broader crisis management process, which includes a December 9, 2026, deadline to file a final application for a crisis regulation tool. The group is also exploring a potential relaunch plan involving Oxy Capital and the Chinese partner Septwolves, which reportedly includes 150 million euros in planned investments.

items.title: Maximum Entertainment AB Receives Favorable Board Opinion on Takeover Offer
items.summary: The board of directors of Maximum Entertainment AB has issued a favorable opinion on the takeover offer initiated by NAF, recommending that shareholders tender their shares.
items.content: On November 26, 2026, it was reported that the board of directors of Maximum Entertainment AB has formally recommended that shareholders accept the takeover offer initiated by NAF. NAF, which currently holds approximately 82.89% of the company's capital and voting rights, is seeking to acquire the remaining shares, excluding those already held or specifically excluded. The offer is being conducted through a simplified procedure, and the company has confirmed that it does not intend to implement a mandatory squeeze-out procedure for minority shareholders following the offer. Additionally, the board noted that it had previously decided on April 22, 2026, not to propose a dividend for the 2025 financial year.

items.title: Bigben Interactive Postpones 2026/2027 Half-Year Results
items.summary: Bigben Interactive has rescheduled the publication of its 2026/2027 half-year financial results to December 16, 2026, following additional audit requirements.
items.content: Bigben Interactive announced the postponement of its 2026/2027 half-year financial results, which were originally scheduled for release on November 30, 2026. The publication has been rescheduled for December 16, 2026, after market close. The delay is attributed to the need for additional audit procedures necessitated by the company's ongoing accelerated safeguard procedure (procédure de sauvegarde accélérée).

items.title: Preservium Property Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Preservium Property AB reported revenue of 18.5 million SEK for the third quarter of 2026, compared to 19.2 million SEK in the same period last year, and noted a decrease in its management result.
items.content: Preservium Property AB released its financial results for the third quarter of 2026. The company reported revenues of 18.5 million SEK, a decrease from the 19.2 million SEK reported in the corresponding quarter of the previous year. Additionally, the company reported a decline in its management result for the period. These figures reflect the company's ongoing performance in managing its portfolio of public archive properties.

items.title: First Patient Dosed in Gabather's Phase II TOTEMS Study of GT-002
items.summary: Gabather AB has initiated the patient-dosing phase of its Phase II TOTEMS study, evaluating the drug candidate GT-002 for the treatment of schizophrenia spectrum conditions.
items.content: Gabather AB announced that the first patient has been dosed in the Phase II TOTEMS study, marking the transition from healthy volunteer testing to patient evaluation for its drug candidate GT-002. The study, which is being conducted at the Center for Neuropsychiatric Schizophrenia Research (CNSR) at Copenhagen University Hospital, is a randomized, double-blind, cross-over trial involving 20 patients and 30 healthy volunteers. GT-002 is a partial positive allosteric modulator of the GABAA receptor designed to address cognitive impairment in schizophrenia, a condition for which no approved medicine currently exists. The study is supported by funding from Innovation Fund Denmark, and the company continues to recruit additional patients for the trial.

items.title: Micropos Medical Receives Order from Johns Hopkins Medicine
items.summary: Micropos Medical AB has secured an order for its Raypilot system from Johns Hopkins Medicine in the United States.
items.content: Micropos Medical AB has received an order for its Raypilot system from the U.S.-based healthcare provider Johns Hopkins Medicine. The Raypilot system is designed to provide real-time tumor tracking to enhance the precision and efficiency of radiotherapy for cancer treatment. This order represents a commercial development for the company's flagship technology within the U.S. market.

items.title: Pet Service Holding Reschedules Q3 2026 Revenue and Business Update
items.summary: Pet Service Holding NV has moved the release date for its Q3 2026 revenue and business update from November 16, 2026, to December 2, 2026.
items.content: Pet Service Holding NV announced that it has rescheduled the publication of its Q3 2026 revenue and business update to December 2, 2026, after market close. The update was originally slated for release on November 16, 2026. The company stated that this adjustment to its financial calendar is intended to support the implementation of quarterly financial reporting, a process introduced by the firm in 2026.

items.title: W5 Solutions Appoints Mathias Sandh as CFO
items.summary: W5 Solutions has announced the appointment of Mathias Sandh as the company's new Chief Financial Officer.
items.content: W5 Solutions has officially appointed Mathias Sandh to the position of Chief Financial Officer (CFO). This executive change was reported on November 26, 2026. The appointment represents a key leadership update for the Swedish defense technology company as it continues its operations in the integration, training, and simulation sectors.

items.content: ED Invest S.A. has officially published its consolidated quarterly financial report for the third quarter of 2026, identified as QSr 3/2026. The report provides updated financial information regarding the company's performance and operations. This disclosure is part of the company's routine periodic reporting obligations as a publicly traded entity.

items.title: Preservia Hyresfastigheter AB Announces Plan to Simplify Share and Capital Structure
items.summary: Preservia Hyresfastigheter AB has outlined a multi-step plan to transition to a single listed share class, the Series B common share, to improve the company's ability to raise capital and grow.
items.content: The board of Preservia Hyresfastigheter AB has announced a strategic plan to simplify the company's share and capital structure, aiming for a single listed share class of Series B common shares. Management identified the current multi-class structure as a barrier to raising new capital and achieving growth. The plan involves multiple steps, starting with an extraordinary general meeting on December 23, 2026, to prepare for the transition. Subsequent steps include a proposed redemption of Series A preference shares, where holders would receive Series B common shares equivalent to the accrued dividend as of September 30, 2026, with a potential cash alternative under consideration. The company's parent, Preservia Holding AB, also intends to convert its preference shares into Series B common shares as part of this restructuring.

items.title: BioInvent Appoints Catharina Johansson as New CFO
items.summary: BioInvent International AB has appointed Catharina Johansson as its new Chief Financial Officer, effective January 13, 2027.
items.content: BioInvent International AB announced the appointment of Catharina Johansson as its new Chief Financial Officer (CFO). Johansson will join the company's Executive Management Team on January 13, 2027, succeeding the current CFO, Stefan Ericsson. To facilitate a smooth transition, Johansson will begin her employment on December 9, 2026, working in parallel with Ericsson, who will remain with the company through the first quarter of 2027. Johansson brings experience from her previous roles as CFO at Edvince AB and Abliva AB, where she focused on financial management, investor communications, and capital raising within the life science sector. CEO Martin Welschof stated that her experience with publicly listed companies will be instrumental in advancing the company's clinical programs and strengthening its financial position.

items.title: Gigasun AB Holds Extraordinary General Meeting and Elects New Board Member
items.summary: Gigasun AB (publ) held an extraordinary general meeting on November 26, 2026, where shareholders approved the proposed agenda and elected Pontus Andersson as a new board member.
items.content: At the extraordinary general meeting held on November 26, 2026, Gigasun AB (publ) resolved in accordance with the proposed agenda. The meeting elected Pontus Andersson, CFO of Soltech Energy Sweden AB (publ), as a new member of the board of directors. Andersson replaces outgoing board member Stefan Ölander and will serve until the end of the next annual general meeting. Following this change, the board consists of Frederic Telander (chairman), Pontus Andersson, Ben Wu, Gang Bao, and Patrick de Muynck.

items.title: Customer Adopts Digital-First Production Model with Investment in Kornit Digital's Apollo
items.summary: A customer has implemented a digital-first production model through a dual investment in Kornit Digital's Apollo printing system.
items.content: A customer has transitioned to a digital-first production model, supported by a dual investment in Kornit Digital's Apollo industrial printing technology. This adoption highlights the continued integration of Kornit's high-speed, waterless digital printing systems into apparel and textile manufacturing workflows. The investment underscores the shift toward on-demand mass customization and the replacement of traditional analog screen printing processes with Kornit's digital solutions.

This development follows earlier market expectations regarding the company's expansion efforts in the region. The acquisition is part of the company's ongoing strategy to strengthen its service network. Further details regarding the transaction terms were not immediately disclosed in the initial report.

items.title: Toivo Group Launches New Housing Project in Verkkosaari
items.summary: Toivo Group Plc has initiated a new owner-occupied housing development project in the Verkkosaari district of Helsinki, valued at approximately EUR 13 million.
items.content: Toivo Group Plc has officially launched a new residential development project located in Verkkosaari, Helsinki. The project is focused on owner-occupied housing and carries an estimated value of approximately EUR 13 million. This development aligns with the company's ongoing strategy of managing the real estate value chain from land development to construction and ownership. The announcement confirms the company's continued activity in the Finnish residential property market.

items.title: Remedy Entertainment Plc: Managers' Transactions
items.summary: Remedy Entertainment Plc reported multiple managers' transactions involving key personnel, including Sami Järvi, Johannes Paloheimo, Santtu Kallionpää, Mikael Kasurinen, Mika Vehkala, and Jean-Charles Gaudechon.
items.content: Remedy Entertainment Plc disclosed a series of managers' transactions on November 26, 2026. The filings involve several members of the company's management team, specifically Sami Järvi, Johannes Paloheimo, Santtu Kallionpää, Mikael Kasurinen, Mika Vehkala, and Jean-Charles Gaudechon. These disclosures are standard regulatory filings regarding the financial activities of company insiders.

The acquisition aligns with the company's business model of engaging in property development and ownership. items.title: Atria CMD: Progress in Finnish Investment Program and Swedish Turnaround
items.summary: Atria provided an update during its Capital Markets Day, highlighting the ongoing progress of its investment program in Finland and the turnaround of its operations in Sweden.
items.content: During its Capital Markets Day (CMD), Atria reported that its strategic investment program in Finland is proceeding as planned. Additionally, the company noted that its efforts to improve profitability and performance in the Swedish market are showing positive results. These updates reflect the company's ongoing focus on operational efficiency and market-specific growth strategies.

items.title: Aiforia Selected for AI-Assisted Cancer Diagnostics by Public Hospital in Italy
items.summary: Aiforia Technologies Plc has signed a two-year agreement with a public university hospital in Italy to integrate its clinical AI solutions into routine pathology workflows.
items.content: Aiforia Technologies Plc announced a new two-year contract with a public university hospital in Italy to implement its cloud-based AI software for clinical diagnostics. The agreement covers the use of Aiforia's diagnostic suites for several cancer types, including breast, prostate, lung, and gastric cancers, as well as colonoscopy and lymph node analysis. By integrating these AI tools, the hospital aims to automate routine tasks for pathologists and enhance the efficiency of its pathology workflows. This partnership marks a further expansion of Aiforia's clinical AI solutions within the European healthcare sector.

items.title: SaverOne Signs Non-Binding Letter of Intent to Acquire Drew Therapeutics
items.summary: SaverOne 2014 Ltd. has announced a non-binding letter of intent to acquire Drew Therapeutics Corporation, a clinical-stage company focused on non-opioid pain treatments.
items.content: SaverOne 2014 Ltd. announced on November 25, 2026, that it has signed a non-binding letter of intent to acquire Drew Therapeutics Corporation, a subsidiary of AI Financial Corporation. Drew Therapeutics is a clinical development-stage company with three products in development targeting the non-opioid pain treatment market, including treatments for complex regional pain syndrome and peripheral artery disease. The acquisition, if completed, would expand SaverOne's portfolio beyond its current RF-based transportation safety solutions. The agreement is non-binding, and the transaction remains subject to due diligence, the execution of definitive agreements, and necessary regulatory or shareholder approvals. SaverOne noted that there is no assurance that the deal will be finalized.

items.title: TOP Ships Inc. Announces Increase in Pistiolis Family Shareholding via Series G Preferred Share Conversion
items.summary: TOP Ships Inc. issued 1,250,000 restricted common shares following the conversion of 2,000 Series G Perpetual Convertible Preferred Shares held by a trust for the Pistiolis family.
items.content: TOP Ships Inc. announced the issuance of 1,250,000 restricted common shares resulting from the conversion of 2,000 of its outstanding Series G Perpetual Convertible Preferred Shares. These preferred shares were beneficially owned by a trust established for the benefit of family members of Evangelos Pistiolis, the company's President and CEO. Following this transaction, the total number of outstanding common shares is 2,590,567, with Evangelos Pistiolis and the family trust collectively holding a 61.3% stake. The newly issued shares are subject to contractual restrictions that prohibit their sale or trading on any public market until March 15, 2028. The conversion was approved by a special committee of the company's independent Board members.

items.title: Kropz Announces Drawdown of ZAR 100 Million from First Loan Facility
items.summary: Kropz plc has drawn ZAR 100 million from its ZAR 370 million First Loan facility to provide immediate liquidity to its Elandsfontein project.
items.content: Kropz plc has executed a drawdown of ZAR 100 million from the ZAR 370 million First Loan facility, which was originally agreed upon with Ubunto-Botho Investments (Pty) Ltd on November 20, 2026. This initial drawdown is intended to provide immediate liquidity to the company's Elandsfontein project. Following this transaction, ZAR 270 million remains available for drawdown under the First Loan, while a separate ZAR 165 million Second Loan facility remains entirely undrawn. The company maintains a total available and committed financing capacity of ZAR 435 million across these two facilities to support its ongoing operations.

items.title: Eshbal Functional Food Inc. Reports Financial Results for the Three and Nine Months Ended September 30, 2026
items.summary: Eshbal Functional Food Inc. announced its financial results for the third quarter and nine-month period ending September 30, 2026, reporting revenue of US$12.07 million for the nine-month period.
items.content: Eshbal Functional Food Inc. reported revenue of US$12.07 million for the first nine months of 2026, representing a 19.5% increase compared to US$10.10 million in the same period of 2025. For the third quarter of 2026, the company recorded revenue of US$3.31 million, compared to US$3.38 million in the third quarter of 2025. The company reported a net loss of US$0.94 million for the third quarter and US$1.66 million for the nine-month period. Management noted that year-over-year comparisons are influenced by the company's evolution following its reverse takeover in April 2025, which impacted the cost structure and the scale of North American operations. Gross margin for the nine-month period was 21.5%, compared to 26.9% in the prior year, reflecting changes in product mix and lower sales in Israel.

items.title: Rise Nano Optics Ltd. Announces Commercial Partnership with Special Eye Care
items.summary: Rise Nano Optics Ltd. has entered into a commercial agreement with Special Eye Care to provide its SpectraGuard™ nanotechnology-based eyewear solutions to patients at two locations in Maryland.
items.content: Rise Nano Optics Ltd. announced a new commercial agreement with Special Eye Care, expanding the availability of its patented SpectraGuard™ lens technology to patients at two Maryland-based eye care locations. This partnership is part of the company's broader, capital-efficient commercialization strategy, which focuses on leveraging existing optical labs and professional eye care practices to accelerate market penetration. By utilizing these established networks, the company aims to scale its presence in the North American market without the significant capital requirements typically associated with building independent manufacturing and distribution infrastructure. The company continues to advance its goal of providing nanotechnology-based solutions for vision protection and eye health.

items.title: VVT Med Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: VVT Med Inc. announced its financial results for the third quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026, reporting significant year-over-year revenue growth.
items.content: VVT Med Inc. reported a 314% year-over-year increase in third-quarter revenue to $29,000, compared to $7,000 in the same period last year. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, revenue grew 33% to $116,000 from $87,000. The company highlighted that approximately 55% of its nine-month revenue was generated from existing distributors or territories. Additionally, VVT Med noted the launch of its ScleroSafe platform in Italy in September 2026 and the receipt of initial product orders from distributors in Italy and Greece. The company also announced a five-year exclusive commercialization agreement with CHS in Canada, which is set to become effective upon receipt of the necessary Health Canada license.

items.title: Regentis Biomaterials Establishes Global Clinical Support Team for GelrinC Phase III Trial
items.summary: Regentis Biomaterials has formed a specialized international clinical support team to provide 24/7 assistance and training to clinical sites, aiming to accelerate patient enrollment in its pivotal Phase III trial for GelrinC.
items.content: Regentis Biomaterials Ltd. announced the establishment of a global clinical support team spanning the United States, Europe, and Israel to bolster its pivotal Phase III trial of GelrinC, a hydrogel implant for knee cartilage repair. The team consists of specialized clinical representatives trained to provide hands-on surgical support, ensure protocol compliance, and offer 24/7 assistance to participating clinical sites. This initiative is designed to optimize site efficiency and accelerate patient enrollment for the study, which is intended to support a Premarket Approval (PMA) application to the U.S. FDA. CEO Ehud Geller characterized the move as a significant operational step toward completing the trial and ensuring quality consistency across all procedures.

items.title: Spinnova and Positive Materials Strengthen Long-Term Collaboration Through Preferred Partnership
items.summary: Spinnova Plc and Portuguese textile innovation company Positive Materials have signed a formal collaboration agreement to advance the development and commercialization of fabrics and garments using SPINNOVA® fiber.
items.content: Spinnova Plc and Positive Materials have entered into a preferred partnership agreement to formalize their existing collaboration on material and product development. The agreement aims to transition SPINNOVA® fiber from material trials toward commercially relevant textile applications. Under the partnership, Positive Materials will provide expertise in R&D, testing, and industrialization, while Spinnova will supply fiber materials, technical support, and product expertise. This initiative is intended to accelerate the adoption of sustainable textile solutions across the value chain by leveraging the combined capabilities of both companies.

items.title: Foresight Autonomous Receives Nasdaq Delisting Notice and Files Appeal
items.summary: Foresight Autonomous Holdings Ltd. has received a delisting notice from Nasdaq due to its ADS price falling below $1.00 and has initiated an appeal process to maintain its listing.
items.content: Foresight Autonomous Holdings Ltd. announced that it received a letter from Nasdaq Listing Qualifications on November 19, 2026, indicating that its American Depository Shares (ADS) failed to meet the minimum bid price requirement of $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days. Because the company had previously executed a reverse stock split within the past year, it is ineligible for the standard 180-day compliance period. In response, the company has filed a request for an oral hearing before the Nasdaq Hearings Panel, which stays the delisting proceedings while the appeal is pending. Foresight intends to implement an ADS ratio change to regain compliance with the minimum bid price rule before the hearing, potentially rendering the hearing unnecessary.

items.title: Faron Pharmaceuticals Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 2b BEXERA Trial
items.summary: Faron Pharmaceuticals has initiated its global Phase 2b BEXERA clinical trial by dosing the first patient with its lead immunotherapy candidate, bexmarilimab.
items.content: Faron Pharmaceuticals has announced the dosing of the first patient in its global, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2b BEXERA trial. The study evaluates the company's lead asset, bexmarilimab, in combination with standard-of-care azacitidine for treatment-naïve patients diagnosed with higher-risk myelodysplastic syndromes (HR-MDS). Bexmarilimab is a novel anti-Clever-1 humanized antibody designed to remove immunosuppression in cancers by reprogramming myeloid cell function. This milestone marks the advancement of the clinical program into a Phase 2b trial, representing a key operational development for the company's immunotherapy pipeline.

items.title: Terveystalo Plc Records Approximately EUR 59 Million in Impairment-Related Write-offs
items.summary: Terveystalo Plc has announced an impairment-related write-off of approximately EUR 59 million, disclosed as inside information on November 26, 2026.
items.content: Terveystalo Plc announced that it has recorded impairment-related write-offs totaling approximately EUR 59 million. The company released this information as inside information on November 26, 2026. The write-offs reflect a significant adjustment to the company's asset valuations. Further details regarding the specific nature of the impairments were not provided in the initial announcement.

items.title: NeuraLight Reports Positive Biomarker Results in NeuroSense's Phase 2b ALS Study
items.summary: NeuraLight announced that its AI-powered biomarker platform detected a statistically significant treatment effect in a sub-cohort of NeuroSense's Phase 2b PARADIGM study for ALS.
items.content: NeuraLight reported positive results from its proprietary biomarker platform used in NeuroSense Therapeutics' Phase 2b PARADIGM study for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). In a sub-cohort of 36 patients, the data showed that PrimeC slowed disease progression compared to placebo after six months of treatment, with an 85% effect size and a p-value of 0.04. These findings were derived from NeuraLight's AI-powered platform, which analyzes eye-movement data to measure brain function. NeuroSense CEO Alon Ben-Noon characterized the results as exploratory and requiring further confirmation, noting that they align with previously reported clinical and biological outcomes from the PARADIGM study. The company intends to use these insights to inform the design and measurement strategy for future pivotal trials.

items.title: Finnair Expands Winter Flight Services to Kittilä
items.summary: Finnair is adding new direct flight connections from Brussels and Zurich to Kittilä, Finland, to support increased winter travel demand.
items.content: Finnair has announced the addition of direct flight services to Kittilä Airport from Brussels and Zurich for the winter season. This expansion is part of a broader increase in airline operations across Lapland's airports, where Finavia anticipates a 4–8% rise in activity and 5–10% passenger growth this winter. The new routes are intended to accommodate the seasonal influx of visitors to the region.

items.title: Ariana Resources Directors Purchase Shares
items.summary: Non-Executive Deputy Chairman Michael de Villiers and his wife Diana de Villiers purchased a total of 1,214,010 ordinary shares in Ariana Resources on 25 November 2026.
items.content: Ariana Resources plc announced that Non-Executive Deputy Chairman and UK Company Secretary Michael de Villiers, along with his wife Diana de Villiers, acquired a combined 1,214,010 ordinary shares on 25 November 2026. Michael de Villiers purchased 607,005 shares at 1.30p, while Diana de Villiers purchased 607,005 shares at 1.33p. Following these transactions, Michael de Villiers' total holding increased to 71,392,995 shares, representing approximately 2.65% of the company's issued capital. The company stated that these trades constitute inside information under UK Market Abuse Regulation (MAR).

items.title: Pathos Communications Appoints Oberon Capital as Joint Corporate Broker
items.summary: Pathos Communications plc has appointed Oberon Capital as a joint corporate broker to work alongside its existing broker, Cavendish Capital Markets, effective immediately.
items.content: Pathos Communications plc announced the appointment of Oberon Capital as a joint corporate broker, effective November 25, 2026. Oberon Capital will serve alongside the company's existing corporate broker, Cavendish Capital Markets Limited. The company stated that this appointment is intended to broaden its broker coverage and enhance investor engagement, with the potential to improve market liquidity and trading support. The announcement noted that there are no changes to the company's funding, revenue, profit, cash, or guidance as a result of this appointment.
