This update follows ongoing reporting regarding the potential acquisition interest in the real estate entity.

items.title: Motorola Solutions Leadership Discusses AI Adoption at WeAreDevelopers Conference India
items.summary: Anudeep Muttavarapu, Country Head and Managing Director of Motorola Solutions, participated in the inaugural WeAreDevelopers Conference India to discuss AI integration and organizational strategy.
items.content: On November 26, 2026, Anudeep Muttavarapu, the Country Head and Managing Director of Motorola Solutions, spoke at the WeAreDevelopers Conference India held in Bengaluru. During his session, he compared the current adoption of artificial intelligence to the historical transition from steam power to electric motors in manufacturing, emphasizing that organizations must redesign their roles and skill sets to fully realize the benefits of AI. His remarks were part of a broader industry discussion on the future of software development and human-agent collaboration. The event brought together thousands of developers and tech leaders to explore the impact of AI agents on global enterprise landscapes.

items.title: Citi Reiterates Sell Rating on Elekta
items.summary: Citi has maintained its 'sell' rating on Elekta, citing concerns regarding the company's valuation.
items.content: Citi has issued an analyst update reiterating a 'sell' rating on Elekta. The firm indicated that it continues to view Elekta's current valuation as strained. This action reflects Citi's ongoing assessment of the company's market position and financial outlook.

items.title: JERA in Talks With Anthropic and Meta Regarding Data Center Development
items.summary: Japanese energy company JERA is reportedly in discussions with Anthropic and Meta to develop data centers near its power plants in Tokyo.
items.content: JERA, a major Japanese energy provider, has entered into talks with Anthropic and Meta to explore the construction of data centers in proximity to its power generation facilities in the Tokyo area. The potential collaboration aims to address the significant energy requirements of large-scale AI infrastructure. The discussions reflect a broader industry trend of AI companies seeking direct partnerships with energy providers to secure reliable power for their expanding data center footprints.

items.title: All Indian Cine Workers Association Demands Ban on Netflix's Pakistani Series
items.summary: The All Indian Cine Workers Association (AICWA) has formally requested that the Indian government block the release of Netflix's upcoming Pakistani original series, 'Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo'.
items.content: The All Indian Cine Workers Association (AICWA) has written to Prime Minister Narendra Modi urging a ban on the release of the Netflix original series 'Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo' in India. The series, which is Pakistan's first Netflix original, is scheduled for a global premiere on December 4. The association argues that the release would disregard the sentiments of families affected by terrorism and has also called for legislation to prohibit Pakistani entertainment content in India. Netflix has not yet clarified whether the series will be made available to its Indian subscribers.

items.title: Oil Sands Alliance Evaluates Impact of New Federal Tax Deduction on Pathways Carbon Capture Project
items.summary: The Oil Sands Alliance, including Imperial Oil, is assessing how a newly announced federal 'Productivity Mega Deduction' could support the development of the Pathways carbon capture and storage project.
items.content: Kendall Dilling, president of the Oil Sands Alliance, stated that the federal government's new 'Productivity Mega Deduction' could help address significant financial barriers facing the proposed Pathways carbon capture and storage project. The project, which involves Imperial Oil and other major energy companies, aims to include carbon-capture facilities at multiple oil sands operations, a shared CO₂ transportation pipeline, and a storage hub in the Cold Lake region. Dilling noted that the tax measure, which allows for the immediate deduction of capital equipment costs, may improve the project's competitiveness for capital. The alliance continues to work toward binding agreements for the project, which is designed to capture and store approximately six million tonnes of CO₂ annually.

items.title: NASA Takes Ownership of X-59 Supersonic Aircraft
items.summary: NASA has officially taken ownership of the X-59 experimental supersonic aircraft from Lockheed Martin, marking a significant milestone in the development of quiet supersonic flight.
items.content: NASA has formally accepted the X-59 aircraft from Lockheed Martin, transitioning the experimental vehicle into the next phase of its mission to demonstrate quiet supersonic flight over land. The handover represents a major milestone for the project, which aims to gather data that could eventually lead to the lifting of current bans on commercial supersonic flight over populated areas. Lockheed Martin developed the aircraft as part of a collaborative effort to reduce the sonic boom to a quieter sound. The transition allows NASA to begin its own flight testing and research operations with the vehicle.

items.title: Synopsys Launches EPIC HPC Scale-Up Program in India
items.summary: Synopsys has introduced the EPIC HPC Scale-Up Program in India, a collaborative initiative with AWS and Syncious designed to accelerate high-performance computing projects.
items.content: Synopsys has launched the EPIC HPC Scale-Up Program in India, partnering with AWS and Syncious to support the development and scaling of high-performance computing (HPC) projects. The program aims to provide resources and infrastructure to help organizations accelerate their HPC initiatives. This initiative is part of Synopsys's broader effort to expand its footprint and support the growing demand for advanced computing solutions in the region.

items.title: Dana Prepares to Combine with Eaton's Mobility Business
items.summary: Automotive supplier Dana is preparing to combine its operations with Eaton's Mobility business as it announces the appointment of a new Chief Manufacturing Officer.
items.content: Dana has announced the appointment of Chris Clark as its new Senior Vice President and Chief Manufacturing Officer. The company noted that this leadership change occurs as Dana prepares to combine its operations with Eaton's Mobility business. The report highlights the strategic transition involving the two entities, though it does not provide further details on the structure or timeline of the combination.

items.title: Cisco Named Premier Sponsor of OpenSSL
items.summary: Cisco has been identified as a premier sponsor providing multi-year financial backing and engineering resources to support the development of the OpenSSL open-source project.
items.content: Cisco is serving as a premier sponsor for the OpenSSL project, contributing both multi-year financial support and engineering resources. This sponsorship is part of a broader effort by various corporate supporters to ensure the sustainability, maintenance, and security of the OpenSSL open-source ecosystem. The support underscores the importance of cryptography as critical infrastructure in modern networking and technology environments. Other corporate supporters mentioned alongside Cisco include AWS, GitHub, Mercedes-Benz, and SAP.

items.title: Agape ATP Corporation Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Agape ATP Corporation announced its financial results for the third quarter of 2026, reporting a loss per share of $0.08 and quarterly sales of $4.798 thousand.
items.content: Agape ATP Corporation (NASDAQ: ATPC) released its financial results for the third quarter of 2026 on November 25, 2026. The company reported a loss of $0.08 per share, which represents an 85.96% improvement compared to the loss of $0.57 per share reported in the same period of the previous year. Quarterly sales were recorded at $4.798 thousand, reflecting a 95.60% decrease from the $109.024 thousand in sales reported during the same quarter last year.

items.title: DarkIris Announces $30 Million Mobile Games Acquisition and CEO Share Purchase Agreement
items.summary: DarkIris Inc. has disclosed a $30 million acquisition of mobile gaming assets to be settled in equity, alongside a share purchase agreement involving its chief executive officer and chairman.
items.content: DarkIris Inc. announced a strategic expansion through the acquisition of mobile gaming assets valued at $30 million. The transaction is structured to be paid in equity. Concurrently, the company disclosed a share purchase agreement involving its chief executive officer and chairman. These developments were reported on November 25, 2026, and were associated with significant movement in the company's stock price during pre-market trading.

items.title: Smart Logistics Global Limited Reports Q2 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Smart Logistics Global Limited (SLGB) announced its financial results for the second quarter of 2026, reporting a decline in revenue and increased losses.
items.content: Smart Logistics Global Limited (SLGB) reported a weaker second quarter for 2026, with revenue falling to $17.0 million, a 26.9% decrease compared to the same period in the previous year. The company also experienced a sharp decline in gross profit, which fell to $712,215. These results reflect the company's performance for the quarter as it continues to navigate its logistics and supply chain operations.

items.title: Lianhe Sowell International Group Files Prospectus for $200 Million Offering
items.summary: Lianhe Sowell International Group Ltd. has filed a prospectus for the potential offer and sale of up to $200 million in securities, including Class A ordinary shares, preferred shares, debt securities, warrants, and units.
items.content: Lianhe Sowell International Group Ltd. has filed a prospectus related to the potential offer and sale of up to $200 million in various securities. The filing covers a range of financial instruments, including Class A ordinary shares, preferred shares, debt securities, warrants, and units. This registration provides the company with the flexibility to raise capital through these offerings as market conditions permit. The filing represents a significant corporate action regarding the company's future capital structure and financing capabilities.

items.title: Apple Removes MiniMax's Talkie App from App Store
items.summary: Apple has removed the AI chatbot application Talkie, developed by MiniMax, from its global App Store following reports of inappropriate interactions with minors.
items.content: Apple removed the popular AI chatbot app Talkie from its App Store worldwide on November 26, 2026. The action followed media reports alleging that the application's AI-generated characters had sent sexualized and abusive messages to minors. Talkie, which allows users to interact with AI companions, has been a significant revenue driver for the Shanghai-based company. MiniMax has reportedly been shifting its strategic focus toward enterprise coding and multimodal AI models, such as its M1 and Hailuo-02 offerings, amid increasing regulatory and public scrutiny regarding the safety of AI companion platforms.

items.title: J-Star Holding Announces Strategy to Evaluate U.S. Automation and System Integration Partners
items.summary: J-Star Holding Co., Ltd. is actively seeking U.S.-based industrial automation and system integration partners to support the development of localized manufacturing capabilities for advanced carbon fiber composite products.
items.content: J-Star Holding Co., Ltd. announced it is evaluating U.S.-based companies with industrial automation and system integration capabilities as potential strategic acquisition targets, joint venture partners, or long-term engineering partners. This initiative is part of the company's broader strategy to establish localized U.S. manufacturing and develop automated production lines for advanced carbon fiber composite products. The company aims to leverage domestic engineering design, electrical control systems, and turnkey line-commissioning capabilities to support the production of structural components for applications such as unmanned aerial vehicles. J-Star is open to various transaction structures, including strategic acquisitions and project-linked equity arrangements, to build a scalable U.S. manufacturing platform.

items.title: Upland Resources Provides Operational Update on Wild Mustang Gas Development
items.summary: Upland Resources Limited reported progress on the GMF-5 well at the Wild Mustang Federal Unit in Wyoming, noting ongoing drilling and infrastructure development.
items.content: Upland Resources Limited announced that the GMF-5 well, the third well at the Wild Mustang Federal Unit in Wyoming, has reached a depth of approximately 13,000 feet toward a planned total depth of 19,700 feet. The company reported gas shows in the Fort Union and Upper Sussex formations, though these intervals are not currently included in existing gas-in-place estimates. Additionally, the five-mile gas sales pipeline is approximately 80% complete, with connection to existing infrastructure anticipated in December 2026, pending final construction and approvals. Upland has invested approximately US$4.3 million in the project through its subsidiary, Upland Resources (Wyoming) Ltd., and retains an option to invest up to an additional US$9.5 million through December 31, 2030.

The agreement aims to explore potential collaborations on international swimming competitions, training camps, and related events. These activities are intended to take place in Singapore, China, and other mutually identified locations. items.title: CBAK Energy to Present at Sidoti Year-End Virtual Investor Conference
items.summary: CBAK Energy Technology Limited announced that its CFO, Jiewei Li, will present at the Sidoti Year-End Virtual Investor Conference on December 10, 2026.
items.content: CBAK Energy Technology Limited announced that Chief Financial Officer Jiewei Li is scheduled to present at the Sidoti Year-End Virtual Investor Conference, taking place from December 9 to December 10, 2026. During the presentation on December 10, Mr. Li will discuss the company's recent financial and operational performance, including progress in large cylindrical battery development, manufacturing capacity expansion, and international market growth. The company also highlighted recent operational milestones, including a fourth-place ranking in China for large cylindrical battery shipments during the first nine months of 2026 and a 152.78% year-over-year revenue increase for its 32140 FS and 40135 FS cell lines during the same period. Additionally, the company noted a battery supply framework with a European technology company, with cumulative orders exceeding $4.5 million as of September 27, 2026, and projected annual sales from this relationship to exceed $30 million in 2027 and 2028.

items.title: BioNexus Gene Lab Corp. Authorizes $2 Million Share Repurchase Program
items.summary: BioNexus Gene Lab Corp. has announced a new share repurchase program authorizing the buyback of up to $2 million of its common stock over the next 12 months.
items.content: On November 25, 2026, BioNexus Gene Lab Corp. announced that its Board of Directors authorized a program to repurchase up to $2 million of its common stock in the open market. The program, which began on November 23, 2026, is set to run for 12 months and will be funded using the company's existing unrestricted corporate cash. The $2 million limit covers the purchase price, brokerage fees, and other associated costs. The company is not obligated to purchase any specific number of shares and may suspend or terminate the program at any time based on market conditions, available cash, and regulatory requirements. Repurchased shares will be retired and become authorized but unissued shares under Wyoming law.

items.title: Primagrove Sets IPO Terms
items.summary: Primagrove has set terms for its upcoming initial public offering, planning to offer 6.3 million shares at a price range of $4.00 to $6.00.
items.content: Primagrove, a Hong Kong-based provider of enterprise software and workspace solutions, has established terms for its initial public offering. The company intends to offer 6.3 million shares, with an estimated price range between $4.00 and $6.00 per share. According to industry tracking, the offering is expected to raise approximately $30.5 million. The IPO is currently scheduled to take place during the week of December 7, 2026.

items.title: Mingteng International Announces 1-for-5 Share Consolidation
items.summary: Mingteng International Corporation Inc. has announced a 1-for-5 share consolidation for its Class A and Class B ordinary shares, effective November 30, 2026.
items.content: Mingteng International Corporation Inc. (Nasdaq: MTEN) announced that its Class A and Class B ordinary shares will undergo a 1-for-5 share consolidation. This action was approved by shareholders at an extraordinary general meeting held on November 20, 2026. Following the consolidation, the company's Class A ordinary shares are expected to begin trading on a split-adjusted basis on the Nasdaq Capital Market at the market opening on November 30, 2026. The ticker symbol will remain "MTEN," and the company will issue a new CUSIP number for the Class A shares. The consolidation will reduce the number of outstanding Class A shares from 7,639,410 to approximately 1,527,882 and Class B shares from 10,455 to 2,091, subject to rounding.

items.title: Asiatel Outsourcing Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Asiatel Outsourcing Inc. announced its financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, reporting a 32% year-over-year increase in third-quarter service revenue.
items.content: Asiatel Outsourcing Inc. reported third-quarter 2026 service revenue of $2.86 million, representing a 32% increase from $2.17 million in the same period of 2025. The company achieved a gross profit of $430,974 for the quarter, resulting in a gross margin of 15%. For the nine-month period ended September 30, 2026, service revenue reached $8.00 million compared to $5.57 million in the prior year's period. As of September 30, 2026, the company held $1.10 million in cash and $587,728 in working capital. This report marks the company's first full quarter as a publicly traded entity on the TSX Venture Exchange.

items.title: Gulf Resources Announces Agreement to Acquire Bromine and Crude Salt Assets
items.summary: Gulf Resources, Inc. has entered into an agreement for its subsidiary, Shouguang City Haoyuan Chemical Company Limited (SCHC), to acquire bromine and crude salt assets from the collective economic organization of Caiyangzi Village.
items.content: On November 25, 2026, Gulf Resources, Inc. announced that it and its wholly owned subsidiary, SCHC, signed a purchase agreement to acquire bromine and crude salt assets located in Shouguang City. The transaction includes 1.29 square kilometers of crude salt fields and is valued at approximately RMB 103.5 million (roughly $14 million). The consideration consists of a cash payment of RMB 8.3 million and the issuance of 355,000 restricted shares of Gulf Resources common stock at a price of $3.50 per share. The company expects the acquisition to expand its production capacity for bromine and crude salt. The deal is subject to customary closing conditions, including a satisfactory asset assessment, with a targeted closing date of December 31, 2026.

items.title: Golden Heaven Group Holdings Ltd. Announces 80-for-1 Reverse Stock Split
items.summary: Golden Heaven Group Holdings Ltd. announced a 1-for-80 reverse stock split of its Class A and Class B ordinary shares, effective November 30, 2026.
items.content: Golden Heaven Group Holdings Ltd. (Nasdaq: GDHG) announced that its authorized, issued, and outstanding shares will undergo a 1-for-80 reverse stock split, effective at the opening of trading on November 30, 2026. Following the consolidation, the company's Class A ordinary shares will continue to trade on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the ticker symbol "GDHG" but with a new CUSIP number. items.title: Concord Medical Receives NYSE Non-Compliance Letter Regarding Delayed Financial Filings
items.summary: Concord Medical Services Holdings Limited has been notified by the NYSE of non-compliance with listing standards due to the delayed filing of restated financial statements for fiscal years 2024 and 2025.
items.content: Concord Medical Services Holdings Limited announced that it received a letter from the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) on November 23, 2026, indicating non-compliance with Section 802.01E of the NYSE Listed Company Manual. The notification stems from the company's failure to file restated financial statements for the fiscal years ended December 31, 2024, and 2025, including amended Annual Reports on Form 20-F, within the required timeframe. This restatement is necessary to reflect the deconsolidation of Concord Healthcare Group Co., Ltd. effective in 2024, following a prior SEC staff request. The company is currently working with independent auditors to complete the restatements and expects to file the delayed reports by December 31, 2026. The NYSE notification does not result in immediate delisting or trading suspension, and the company will be listed as a late filer with an "LF" indicator until compliance is regained.

items.title: Wall Street Analysts Update Ratings and Price Targets for Dell Technologies
items.summary: Multiple financial analysts updated their ratings and price targets for Dell Technologies Inc. on November 26, 2026.
items.content: On November 26, 2026, several major financial institutions updated their investment ratings and price targets for Dell Technologies (NYSE: DELL). Analysts from Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, BofA Securities, Barclays, and Deutsche Bank provided revised outlooks, with price targets for the company's stock ranging from $325 to $700. These updates reflect ongoing market analysis of the company's performance and valuation within the technology sector.

items.title: ExxonMobil Files Disclosure Regarding Threshold Crossing in Esso S.A.F.
items.summary: ExxonMobil informed the French financial markets authority (AMF) that its stake in Esso S.A.F. has fallen below multiple ownership thresholds following the completion of a previously announced block acquisition.
items.content: ExxonMobil France Holding SAS notified the AMF that its participation in Esso S.A.F. has crossed below the 2/3, 50%, 1/3, 30%, 25%, 20%, 15%, 10%, and 5% thresholds of capital and voting rights. This disclosure follows the completion of the sale of its stake in the company, which was part of an agreement announced on May 28, 2025, involving the acquisition of an 82.89% block of Esso S.A.F. and 100% of ExxonMobil Chemical France. The transaction was finalized on November 28, 2025, at a final price of 26.19 € per share, following various adjustments and distributions. The current filing serves as a formal regulatory update regarding the change in ownership status.

items.title: MegazoneCloud Launches Amazon Quick Center of Excellence
items.summary: MegazoneCloud has established a dedicated Center of Excellence to support enterprise adoption of Amazon's AI and data analytics tools.
items.content: MegazoneCloud, an AI and cloud services company, has officially launched its Amazon Quick Center of Excellence (CoE). The new practice is designed to facilitate the transition of enterprise clients from manual workflows to autonomous, AI-driven operations using Amazon's Quick platform. The initiative focuses on the 'last mile' of enterprise AI, providing governed autonomy, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and wave-based rollout templates to ensure production-ready adoption. By pairing the Amazon Quick agentic workspace with structured delivery engagements, the CoE aims to move clients beyond business intelligence into autonomous workload management.

items.title: JPMorgan Chase & Co. Discloses Holding in Vistry Group PLC
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. notified the market that it crossed a 5.001569% holding threshold in Vistry Group PLC as of November 24, 2026.
items.content: JPMorgan Chase & Co. filed a regulatory notification confirming that it held a 5.001569% interest in Vistry Group PLC as of November 24, 2026. The position represents 15,908,154 voting rights, consisting of 2,196,998 direct shares and 13,711,156 votes held through cash-settled equity swaps. The notification was formally submitted on November 26, 2026, in accordance with standard regulatory disclosure requirements.

items.title: Reports Indicate McDonald's App Sending Unauthorized Notifications
items.summary: Users have reported receiving promotional push notifications and Live Activities from the McDonald's app even when notifications are disabled.
items.content: Reports have emerged indicating that the McDonald's mobile app is sending promotional push notifications and utilizing Live Activities to display advertisements to iPhone users, even when those users have explicitly disabled notification permissions. The issue, which has also been observed with other retail and restaurant apps, raises questions regarding compliance with Apple's App Store guidelines, which generally prohibit the use of push notifications for marketing without user consent. While the technical cause remains unclear, the reports suggest a potential conflict between app functionality and iOS notification settings.

items.title: Families File Lawsuit Against Uber Following Fatal Arizona Collision
items.summary: Families of victims involved in a 2025 Arizona car crash have filed a lawsuit against Uber, alleging negligence in driver screening and supervision.
items.content: A lawsuit has been filed in Pima County Superior Court against Uber Technologies, Inc. following a fatal October 2025 collision in Tucson, Arizona. The complaint alleges that the company failed to adequately screen, qualify, train, and supervise the driver involved in the accident, which resulted in the deaths of four individuals, including two Uber passengers and a minor. The plaintiffs contend that Uber did not exercise reasonable care in monitoring its drivers, raising concerns about the company's safety protocols for transporting passengers. The litigation seeks to address these alleged failures and hold the company accountable for the incident.

items.title: Nexus Advanced Technologies Inc. Appoints Cheng Sin Yi as Co-Chief Executive Officer
items.summary: Nexus Advanced Technologies Inc. has appointed Cheng Sin Yi as Co-Chief Executive Officer, effective November 21, 2026, as part of a leadership transition.
items.content: Nexus Advanced Technologies Inc. (Nasdaq: NXAT) announced the appointment of Ms. Cheng Sin Yi as Co-Chief Executive Officer, effective November 21, 2026. As part of this leadership change, Myungjong Kim has stepped down from his role as of the same date, and current Co-CEO Ted Kim is scheduled to step down at the beginning of next year. Ms. Cheng brings over 15 years of experience in finance, corporate management, and capital markets to the company. The company stated that her appointment is intended to strengthen its financial foundation, governance, and efforts to meet Nasdaq continued listing requirements.

items.title: Investigation into Alleged Deliberate Methane Releases at Chevron Facilities
items.summary: A probe has identified instances of methane plumes at Chevron facilities that were allegedly released deliberately.
items.content: An investigation has reportedly uncovered evidence of methane plumes at Chevron-operated sites that were characterized as being deliberately released. This finding raises concerns regarding operational practices and environmental compliance. The company is now facing scrutiny over these specific emissions events, which have been highlighted in recent reports.

items.title: Johanna Mendez Appointed Global Procurement Director at Johnson & Johnson
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson has appointed Johanna Mendez as the new Global Procurement Director for Enterprise Categories (GPO).
items.content: Johanna Mendez has been appointed as the Global Procurement Director, Enterprise Categories (GPO) at Johnson & Johnson. Mendez brings over 19 years of experience in finance, procurement, and sustainability across Latin America and the EMEA region. In her new role, she is expected to leverage her expertise in scaling regional and global operations to drive financial impact and optimize end-to-end procurement processes for the company.
